title: Sr. Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a Staff AI Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, evolving, and scaling Teradata’s enterprise AI platforms and capabilities. This role goes beyond feature delivery—you will own architecture level decisions, influence AI platform strategy, and lead complex initiatives spanning agentic AI, LLM platforms, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), vector stores, and developer facing AI systems.
  
  
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, partner closely with product and architecture leadership, and raise the technical bar across multiple teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
*Technical Leadership & Architecture*

* Lead the design and evolution of largescale, distributed AI systems that power Teradata’s AI platform and AI native products.
* Own end-to-end architecture for critical AI capabilities such as agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, vector search, semantic retrieval, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Drive technical strategy and architectural consistency across multiple engineering teams.

*AI Systems & Platform Development*

* Design and implement production grade AI systems using LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and agent based architectures.
* Build scalable, secure, and reusable platform services and APIs supporting AI workloads across the software development lifecycle.
* Define and implement guardrails for reliability, safety, governance, and cost control in enterprise AI systems.

*Cross Functional Influence*

* Partner with product management, architecture, research, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
* Influence roadmap decisions by providing deep technical insight, tradeoff analysis, and long-term platform thinking.
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex system design, performance, and reliability challenges.

*Quality, Performance & Operational Excellence*

* Drive best practices for testing, observability, evaluation, and production readiness of AI systems.
* Identify systemic performance bottlenecks and lead efforts to optimize distributed systems and AI pipelines.
* Establish engineering standards that improve development velocity, quality, and operational resilience.

*Mentorship & Org Level Impact*

* Mentor Senior and Staff level engineers, providing guidance on architecture, design reviews, and technical decision making.
* Raise the overall engineering bar through design forums, technical reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Lead by example through hands on contributions to the most complex and business critical problems.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will partner closely with product and architecture leadership, and raise the technical bar across multiple teams.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience building backend services, distributed systems, or data/AI platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Go, or Python, with experience building largescale services.
* Deep understanding of distributed system design, scalability, fault tolerance, and cloud native architectures.
* Proven experience designing and operating production systems with SQL and NoSQL data stores.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Exposure to agentic AI patterns such as tool calling, planning, memory, and multi-step reasoning.
* Experience building or operating AI systems in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production-grade observability.

**Why We Think You'll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
**Department**
: Technology & Product
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About TerraTern**
TerraTern is one of India’s fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility startups, helping individuals navigate international relocation with confidence. We deliver end-to-end visa support, job search guidance, and mobility resources designed for global aspirants. Transparency, precision, and client trust are the foundation of everything we build.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an AI Engineer to build products that use large language models to help people plan their move abroad. You will work with our product and tech teams to take an idea from a rough sketch to a working feature that real users rely on. Freshers with good projects and a strong interest in AI are welcome to apply.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build AI features using LLM APIs, such as chat assistants, document readers and smart search.
* Set up RAG systems so our AI answers from TerraTern’s own trusted information.
* Create AI agents and workflows that handle repeat tasks for our users and our team.
* Connect AI features to our website, apps and internal tools through clean APIs.
* Test every feature on real questions, and fix wrong or unclear answers before users see them.
* Watch speed, cost and accuracy after launch, and bring all three in line.
* Work with product managers and designers so each feature is easy to use and solves a real problem.

**Eligibility & Requirements**

* 1 to 3 years of experience building software or AI applications, or a fresher with strong projects, internships or open-source work.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI or a related field.
* Good Python skills, and comfort with APIs, Git and a database.
* Hands-on use of at least one LLM API such as OpenAI, Claude or Gemini.
* Basic understanding of embeddings, vector search and prompt design.
* Clear communication, and the ability to explain technical ideas in simple words.
* Curiosity, ownership and a habit of finishing what you start.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n or similar tools.
* A deployed AI project, even a small personal one.
* Interest in immigration, education or global careers.

**Why Join TerraTern**

* Impactful Work: Build tools that help people reach jobs and study options abroad.
* Professional Growth: Learn from the team and work on real AI products from day one.
* Entrepreneurial Culture: Share your ideas, try them out and own the result.
* Collaborative Environment: Work closely with product, sales and operations in a team that likes to learn together.

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer (AI FDE)
description:
**About The Job**
**Department:**
Founder’s Office

Full-time
  
  
**About TerraTern**
TerraTern is one of India’s fastest-growing Global Talent Mobility startups, helping individuals navigate international relocation with confidence. We deliver end-to-end visa support, job search guidance, and mobility resources designed for global aspirants. Transparency, precision, and client trust are the foundation of everything we build.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an AI Forward Deployed Engineer to sit close to our founders and our teams, find the slow and manual parts of our work, and fix them with AI. You will not wait for a long spec. You will talk to the people doing the work, build a working solution quickly, and stay with it until it makes their day easier. Freshers with good projects and a strong urge to build are welcome to apply.

* Work with the founders and team leads in sales, counselling, operations and marketing to understand where time and effort are being lost.
* Build AI tools and automations for those problems, using LLM APIs, agents and no-code tools such as n8n.
* Ship small working versions fast, put them in front of the team, and improve them based on real feedback.

* Hands-on use of at least one LLM API such as OpenAI, Claude or Gemini.
* Clear communication, and the ability to explain technical ideas in simple words to people who are not technical.
* Comfort with unclear problems, and the habit of asking good questions before building.
* High ownership, a strong sense of urgency and a habit of finishing what you start.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with n8n, Zapier, Make or similar automation tools.
* Experience with RAG, agents or chat assistants.
* A project you built and shipped that real people used, even a small one.
* Interest in immigration, education or global careers.

**Why Join TerraTern**

* High Impact: Build tools that your own colleagues use every day, and see the result within days.
* Fast Growth: Work close to the founders and learn how a business runs while you build for it.
* Entrepreneurial Culture: Share your ideas, try them out and own the result.
* Collaborative Environment: Work with every team in the company, in a group that likes to learn together.

title: Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineering
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**GCL:**
D3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to harness Generative AI and agentic systems to transform how therapies reach patients and sharpen commercial decision-making? As a Senior Consultant in AI/ML Engineering based in Bangalore, you will design, build and ship AI solutions that help clinicians, field teams and partners act faster and smarter—ultimately improving outcomes for millions.
  
  
Do you want to lead end-to-end delivery, from problem framing and experimentation through evaluation, deployment and monitoring? You will work across multiple disease areas and brands, integrating diverse data sources to deliver robust tools. You will join a global community of data scientists, ML engineers and domain experts, providing technical leadership on high-impact projects while deepening your expertise in the latest AI methods.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Generative and Agentic Solutions: Design, build and deploy Generative AI and agentic solutions for commercial use cases, including LLM applications and multi-agent systems on frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
* Fine-tuning and Distillation: Develop and apply fine-tuning and distillation techniques to enhance quality while reducing cost and latency.
* Evaluation and Safety: Build and operate evaluation harnesses and platforms to measure quality, safety and reliability of LLM and agent systems, using results to drive continuous improvements.
* Production Telemetry and Monitoring: Implement telemetry, tracing and monitoring for AI systems in production and respond to quality, drift and cost issues.
* Reinforcement Learning: Explore and apply reinforcement learning and feedback-based optimisation where they add measurable value.
* Classical ML Delivery: Develop and maintain traditional ML models (classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, NLP) for commercial analytics.
* Data Integration: Integrate internal and external structured and unstructured data by partnering with data engineering, informatics and platform teams.
* Technical Leadership and Code Quality: Lead technical workstreams and write production-quality, well-tested and well-documented code that scales.
* Multi-functional Partnerships: Collaborate with Commercial, Medical, IT and other partners to scope problems, define success metrics and deliver scalable solutions.
* Research and Coaching: Research and apply the latest algorithms and methods to business problems, and coach junior data scientists and engineers to set the standard.

**Essential Skills/Experience**
**Minimum Requirements**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field.
* Typically 6+ years of experience building data science and ML solutions, including recent hands-on experience (typically 1+ years) with LLM-based applications.
* A track record of independently leading data science or AI projects to solve business or scientific problems.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and working knowledge of fine-tuning and distillation approaches.
* Agentic AI: experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangGraph, Strands or similar.
* Evaluation: experience designing and running evaluations of LLM and agent systems.
* Machine learning foundations: classical ML (supervised and unsupervised methods, including classification and regression) and deep learning, including transformers, using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Programming and tools: exceptional Python; SQL and familiarity with NoSQL; scikit-learn; Jupyter; Streamlit or similar.
* Cloud: working knowledge of AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock preferred).

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Master’s or PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field. We prioritise demonstrated skills over credentials.
* Familiarity with reinforcement learning, including preference-based optimisation of LLMs.
* Experience with telemetry and observability tooling for AI systems.
* MLOps tooling: MLflow, Docker, CI/CD, and pipeline tools such as Airflow.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, and with structured and unstructured data (text and image).
* Pharmaceutical, healthcare or commercial analytics domain experience.
* Curiosity and a desire to keep learning new technologies and methods in AI.
* Ability to explain complex methods and techniques to a non-technical audience.
* Ability to collaborate closely with multi-functional, global teams.
* Good written and verbal communication skills; fluent English.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, your AI craftsmanship directly accelerates how science reaches patients. You will collaborate with diverse experts who thrive on solving complex, real-world problems—bringing advanced methods in machine learning, LLMs and multi-agent systems to life at scale. We combine bold ambition with genuine support, valuing kindness alongside pace, and we create practical solutions by putting unexpected teams together to unlock new ideas. If you want to push the boundaries of data and AI while seeing tangible impact in the clinic and the marketplace, this is where your work will matter every day.
  
  
**Call To Action**
Take the lead in building AI that changes outcomes for patients and the business—send us your CV and help shape the future of how medicines reach those who need them.
  
  
**Date Posted**
13-Nov-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
19-Nov-2026
  
  
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: AI Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**
**Introducing Amex Tech & Enterprise CRM Solutions (eCRMs)**
At American Express, technology is at the core of how we innovate, grow, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Joining Amex Tech means being part of a global engineering organization that is shaping the future of commerce through cutting-edge platforms, data, and Artificial Intelligence. Our teams build scalable, secure, and intelligent systems that power seamless experiences for customers and colleagues worldwide.
  
  
Within this ecosystem, Enterprise CRM Solutions (eCRMs), part of the International Card & Risk Services Technology organization, plays a pivotal role in enabling customer-centric growth. eCRMs brings together engineering, product, and business teams to deliver modern, connected CRM capabilities across both Customer and Sales domains. The organization is focused on transforming the CRM landscape by centralizing customer data, reducing fragmentation, and enabling more personalized, insight-driven interactions at scale.
  
  
Artificial Intelligence is a key driver of this transformation. From intelligent automation to advanced decisioning and personalized engagement, we are embedding AI into core sales and customer platforms—while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and responsible use at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Role Description**
As an AI Engineer within Enterprise CRM Solutions (eCRMs), you will contribute to advancing AI-driven transformation across customer and sales platforms at American Express. Working at the intersection of data, AI, and CRM modernization, you will help build intelligent, scalable solutions that enhance customer engagement, improve sales effectiveness, and support compliance and governance.
  
  
In this role, you will develop and implement AI-powered capabilities that bring greater intelligence and automation into customer and sales processes. This includes building GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for quality monitoring, intelligent workflows, personalized customer experiences, and customer data enrichment. You will work with enterprise data platforms and cloud-native technologies to develop production-ready AI applications that integrate with business systems and enable better decision-making.
  
  
You will also contribute to the development of enterprise AI platforms, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices while ensuring AI solutions are reliable, secure, and aligned with responsible AI and governance standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement AI and Agentic AI solutions that enhance customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and operational efficiency across enterprise CRM platforms.
* Build intelligent workflows using Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise data, and tool integrations to automate customer and business processes.
* Develop production-ready GenAI applications, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and AI-powered business workflows.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and AI solutions using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, Composer (Airflow), DataProc, and related cloud services.
* Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, and data platforms while ensuring operational reliability and performance.
* Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to shared AI frameworks, reusable components, evaluation pipelines, and engineering standards.
* Ensure AI applications comply with enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and operational standards.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, or applied AI.
* Hands-on experience building or integrating GenAI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Experience with Agentic AI concepts, including orchestration frameworks, tool calling, context management, or multi-step AI workflows.
* Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation techniques.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.
* Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Composer (Airflow), DataProc, Cloud Storage, and related data services.
* Understanding of cloud-native application development, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices.
* Knowledge of CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and production deployment concepts.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Nexperia**
is a world-class company in semiconductor development and in-house production. A proven global player with an entrepreneurial mentality. At our core is an 13,000+ strong international network with a singular focus. Built on passion and commitment to our work, belief in our goals and a drive to succeed regardless of the challenges we face. We support, reward and challenge individuals equally, in a dynamic and energetic environment.
  
  
Nexperia is a world-class company in semiconductor development and in-house production. We form a global network of talent, with passion and performance, perseverance and professionalism. Join TeamNexperia and become part of a leading company that supports, rewards and challenges you equally, in a dynamic environment, working for world-class results. Talk to us today and learn your true capabilities in an energetic company where you will develop and thrive, the Efficiency Company – Nexperia.
  
  
**About The Team**
Digital Enablement is Nexperia's fast-track enabler of AI & Digital use-cases and platform enablement. We operate as one global practice across Nijmegen, Hamburg, Kuala Lumpur, Seremban and Bangalore, covering digital strategy, cloud and infrastructure, digital factory and enterprise, data, AI and integration.
  
  
Bangalore is where we build and ship the agentic systems that put Nexperia's AI patterns in front of real users: copilots, IDE tooling and internal automation that engineers across the company touch every day.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is the senior build role for Nexperia's agent engineering practice in Bangalore. You own the architecture of the agents themselves — reasoning, planning, tool-calling and memory — and you own the surfaces people actually use them through: chat UI, IDE extensions, CLI tools and the APIs behind them.
  
  
You work closely with the Integration Architect on how agents connect into IDEs and internal systems, and with the MLOps/eval function on the quality bar an agent has to clear before it ships.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You are still writing and reviewing code, still debugging orchestration failures when something breaks in production, and still accountable for what ships — not a role that manages from a distance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Architect and orchestrate agents**

* Design agent architecture: reasoning loops, planning, tool-calling and memory/context management.
* Build multi-step orchestration: task decomposition, tool selection and error recovery.
* Partner with the Integration Architect on connecting agents to IDEs and internal systems.

**Ship end-to-end agent products**

* Own the build of user-facing surfaces for Copilot-style products: chat UI, IDE extensions and CLI tools.
* Build the backend APIs that connect those surfaces to agent and LLM services, including streaming responses, session state and context handling.
* Ship integrations into developer tools (VS Code extension API, LSPs, browser extensions) and own deployment of both the frontend and backend components you build.

**Set the bar and take releases live**

* Review code and agent designs from the two Junior AI Engineers, and mentor them toward independent ownership.
* Define the agent quality bar with the MLOps/eval function before anything ships, and work with that function on the CI/CD, monitoring, versioning/rollback and observability an agent needs once it's live.

**Enable the Spokes**

* Own the governance bar for citizen-built agents — what "safe to ship" means for security, data access, cost and quality — in partnership with security/compliance and the Integration Architect.
* Publish and maintain the standards — prompting, evals, architecture patterns — that spoke teams build against.
* Own the design of the self-service component catalog spokes build on top of, and the support model — office hours, an embedded rotation, or a ticket queue — for citizen developers using it

**What You Bring**
We have kept this list to what the role truly requires. If this role excites you and you meet most, but not all, of these points, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Core Requirements**

* 1-6 years hands-on building LLM or agent systems.
* Strong Python and/or TypeScript; comfortable owning a service end to end.
* Hands-on with agent frameworks or SDKs (Claude Agent SDK/MCP, LangGraph, AutoGen) or custom orchestration.
* Has shipped an agentic system to production, not just a prototype.
* Solid grasp of traditional machine learning/AI (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, feature engineering) in addition to LLM/agent-based approaches..
* Comfortable designing REST, GraphQL and streaming/WebSocket APIs, and familiar with LLM streaming APIs (SSE/WebSockets) and token-by-token rendering.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI/copilot platforms and cloud-native model ecosystems — Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry (model catalog, deployments, and orchestration), and AWS model configuration (Bedrock model access, inference profiles/settings) is a plus.

**Valuable extras**

* Strong in React/TypeScript for frontend work, and Node.js or Python for backend work.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or similar), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Observability tooling — Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, or LLM-specific tools like LangSmith or Arize — and familiarity with LLMOps practices: prompt versioning, eval pipelines, cost tracking.
* Working knowledge of auth and session management, and awareness of security and compliance considerations for AI systems.
* Experience in the manufacturing industry, preferably semiconductor, is a plus.
* Experience or interest in developer enablement or platform engineering — documentation, SDKs, or internal tooling built for non-specialist users, not just for your own team.

**Why join us**

* Real ownership: you set the architecture and the quality bar for agents that ship to real users, not just a reference design others build from.
* A mentoring role with teeth: two Junior AI Engineers are counting on your reviews, and Nexperia measures you on their growth as much as on your own output.
* You're measured not only on what the Hub ships, but on how many spoke teams successfully ship agents using what you've published.
* Global exposure from Bangalore: you work with the AI and Data Centers of Enablement, the Integration Architect, platform engineering, security and compliance, with visibility up to the CIO and IT Management Team.
* A team that values structured thinking, intellectual honesty about trade-offs and good documentation over heroics.

**Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. Nexperia job adverts are Nexperia copyright © material and the word Nexperia® is a registered trademark.**
**D&I Statement**
As an equal-opportunity employer, Nexperia values diversity not just because it is the right thing to do but because diverse teams perform better. We are dedicated to being inclusive, and a proof point of this dedication is that we were the main partner of the very first Dutch Paralympic Team NL House during the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested.
  
  
In addition, we offer our colleagues the possibility to join employee resource groups such as the Pride Network Group or global and local Women's groups. Nexperia is committed to increasing women in management positions to 30% by 2030.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
**Autonomize AI**
is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients.
  
  
We're looking for engineers who don't just
*integrate*
AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end.
  
  
This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry.
  
  
**You're a Fit If You Have**

* AI-native engineering is your default mode
* You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
* You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
* You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing
* You've instrumented AI systems for observability - latency, token usage, hallucination rate, drift
* You can reason about model tradeoffs (context length, cost, latency, accuracy) and make architectural calls accordingly
* You've worked with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
* You build robust backend systems
* 6 + years building production web applications from scratch
* Deep Python proficiency; comfortable with FastAPI, Django, or Flask in production
* Experience designing APIs that serve both humans and AI agents (tool schemas, structured outputs, streaming)
* Async-first thinking: asyncio, task queues, event-driven architectures
* Kafka, Redis, or ActiveMQ for real-time data movement
* Postgres, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in production
* You operate at cloud scale
* Docker and Kubernetes in production - this is a hard requirement
* At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) with real operational experience
* Microservices and cloud-native design patterns
* You've been on-call. You know what a bad deploy feels like at 2am.
* You can ship a frontend when the product demands it
* React, TypeScript, or modern JS frameworks
* Enough frontend fluency to build clinical interfaces without a dedicated frontend handoff

**Bonus Points**

* Led a small engineering team - mentored, reviewed, unblocked
* CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes certification
* ML/DL model deployment experience (PyTorch, scikit-learn)
* Built evaluation harnesses or used MLflow, LangSmith, or similar for AI observability
* Healthcare domain experience (FHIR, HL7, clinical workflows)

**What We Value Above Credentials**
**Bias toward action**
- you ship, then iterate. You learn by doing, not by planning.
  
  
**Owner mentality**
- you don't wait for permission. You identify what needs to exist and build it.
  
  
**Intellectual honesty**
- you'd rather say "I don't know, let me find out". When unsure, seek the right information from your peers or leaders.
  
  
**Async-first communication**
- you write clearly, document decisions, and work well across time zones.
  
  
**What You'll Get**
**Ground floor equity**
in a VC-backed healthcare AI company growing fast
  
  
**Full-stack ownership**
- no handoffs, no silos, no "that's not my team"
  
  
**Direct access to founders and customers**
- your technical decisions will be seen and felt
  
  
**Professional development budget**
- conferences, courses, certifications, books
  
  
**Flexible, remote-friendly culture**
built around output, not hours
  
  
*If you've been waiting for a role where AI isn't a feature - it's the foundation - this is it.*

title: Applied Scientist III, Advertising Trust
description:
**Description**
Amazon Advertising Trust is on a mission to redefine how trust is enforced at internet scale, and we are looking for exceptional scientists to help lead the way. We are building systems that reason about advertising content the way a trained human would, at a industry leading volume and speed, and that keep working when the rules change underneath them.
  
  
At Ads Trust Science we leverage machine learning, generative AI, and large-scale retrieval to solve some of the most complex decision problems for ads worldwide. Every ad shown across Amazon's owned-and-operated properties and third-party networks, in every format and every global marketplace, depends on decisions our systems make. We are just getting started.
  
  
As a Senior Applied Scientist you will be at the forefront of this work. You will own science problems end to end, bridging the gap between research and production impact. You will not be handed a specification. You will be given a customer problem, a system that partly solves it, and the latitude to decide what to build next.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of multimodal understanding, large language models, and large-scale retrieval, on a problem where the science is genuinely unsettled. You will work alongside scientists whose models run in front of hundreds of millions of customers, at a scale that changes which approaches are even possible.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Ship a model into production, then find and document where it fails once real traffic reaches it.
* Drive the technical discussion, inside your team and with partner teams, on how to close that gap.
* Bring a fresh angle to a problem that is not yours and help a peer get further than they would have alone, building trust across the team in the process.
* Mentor while staying hands-on. At this level the design and the code are both yours.

**About The Team**
Ads Trust Science is a group of scientists who would rather change what the team measures than optimise the wrong number. We value curiosity, rigour, and a bias for action. We expect people to disagree with evidence, to say clearly what did not work, and to iterate quickly toward the solutions that matter.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability
* PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

The AI team within Tech COE organization is responsible for building the ultimate go-to-market engine to connect our solutions with customer needs at scale. As a Senior Associate Decision Science, you will be partnering with stakeholders to crack the most important challenges to drive operational excellence and ultimately increase customer value.

This role focuses on building and deploying AI and GenAI solutions that turn complex data into actionable business insights, improve forecasting, and drive operational efficiency. It involves solving advanced analytical problems, creating intelligent systems for sales teams, and partnering cross-functionally to scale data-driven processes and innovation.

The ideal candidate should have a strategic mindset and strong communications skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and drive critical business decisions. The candidate should also be able to handle highly sensitive, confidential, and non-routine information, have high attention to detail, be open-minded to challenge the status quo and work in a rapidly changing organization in close collaboration with business partners.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of strategic AI/ML initiatives, from problem definition and solution design to production deployment and business adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities and translate ambiguous business problems into scalable AI-driven solutions.
* Design, develop, evaluate, and productionize machine learning, deep learning, and Generative AI models, including agentic AI workflows where appropriate.
* Own technical solution architecture, model selection, experimentation strategy, and production deployment while ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Drive AI innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, recommendation systems, optimization techniques, and predictive modelling to improve business outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering and Infrastructure teams to build robust ML pipelines, automate model retraining, monitoring, and continuous evaluation.
* Define success metrics, conduct experiments, analyse outcomes, and communicate insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and best practices in AI/ML development.
* Influence technical direction across multiple projects while driving engineering excellence and reusable AI platforms.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 7+ years of industry experience applying machine learning and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems.
* Programming skills in Python with experience building production-grade ML applications.
* Experience building scalable ML pipelines and integrating models into production systems.
* Experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets using Spark, SQL, or distributed computing frameworks.
* Communication skills: ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building production-grade Generative AI applications using LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience in deploying machine learning models in Azure cloud.
* Experience with distributed data systems such as Hadoop and related technologies (Spark, Presto, Pig, Hive, etc.)
* Background in any one of programming language (C#, Java, PHP, JavaScript)
* Experience designing multi-agent systems and autonomous AI workflows.
* Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, MLOps, model monitoring, observability, and production AI governance.
* Experience mentoring scientists and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Publications, patents, or contributions to open-source AI projects are a plus.

* Machine Learning & Deep Learning
* AI Model Deployment
* Distributed Data Systems
* Mentoring
* Stakeholder Management

Opkey is the leading Cloud Application Lifecycle Management (CALM) platform for Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, Coupa, and more. Whether it’s a new implementation, a platform update, or business‑as‑usual change, Opkey handles it all: updates validated in hours, self‑healing tests, end‑to‑end integrations assured, configurations synced, and training updated in real time—all delivered in a single unified platform instead of a patchwork of disconnected tools.

**About The Opportunity**

* We are hiring an AI Engineer to fine-tune, train, and evaluate large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for production use. You will own models end to end: data, training, evaluation. The role suits someone who solves hard problems from first principles and understands why techniques work, not just how to run them.

* Read and reproduce recent research papers, and turn promising ideas into working experiments.

title: LMTS - Lead AI/ML Engineer (LLM Post-Training)
description:
**Description**
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
  
  
This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
  
  
The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
  
  
We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
* Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

* Please be ready to discuss work you personally did. Strong candidates can explain:
* One model-training project they owned end to end: base model, training objective, dataset scale and provenance, compute setup, training recipe, evaluation, production outcome, and what failed.
* One dataset they generated for fine-tuning: source material, generation method, filtering and review, split strategy, known failure modes, and the evidence that it improved the model.
* The actual training method they used, including why it was chosen over alternatives, how they tuned it, and how they knew it improved behavior rather than merely format-following.
* One reasoning, tool-use, preference, or reinforcement-learning dataset they created or used: how correctness was established, how contamination was prevented, and how reward hacking or low-quality traces were detected.
* The exact denominator, dataset split, and review method behind any quality or business-impact metric on their resume.
* A difficult production incident or model-quality regression, how they isolated the cause, and the evidence that confirmed the fix.
* A code sample, design document, experiment report, publication, or other artifact that makes their contribution verifiable. Confidential details may be redacted.
* We do not require a PhD, publications, or prior domain experience. We do require depth, honesty about individual contribution, and the ability to turn claims into technical evidence.

Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future.
  
  
Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you’ll be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Among them, you’ll channel your purpose, bring fresh ideas to the table, and simply be you. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Gemini Agent Platform AI Engineer will help accelerate the adoption of Google Cloud, Gemini and agent-based artificial intelligence technologies across Unilever.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong product engagement dimension. You will partner with product and engineering teams to understand their existing applications and technology landscape, identify opportunities to migrate or modernize solutions onto Google Cloud, and help define and engineer the target solutions.
  
  
Alongside application migration and modernization, you will design and build artificial intelligence and intelligent agent solutions using Google's technology ecosystem. A key part of the role will be developing reusable engineering components, patterns and implementation approaches that can support multiple enterprise use cases.
  
  
You will work across the complete development lifecycle, from discovery and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement, helping teams turn ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable and production-ready solutions.
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative environment where engineers, architects and product teams work together to solve meaningful problems, experiment with emerging technologies and shape how Google and artificial intelligence capabilities are adopted at enterprise scale.
  
  
Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing applications, technical requirements and modernisation needs, and identify appropriate opportunities to adopt Google Cloud technologies.
* Support the migration and modernisation of applications onto Google Cloud, working with product teams and architects to define target architectures and practical engineering approaches.
* Design, develop and deploy artificial intelligence applications and intelligent agent solutions using Google Gemini and Google Cloud technologies.
* Take solutions through the complete engineering lifecycle, from experimentation and technical design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Build reusable components, frameworks and engineering patterns that accelerate future artificial intelligence and Google Cloud implementations.
* Develop integrations between intelligent agents, enterprise applications, application programming interfaces and data sources.
* Design solutions that securely connect artificial intelligence models with trusted enterprise information and services.
* Build and orchestrate workflows involving artificial intelligence models, software tools, business applications and cloud services.
* Evaluate technical approaches based on engineering feasibility, scalability, reliability, security, operational readiness and cost.
* Apply strong software engineering practices across source control, automated testing, deployment automation, version management and release processes.
* Implement appropriate security, identity and access management, monitoring, observability and responsible artificial intelligence practices.
* Evaluate and improve the quality, reliability and technical performance of artificial intelligence and agent-based solutions.
* Work closely with architects, product teams and engineering partners to convert business requirements and early prototypes into production-ready solutions.
* Create clear technical documentation, reusable implementation guidance and engineering standards that enable other teams to adopt proven solutions and patterns.
* Support rapid experimentation and proof-of-concept development while ensuring successful solutions have a clear path towards production and scale

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong software engineering experience with the ability to design, develop and productionise cloud-based applications.
* Hands-on experience designing, developing and deploying solutions on Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, covering solution design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and production operations.
* Experience developing applications using generative artificial intelligence or large language models.
* Understanding of intelligent agent concepts, including tool use, orchestration, grounding and context management.
* Experience with cloud-native application architectures, application programming interfaces and integration patterns.
* Experience with modern software engineering practices, including source control, automated testing, continuous integration and automated deployment.
* Ability to understand existing application architectures and define appropriate approaches for migration and modernisation onto Google Cloud.
* Ability to engage effectively with product, architecture and engineering teams and translate business and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions.
* Ability to take prototypes and early-stage solutions through engineering into secure, scalable, reliable and production-ready solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on development experience with Google Gemini and Vertex AI.
* Experience developing cloud or artificial intelligence solutions using Python.
* Experience with Google technologies and frameworks for building intelligent agents.
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, semantic retrieval and vector search.
* Experience with artificial intelligence evaluation, monitoring, observability and responsible artificial intelligence controls.
* Experience creating reusable artificial intelligence components, engineering frameworks or platform capabilities.
* Experience with application migration and modernisation on Google Cloud.
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, including containers and serverless architectures.
* Experience with enterprise application integration and application programming interfaces.
* Experience working across global, cross-functional product and engineering teams.
* Experience working with external technology or delivery partners.

**Additional Information**

* This role operates with a global scope and will involve close collaboration with product teams, architects, platform teams and engineering partners.
* Success in this role means being equally comfortable in an engineering discussion and in a product conversation. You will need to understand how an application works today, identify how Google technologies can improve or modernize it, translate that into a practical engineering approach, and then help turn that approach into a working solution.
* The role therefore requires more than knowledge of individual Google services. It requires an understanding of how applications are designed, developed, migrated, secured, deployed, operated and continuously improved within an enterprise environment.

**At Unilever, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We**
welcome applicants from all walks of life and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive/succeed. All applicants will receive fair and respectful consideration, and we actively support the growth and development of every employee.
  
  
**Unilever Is An Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Persons With Disabilities.**
**Note:**
All official offers from Unilever are issued only via our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Offers from individuals or unofficial sources may be fraudulent—please verify before proceeding.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**Generative AI Engineer**

**Company:**
IRISS, Inc.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience Required:**
5+ Years

Website: IRISS | YouTube: IRISS

**About IRISS**

IRISS is a global leader in industrial safety and condition-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide.

Headquartered in the United States, with manufacturing operations in Bradenton, Florida, and a global presence across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, IRISS develops innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected.

Our technologies help organizations prevent equipment failures, reduce operational risks, improve reliability, and protect their people.

At the heart of everything we do is our guiding principle:
**We Humanize Safety.**

We are committed to developing advanced, intuitive technologies that empower people and transform how industries approach safety and reliability.

**About the Role**

IRISS is seeking an experienced and innovative
**Generative AI Engineer**
to join our technology team in Bengaluru, India.

This position will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered applications that transform complex enterprise data into meaningful, actionable business insights.

You will help build a conversational analytics platform that enables users to ask questions in natural language and receive accurate, secure, and understandable answers through dashboards, reports, and data visualizations.

Working closely with backend engineers, frontend developers, and technical stakeholders, you will develop AI services involving large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural-language-to-SQL generation, and enterprise data integration.

The ideal candidate has strong Python development skills, practical experience deploying generative AI applications, and a solid understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure and secure, scalable software architecture.

This is a
**hands-on engineering position**
focused on developing production-ready AI applications within a multi-tenant SaaS and IoT environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Generative AI & LLM Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade generative AI applications and conversational analytics solutions.

* Build end-to-end conversational AI workflows involving natural-language understanding, contextual retrieval, SQL generation, query validation, and response generation.

* Integrate commercial and open-source large language models through platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, and Hugging Face.

* Develop and optimize prompts, model orchestration workflows, and AI response validation mechanisms.

* Implement multi-turn conversational experiences with contextual memory and reliable conversation-state management.

* Evaluate AI model performance and improve response accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Data Integration**

* Design and implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge sources.

* Develop contextual retrieval mechanisms that provide accurate, relevant information while maintaining tenant isolation.

* Integrate vector search technologies such as OpenSearch, FAISS, Pinecone, or ChromaDB.

* Build natural-language-to-SQL capabilities that translate business questions into validated database queries.

* Implement safeguards to enforce data-access policies, query restrictions, and enterprise security requirements.

* Collaborate with data engineering and application development teams to integrate AI capabilities with existing systems.

**Python Development & AI Microservices**

* Develop scalable Python-based APIs and AI microservices using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or comparable frameworks.

* Design and maintain modular, secure, and production-ready AI service architectures.

* Integrate AI services with existing backend applications, frontend interfaces, and enterprise analytics platforms.

* Develop automated tests and validation procedures to ensure application quality and reliability.

* Maintain technical documentation, architecture decision records, and development standards.

**AWS Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Deploy, configure, and maintain AI applications and supporting services within AWS environments.

* Work with AWS technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch, Kendra, Lambda, ECS, EC2, S3, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.

* Support containerized application deployment using Docker and established CI/CD pipelines.

* Monitor application performance, infrastructure efficiency, response latency, and operational reliability.

* Identify and implement improvements to scalability, system availability, and infrastructure utilization.

**AI Performance, Security & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop evaluation and monitoring capabilities to measure AI response quality, SQL accuracy, latency, and user feedback.

* Implement security controls that protect enterprise information and enforce multi-tenant data isolation.

* Support responsible AI development through appropriate validation, access controls, and data governance practices.

* Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective improvements.

* Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable AI-driven analytics experiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* **5+ years of overall relevant professional experience**
  , including at least
  **3 years developing and deploying AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, or chatbots**
  .

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Strong hands-on
  **Python development experience**
  , including API or microservice development using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.

* Demonstrated experience integrating
  **large language models (LLMs)**
  using OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Hugging Face, or comparable platforms.

* Practical experience developing
  **retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)**
  solutions using embeddings, vector search, and contextual retrieval pipelines.

* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, model orchestration, AI output validation, and conversational workflows.

* Hands-on experience with AWS services supporting AI applications, such as Bedrock, Kendra, OpenSearch, ECS, Lambda, and CloudWatch.

* Working knowledge of SQL, database query validation, enterprise data security, and multi-tenant architectures.

* Experience with Docker, Git-based CI/CD workflows, and microservice architectures.

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and technical communication skills.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with backend, frontend, data engineering, and product development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience hosting, deploying, or fine-tuning open-source language models.

* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as
  **LangChain, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel**
  .

* Experience developing agent-based AI workflows and advanced conversational applications.

* Experience integrating AI microservices with
  **Angular frontend applications and .NET backend systems**
  .

* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana.

* Knowledge of enterprise data governance, role-based access controls, AI security, and compliance frameworks.

* Experience with AI evaluation methodologies, response-quality monitoring, or automated testing frameworks.

* Contributions to open-source AI projects or experience developing custom LLM integrations.

**Technology Environment**

The successful candidate will work with technologies commonly used in modern generative AI and enterprise application development.

Experience with comparable technologies is welcome; candidates are not expected to have worked with every tool listed.

**Programming Languages & APIs**

* Python 3.10+
* FastAPI
* .NET and Python microservices

**Generative AI & Model Orchestration**

* OpenAI
* Anthropic
* Amazon Bedrock
* Hugging Face
* LangChain
* Haystack
* Semantic Kernel

**Vector Search & Data Retrieval**

* Amazon OpenSearch
* FAISS
* Pinecone
* ChromaDB

**AWS Cloud Infrastructure**

* Amazon Bedrock
* Amazon Kendra
* AWS Lambda
* Amazon ECS and EC2
* Amazon S3
* API Gateway
* Amazon CloudWatch

**Application Development & DevOps**

* Docker
* GitHub Actions
* AWS CDK
* Redis or DynamoDB
* OpenTelemetry

**Frontend & Data Visualization**

* Angular
* Chart.js
* D3.js

**What We're Looking For**

We are seeking a technically strong, hands-on engineer who enjoys building practical AI solutions that solve real business problems.

The successful candidate should be comfortable developing production-ready generative AI applications, working with enterprise data, and integrating AI capabilities into existing software platforms.

You should have a strong understanding of how to balance AI innovation with security, reliability, scalability, and performance.

We value individuals who take ownership of their work, collaborate effectively across technical teams, and continuously look for opportunities to improve the quality and effectiveness of the solutions they develop.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Deliver reliable conversational AI solutions that transform natural-language business questions into accurate, actionable insights.

* Develop secure and scalable RAG pipelines and AI microservices that integrate with enterprise applications.

* Ensure generated SQL queries are validated and comply with established data-access policies.

* Maintain strict tenant isolation and appropriate enterprise security controls.

* Improve AI response accuracy, application performance, reliability, and user experience.

* Deliver measurable improvements in AI-driven analytics and operational decision-making.

**Why Join IRISS?**

At IRISS, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies that improve industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational performance worldwide.

You'll work with modern generative AI technologies and collaborate with engineering teams developing intelligent, connected solutions for industrial environments.

Your contributions will help shape the future of conversational analytics and AI-powered insights within our growing SaaS and IoT technology ecosystem.

We offer a collaborative, innovation-driven environment where technical expertise, problem-solving, and continuous improvement are valued.

**Join IRISS and help us advance our mission: We Humanize Safety.**

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn by submitting an updated resume highlighting their experience in generative AI development, Python programming, LLM integration, RAG architectures, and AWS cloud technologies.

Candidates with experience developing production-ready conversational AI applications, enterprise analytics platforms, or secure multi-tenant SaaS solutions are especially encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Manager, AI Engineer, Intelligence & Data Solutions (IDS)
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Description:
  
  
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
The Intelligence & Data Solutions (IDS) team at VCA consists of data scientists, analysts, and engineers who provide analytics solutions. Their goal is to leverage VisaNet, one of the largest datasets globally, to help clients enhance their performance and increase profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
What an AI Engineer does at Visa:
  
  

* Contribute to end‑to‑end AI/ML and Generative AI projects, helping translate business needs into technical solutions and participating in model design, development, and deployment.
* Advanced Model Development: Design and implement state-of-the-art deep learning architectures, foundation models, and custom GenAI solutions including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning strategies, prompt engineering frameworks, and multi-modal AI systems.
* Platform Engineering: Build and govern production-grade AI platforms with robust LLMOps, AgenticAIOps, and MLOps practices, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and observability across the full ML lifecycle.
* Innovation & Research: Drive R&D initiatives exploring frontier AI technologies including reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-augmented agents, and emergent AI capabilities.
* Quality & Governance: Define and enforce rigorous model validation, testing, monitoring, and governance standards ensuring ethical AI deployment, bias mitigation, explainability, and regulatory compliance.

**Why This Is Important To Visa**
This role is central to shaping how our organization uses AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to transform the way we work. By building AI capabilities that automate and streamline workflows, augment decision-making, and enhance our practices, this role will drive meaningful innovation and improve how we deliver outcomes for our clients and the business.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 10-12+ years of relevant AI/ML experience with demonstrated leadership in delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions.
* Deep expertise in Generative AI, including hands-on experience with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.), prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and production deployment of GenAI applications.
* Proficiency of Agentic AI architectures including multi-agent systems, autonomous reasoning frameworks, tool-use agents, and workflow orchestration platforms (Bedrock, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, etc.).
* Deep Learning experience with across transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, computer vision, NLP, and time-series forecasting with frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX.
* Competency in software languages such as React for integrating AI solutions into applications or visual interfaces.
* Production ML systems experiences such as implementing LLMOps/MLOps best practices, model monitoring, A/B testing, feature stores, model registries, and automated retraining pipelines.
* Experience with Agentic systems latency reduction and also guardrails, prompt injections, red teaming etc.
* Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and commitment to data/model quality.
* Demonstrated interest in learning emerging AI technologies and best practices.
* Previous exposure to financial services or credit card analytics is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software engineering from a top-tier institution.
* Contributions to open-source AI projects or active participation in AI research communities

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:

We are looking for an AI Consultant to help the largest global enterprises get real business value from Artificial Intelligence on AWS, as part of AWS ProServe India LLP ("ProServe India"). In this role, you will design and build Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), generative AI and agentic AI solutions that run on large volumes of enterprise data and solve a wide range of business problems.
  
  
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building ML and DL models and agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool use and agent frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
