Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand the internal customer’s business need and guide them to a solution using our AWS AI Services, AWS AI Platforms, AWS AI Frameworks, and AWS AI EC2 Instances .

description:
**A.P. Moller - Maersk**
A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs c. 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains.
  
  
**Job Role**
AI/ML Platform Engineering focuses on building scalable engineering platforms, infrastructure, automation, and operational capabilities that enable AI and Machine Learning teams to develop, deploy, integrate, monitor, and operate AI/ML solutions efficiently and securely. AI/ML platforms provide standardized tools and services for model lifecycle management, MLOps, model serving, Generative AI, LLM applications, agentic AI, experimentation, deployment, observability, and governance. AI/ML Platform Engineering combines cloud infrastructure, software engineering, DevOps, MLOps, Kubernetes, automation, and AI technologies to create reliable and self-service platforms that accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
  
  
Data AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) Engineering involves the use of algorithms and statistical models to enable systems to analyze data, learn patterns, and make data-driven predictions or decisions without explicit human programming. AI/ML applications leverage vast amounts of data to identify insights, automate processes, and solve complex problems across a wide range of fields, including healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and more. AI/ML processes transform raw data into actionable intelligence, enabling automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent solutions. title: Member of Technical Staff, Cekura (Bangalore, In-Person)
description:
Read This First
  
  
We work with unusual intensity: in-person in Bangalore, six days a week, long days, most weekends. That's how we've chosen to build, because in our market speed decides who wins. We say this up front because we want people who feel pulled in, not talked into it. If you want a 9-to-5 (no judgment), this isn't your role.
  
  
**What You Get In Exchange**

* Top-of-market cash. Extraordinary hours deserve more than an average salary.
* Meaningful equity. Significant grants, employee-friendly terms, and liquidity opportunities as we raise.
* No commute tax. Support to live near the office, plus dinner there every night.
* Founders in the trenches. We work the same schedule we ask of you.
* A decade of growth in two years. You'll ship more and own more than anywhere else.

**About Cekura**
Cekura (YC F24) builds evals and improvement for voice AI, covering both voice agents and the speech-to-speech models behind them.
  
  

* Voice agents. Teams test before launch, monitor production calls, and improve continuously. When something fails, Cekura reproduces it in simulation, fixes it, tests the fix, and raises a PR. The platform covers simulation, LLM evaluation, red-teaming, drift monitoring, and benchmarking across Vapi, Retell, Pipecat, LiveKit, ElevenLabs and more.
* Speech-to-speech models. We give labs benchmarks, data, and RL environments to improve turn-taking, interruptions, naturalness, and tool use in live conversations.

Customers include Five9, HighLevel, Twin Health, PwC, Deloitte, Jobber, and Jotform. HIPAA, SOC 2, and GDPR are defaults. We're growing fast and backed by top investors.
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll build the core of Cekura: simulation engines, evaluation systems, benchmarks, RL environments, self-improvement loops, and observability pipelines. We don't split "software engineer" from "AI engineer." The best problems sit where real-time voice infrastructure, LLM evaluation, RL training, and speech analysis meet.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Simulation engine. Simulate thousands of realistic conversations across voice, chat, and phone, with control over personas, interruptions, noise, and edge cases.
* Agent evaluation. Build LLM evaluators, metrics, red-teaming, drift detection, and the autonomous loop that detects, reproduces, fixes, tests, and ships a PR.
* Speech-to-speech research. Work with labs to find where models fall short of human conversation, then build the benchmarks, datasets, reward signals, and RL environments that close the gap.
* Applied audio. Turn the paralinguistic layer (emotion, tone, silences, hesitations, overlaps) into structured signals, so models are judged on how things are said, not just what.
* Real-time voice infra. SIP, WebRTC, STT/TTS, Twilio, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat. Latency and barge-in are first-class problems.
* Ship end-to-end and shape the team. Own what you build from design to production, and set the standards a growing team inherits.

**About You**

* A strong generalist who wants to work across systems and AI, not stay in one lane.
* A strong coder in Python, TypeScript, or Go, with experience in distributed systems, real-time infra, LLM products, or model training and evaluation.
* You've run production systems and care about reliability, latency, and correctness.
* Sharp instincts about where LLMs and speech models fail, and how to build reliable systems on them.
* You like ambiguity, move fast, communicate clearly, and raise the bar around you.
* You read the first section twice and you're still here.
* Bonus: ex-founder or aspiring one.

Nice to Have
  
  

* LLM evals, agent frameworks, or AI observability.
* Voice AI stack experience (Twilio, SIP, WebRTC, Vapi, Retell, LiveKit, Pipecat, STT/TTS).
* RL for language or speech models, benchmark building, or speech-to-speech models.
* Early-stage startup experience or open-source work.

This Is Not for You If
  
  

* You want a narrow role, a fixed stack, or to work only on models or only on infra.
* You need rigid process or heavy structure.
* You're optimizing for work-life balance right now.
* You don't want to work in-person in Bangalore.

Why Cekura
  
  

* The hardest problems in voice AI, worked on alongside the labs building the models.
* A 12-person engineering team post-seed: early enough to matter, funded enough to move fast.
* Direct work with founders and a highly technical team.
* Top-of-market pay, meaningful equity, all meals at the office, and relocation support.

title: LMTS - Lead AI/ML Engineer (LLM Post-Training)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Software Engineering
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
  
  
This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
  
  
The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
  
  
We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows.
* Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run.
* Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases.
* Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking.
* Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal.
* Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis.
* Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action.
* Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow.
* Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability.
* Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior.
* Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility.
* Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle.
* Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material.
* Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized.
* Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems.
* Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems.
* Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify.
* Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs.
* Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer behavior, sequence packing, loss masking, optimizer and learning-rate schedules, checkpointing, distributed or memory-efficient training, and inference tradeoffs.
* Experience creating and evaluating reasoning, tool-use, or structured-output training data. You understand the difference between a plausible trace and a correct, useful outcome, and know how low-quality traces degrade a model.
* Experience with model evaluation: held-out datasets, error taxonomy, task and quality metrics, experiment design, ablation studies, regression analysis, and human-review workflows.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, debugging, observability, version control, and clear technical writing.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous failures across model behavior, data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and backend services.
* Demonstrated leadership in architecture, design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring engineers.
* Comfortable working across application and ML layers instead of staying within a narrow specialty.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building integrations with enterprise platforms, APIs, data systems, identity controls, or tool-using AI applications.
* Experience with complex enterprise workflows, such as CRM, commerce, finance, service, supply chain, or regulated-industry systems.
* Deep experience with preference optimization or reinforcement-learning methods for LLMs, such as DPO, ORPO, GRPO, PPO, or verifiable-reward training. Candidates must be able to explain the reward/preference data, training stability, and failure modes, not just name a framework.
* Resource-constrained or distributed model training and inference, including PyTorch, Transformers, TRL, Accelerate, DeepSpeed, FSDP, vLLM, GPU optimization, or quantized model serving.
* Retrieval systems, source provenance, and retrieval evaluation. Retrieval experience is useful, but candidates must understand that retrieval is context, not a substitute for model training or model evaluation.
* Security and data-governance work involving sensitive enterprise data, access scopes, auditability, and human approval boundaries.
* Experience taking an AI feature from experiment through a measured, monitored production release.

**What We Will Ask You To Show**

* Please be ready to discuss work you personally did. Strong candidates can explain:
* One model-training project they owned end to end: base model, training objective, dataset scale and provenance, compute setup, training recipe, evaluation, production outcome, and what failed.
* One dataset they generated for fine-tuning: source material, generation method, filtering and review, split strategy, known failure modes, and the evidence that it improved the model.
* The actual training method they used, including why it was chosen over alternatives, how they tuned it, and how they knew it improved behavior rather than merely format-following.
* One reasoning, tool-use, preference, or reinforcement-learning dataset they created or used: how correctness was established, how contamination was prevented, and how reward hacking or low-quality traces were detected.
* The exact denominator, dataset split, and review method behind any quality or business-impact metric on their resume.
* A difficult production incident or model-quality regression, how they isolated the cause, and the evidence that confirmed the fix.
* A code sample, design document, experiment report, publication, or other artifact that makes their contribution verifiable. Confidential details may be redacted.
* We do not require a PhD, publications, or prior domain experience. We do require depth, honesty about individual contribution, and the ability to turn claims into technical evidence.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Founding AI Engineer
description:
**About TRADL AI**
TRADL AI is building India's first AI trading co-pilot for 100M+ traders.
  
  
Today, we convert natural language into verified, code-backed stock intelligence - no hallucinations, no black boxes. Tomorrow, we're building the full stack: real-time chart intelligence, autonomous research agents, and portfolio-aware execution. We're turning what institutional desks spend millions on into a conversation anyone can have. We're live, growing fast, and the hardest technical problems are still ahead of us.
  
  
Our tech stack spans real-time market data ingestion (Kafka + TimescaleDB processing millions of ticks/day), AI/ML infrastructure (custom LLM orchestration + quant computation engines), a React/Next.js web platform, and native mobile apps - all built for sub-100ms latency because in trading, milliseconds matter.
  
  
We are building the engineering team that will scale this from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of concurrent traders.
  
  
**Why this Role exists**
TRADL's core moat is the intelligence layer - the system that takes a natural language trading query, understands intent, decomposes it into quantitative operations, generates executable Python code, and returns mathematically precise results against live market data. Today this works. But it needs to work 100x better: faster inference, richer reasoning chains, multi-step agent workflows, and eventually autonomous execution.
  
  
The Founding AI Engineer owns the entire AI/ML stack and is the technical co-architect alongside our CTO.
  
  
**What You'll Own**- LLM Orchestration: Own the pipeline converting natural language → executable quant code. Architect self-hosted models, fine-tuning, and hybrid routing
- Hallucination Elimination: Build the verification layer ensuring every AI result is mathematically deterministic. Our deepest IP.
- AI-Charts Engine: Real-time AI overlays - automated pattern recognition, predictive annotations, support/resistance. Scale from static to streaming intelligence.
- FundAgent: Design the autonomous trading agent: multi-step reasoning, portfolio-aware decisions, risk-bounded execution.
Model Infrastructure: GPU compute strategy, model versioning, A/B testing, latency optimization (- Research → Production Pipeline: Turn academic research into production features. Bridge the Jupyter notebook → live market execution gap.
**What We're Looking For**

* 5-8 years in ML/AI engineering with at least 2 years working with LLMs in production (actual deployed systems handling real user queries).
* Deep understanding of LLM internals: tokenization, attention mechanisms, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, function calling, and code generation patterns.
* Production experience with model serving: latency optimization, batching strategies, model routing, and cost management across multiple LLM providers.
* Strong Python: You'll be writing the code that generates code. Meta-programming, AST manipulation, and sandboxed execution are daily concerns.
* Familiarity with financial data structures is strongly preferred: OHLCV, option chains, Greeks, order books. You don't need to be a quant, but you need to understand what the generated code is computing.
* Experience building agent/agentic systems: tool use, multi-step planning, state management, error recovery.

**Bonus Points**

* Published research or open-source contributions in NLP, code generation, or financial AI.
* Experience with quantitative finance: backtesting frameworks, risk models, signal generation.
* Rust or C++ for performance-critical components.

* Architect & Deliver End-to-End Solutions: Design, prototype, benchmark, and deploy enterprise-grade Agentic systems, multi-stage RAG pipelines, and fine-tuned Foundation/Small Language Model (LLM/SLM) architectures to solve complex business problems.
* Lead AI Engineering & Productionization: Implement modern LLMOps/GenAIOps standards, including prompt orchestration, deterministic guardrails, structured outputs, automated red-teaming, latency/token-cost optimization, and continuous evaluation (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge).
* Execute High-Impact Fine-Tuning & Quantization: Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA), alignment tuning (DPO, RLHF), and model quantization/distillation for downstream domain specialization and edge/on-premise inference.
* Drive Client Advisory & Executive Communication: Partner with cross-functional global stakeholders, translate complex algorithmic decisions into measurable business impact (ROI, cost-per-query, latency budgets), and deliver compelling technical presentations to C-suite leadership.
* Practice Growth & Technical Evangelism: Lead technical proposals (RFPs/POCs), formulate point-of-view (PoV) whitepapers, explore emerging frontier models and open-source tooling, and continuously enhance internal IP, reference architectures, and reusable accelerators.
* Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Foster engineering excellence by conducting rigorous code/design reviews, guiding junior scientists on applied ML/GenAI methodologies, and enforcing reproducible data science standards.

What We Are Looking For
  
  
You are an applied AI practitioner and pragmatic engineer who thrives on turning raw research and frontier models into secure, reliable software systems. You balance algorithmic depth with system architecture, understand the operational bottlenecks and scaling best practices and are able to own technical delivery at scale end to end.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, paired with 4+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, deep learning, and advanced NLP/GenAI in an enterprise or consulting environment.
* GenAI & Agentic Architectures: Deep hands-on experience building autonomous agents and complex multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) using tool-calling, stateful memory, and routing graphs.
* Advanced RAG & Retrieval Systems: Demonstrated expertise implementing hybrid search pipelines (dense vectors + sparse BM25), semantic routing, contextual compression, reranking models (e.g., Cohere, BGE), and production vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Fine-Tuning & Model Adaptation: Practical experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs/SLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) using PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA, DeepSpeed, or Unsloth, paired with robust knowledge of post-training evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, TruLens).
* Software Engineering & APIs: Strong proficiency in Python, modern asynchronous web frameworks (FastAPI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and designing secure, low-latency REST/gRPC endpoints.
* Cloud & Distributed Computing: Hands-on experience architecting ML/AI workloads on at least one major cloud platform (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/ML, or GCP Vertex AI).

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
The Elastic IT team is moving beyond simple chat to the next frontier: Agentic Workflows and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Systems. We are looking for an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to join our team. You will build multi-agent ecosystems that are self-directed. These ecosystems will do more than just answer questions. They will collaborate, delegate tasks, and execute complex business processes across the organization.
  
  
In this role, you will focus on large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration, and A2A integration frameworks to power our intelligent workforce. You will create workflows for multiple agents instead of just focusing on single-agent search or managing the stack. These workflows will enable the agents to communicate with each other, share information, access enterprise tools, and automate tasks from start to finish. Driven by a service-oriented mindset, you will empower internal teams with cutting-edge LLM capabilities while integrating seamlessly with enterprise systems.
  
  
Are you ready to build the next generation of LLM-powered multi-agent systems that supercharge enterprise productivity? Join us to enable agent-to-agent workflows that turn collective knowledge into instant, coordinated action across Elastic.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* A2A Architecture & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Design, build, and deploy agent-to-agent (A2A) communication architectures and workflows that enable autonomous agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, and negotiate multi-step business processes.
* LLM Integration & Tool Calling: Integrate advanced LLMs, both proprietary and open-source, with enterprise APIs. Use tool-calling methods. Connect with third-party SaaS applications for smooth operations.
* Enterprise Grounding & RAG: Use advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Implement strategies that connect enterprise context by using search and vector storage engines. This will ensure that all inter-agent operations are highly accurate and reliable.
* Scalable Infrastructure & IaC: Provision and manage robust cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Terraform to support the high-concurrency demands of LLM inferences and multi-agent coordination.
* DevOps & Lifecycle Management: Support modern DevOps practices. This includes creating CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and versioning. You will also evaluate LLMs and agentic workflows regularly.
* A2A Security & Governance: Apply strict security and network fundamentals (VPC configurations, secure API gateways, encryption, and IAM controls) to secure inter-agent communication and protect sensitive enterprise data.
* LLM Observability & Evaluation: Create systems to monitor how multiple agents interact. These systems will help us check model accuracy. They will also help manage token spending and identify model drift or agent loops.
* Documentation: Keep detailed technical documents for LLM integration protocols. This includes A2A interaction flows and cloud infrastructure deployments.

**What You Bring:**

* Experience with AI-assisted development, code review, test generation, working through unfamiliar code, drafting specifications, summarizing incidents, and accelerating research.
* Experience in shipping features covering full stack from design, build, test and deploy across the stack from database and portal through APIs, backend services, and the data pipeline.
* LLM & GenAI Expertise: Deep experience integrating, fine-tuning, and optimizing foundation models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models), including expertise in prompt engineering, tool calling, and structured outputs.
* Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocols: Proven success building multi-agent systems, inter-agent messaging pipelines, state management frameworks, and dynamic task delegation protocols.
* Agentic Frameworks: Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, etc. along with tracing platforms like LangSmith.
* Market Trends & Interoperability: Strong understanding of emerging AI interoperability standards, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and open multi-agent communication specifications.
* Programming: Contribute production code to our product code base using ReactJS / NodeJS/Java/Spring, our Kotlin Multiplatform SDK and its native layers, Angular/TypeScript Portal and JavaScript Web SDK, NoSQL data modeling, streaming and messaging/queueing technologies.
* Enterprise Grounding & Vector Search: Practical knowledge of RAG patterns, vector databases, hybrid search architectures, and context management strategies.
* DevOps & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience with DevOps practices and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes for scalable AI deployments.
* Security & Network Fundamentals: Strong knowledge of secure cloud architectures, zero-trust network design, private endpoints, and identity management (OAuth, SAML, IAM) for secure A2A interactions.
* LLM Observability & Evaluation: Experience setting up observability frameworks (logging, distributed tracing, and metrics) to track non-deterministic multi-agent workflows, token costs, and LLM output quality.
* Enterprise AI Platform Knowledge: Knowledge of the broader agentic and workflow landscape (e.g., Workday A2A, Salesforce Agentforce, ServiceNow AI Agents).

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

**Security & Privacy Responsibilities:**
Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.
  
  
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer, Autonomous Pentesting**

**About Astra:**

Astra Security is a leader in the penetration testing space, recognized by G2 in the Pentest category. With headquarters in the US & India, Astra is the trusted security partner for leading brands including Muthoot Finance, Loom, CompTIA, NIIT, Goldcast, HackerRank, Sprinto, ITC & more. Its one-of-a-kind continuous pentest platform is trusted by 1,200+ companies across 100+ countries, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 100 giants.

Astra's autonomous pentest platform pairs AI agents with certified human pentesters to continuously pentest applications and infrastructure at scale. Vulnerabilities are discovered, validated, and chained the way a real attacker would. Beyond pentesting, Astra's suite includes a DAST Scanner, Cloud Vulnerability Scanner, and API Security Platform, giving teams continuous coverage across web apps, cloud environments, and APIs from a single dashboard. With over 18,000 vulnerabilities detected daily, Astra helps customers prevent millions in potential losses while saving thousands of developer hours. Last year alone, Astra uncovered more than 6.8 million vulnerabilities for its customers.

Astra's research team actively contributes to the OWASP community, including helping shape the OWASP Autonomous Penetration Testing Standard (APTS) and contributing to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Security Risks. Astra is CREST-accredited, CERT-IN empaneled, and a PCI ASV, reflecting its commitment to the highest standards of security testing.

We've been awarded by the President of France Mr. François Hollande at the La French Tech program and Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox etc. are a few of Astra’s customers.

**Why this role exists**

A frontier model on its own is not a pentester. What turns a model into a capability you can run against a customer's app every day, and at scale, is the harness around it: how you feed it the target, scaffold its reasoning, give it tools, orchestrate cheap models against expensive ones, score what it produces, and stop it from shipping garbage. That harness is our core IP and our main lever on accuracy, coverage, and cost. You will own it.

**What you'll do**

* Build and productionize harnesses for autonomous pentesting across web, API, mobile, cloud, and more, taking each from a working prototype to something reliable against real customer targets.
* Orchestrate models against each other: use frontier models as the source of intelligence, then distill that into cheaper open-weight models so we can run at scale economically.
* Own evaluation. Define what a true finding is, measure recall and precision against ground truth, penalize false positives hard, normalize for cost, and control for run-to-run variance. If it is not measured, it does not ship.
* Push accuracy and coverage up, and cost and latency down, release over release.
* Build the guardrails that keep a hallucinated finding from ever reaching a customer, because one false critical costs more trust than ten real findings earn.
* Work shoulder to shoulder with our pentesters and researchers: turn their judgment into harness logic, and build tools that make them faster.

**What we're looking for**

* An engineer who ships. You write clean, scalable, flexible code, get a working slice out fast, then harden it. Prototypes that never reach production are not the job.
* Real LLM engineering: prompting and scaffolding, tool use and agents, orchestration across models, retrieval and context management, and a feel for where models break.
* Enough security depth to judge the output. You do not need to be a career pentester, but you must look at a finding and tell real from plausible-but-wrong, and reason about severity. Slop resistance is a core skill here.
* Evaluation rigor. You think in ground truth, baselines, false-positive rates, and cost per true finding, not vibes.
* Production instincts: observability, cost control, reliability, and the discipline to measure before and after every change.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on pentesting or offensive security across web, API, mobile, or cloud, CTF, or vulnerability research.
* Serving or fine-tuning open-weight models, or running them cheaply at scale.
* Mobile (Android or iOS) security, static and dynamic analysis, or reverse engineering.
* A track record of turning a messy research idea into something that shipped.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
**Company:**

Trench Legal

**Location:**

India (100% Remote)

**Employment Type:**

Full-time (via Employer of Record)

**Experience:**

3+ years

**Compensation:**

₹25–30 LPA, depending on experience and skills

**About Trench Legal**

Trench Legal is an early-stage U.S. legal technology startup built by founders from Google, Amazon and LinkedIn to help law firms automate document-heavy workflows and run the operational side of their firms. We are VC-backed and have raised 5 million in funding overall. We are growing fast and our revenue is increasing 80% MoM.

Law firms handle thousands of pages of medical records, bills, and other case documents. Processing these documents and turning them into accurate, useful information is often time-consuming and manual.

We're building a platform that automates much of this work, including:

* **Document intelligence:**

  Extracting structured information from medical records, bills, and legal documents.
* **Medical chronologies:**

  Organizing treatments, diagnoses, procedures, and events into accurate case timelines.
* **AI case chat:**

  Answering questions across large collections of documents with verifiable source citations.
* **Document generation:**

  Producing evidence-backed drafts and demand letters.
* **Workflow automation:**

  Supporting medical record retrieval and other legal processes.

We have an existing product and codebase and are looking for an engineer to help improve our AI capabilities, strengthen our backend infrastructure, and build reliable data pipelines.

**About the Role**

We're hiring an
**Applied AI Engineer**

who enjoys building practical AI applications and solving challenging software engineering problems.

You'll work directly with our technical founder to develop AI features, improve document processing, and build the infrastructure that connects unstructured data to useful product capabilities.

This is a hands-on engineering position focused on
**building and deploying production AI systems**

, rather than training machine learning models from scratch.

As an early engineering hire, you'll have meaningful ownership over your work, contribute to technical decisions, and help shape the product as the company grows.

**What You'll Do**

AI Features & Document Intelligence

* Build and improve LLM-powered document extraction, case question-answering, medical timelines, and document generation.
* Develop pipelines to ingest, parse, classify, and extract information from PDFs, scanned records, medical bills, and other documents.
* Extract, normalize, and reconcile structured information such as dates, providers, diagnoses, procedures, treatments, and billing amounts.
* Improve structured outputs, validation, and extraction consistency.
* Create multi-step agents that can perform long tasks reliably

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

* Improve document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, search, and retrieval.
* Develop source-grounded AI responses with accurate document and page citations.
* Reduce unsupported model outputs and improve answer reliability.
* Optimize retrieval accuracy, latency, and LLM usage costs.

Backend Engineering & Data Pipelines

* Develop and maintain Python APIs, backend services, and data-processing workflows.
* Build reliable asynchronous processing with queues, retries, deduplication, and error handling.
* Extend PostgreSQL schemas, APIs, and integrations within our existing product.
* Debug production issues and improve performance, monitoring, and maintainability.
* Implement appropriate safeguards for handling sensitive information.

AI Evaluation & Quality

* Create evaluation datasets and automated tests for AI features.
* Measure extraction accuracy, completeness, citation quality, latency, and cost.
* Investigate AI failures and improve pipelines based on measurable results.
* Build validation and quality-control mechanisms for complex documents.

**What We're Looking For**

Required Qualifications

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Contractual for 1 Year)**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the technical architecture for agentic AI workflows across the Market Risk function: agent orchestration patterns, multi-agent coordination, tool/permission design, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Set the evaluation and governance framework: define what "production-ready" means for an agent handling risk data, including accuracy thresholds, red-teaming for prompt injection and jailbreaks, and continuous monitoring standards.
* Lead model risk and regulatory engagement — partnering with Model Risk Management, Compliance, and Internal Audit to get agentic systems validated and approved for use in regulatory-adjacent workflows (e.g., VaR backtesting exception analysis, regulatory report drafting, RWA/limit reconciliation).
* Design fallback, escalation, and kill-switch mechanisms so that any agent making or influencing a risk decision has a clear, auditable human checkpoint and can be safely disabled.
* Architect multi-agent systems (e.g., a supervisor agent delegating to specialist sub-agents for data retrieval, calculation checks, narrative generation, and anomaly flagging) with attention to cost, latency, reliability, and failure isolation.
* Mentor a team of AI engineers/analysts, review their designs, prompts, and evaluation results; set engineering and documentation standards.
* Own the vendor and platform strategy: evaluate build-vs-buy decisions across LLM providers, agent frameworks, and enterprise AI platforms, factoring in data residency, security, and cost.
* Partner directly with senior Market Risk stakeholders to identify high-value automation candidates (e.g., daily risk commentary, limit exception triage, ad-hoc scenario analysis, regulatory query response) and prioritize a roadmap.
* Define cost governance for LLM usage (token budgets, model selection by task complexity) at a portfolio level, not just per-workflow.
* Represent the function to senior management and, where relevant, to regulators, on how AI is being used responsibly within risk processes.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Demonstrated ownership of agentic or LLM-based systems in production, not just prototypes — including having handled real incidents (hallucination, drift, cost overrun, or a failed evaluation gate) and the process improvements that followed.
* Deep, practical fluency with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) and with designing multi-agent systems, not just single-agent chat flows.
* Experience designing RAG and knowledge-grounding architectures at scale, including retrieval quality tuning, source attribution, and strategies to minimize hallucination on factual/numeric outputs.
* Working knowledge of the regulatory and model-risk landscape for AI in banking (e.g., how model validation frameworks are being adapted for generative/agentic AI; explainability expectations; data governance).
* Proven ability to architect for reliability and cost — caching, model routing (using smaller/cheaper models for simple sub-tasks), token budgeting, and latency management in multi-step agent chains.
* Solid software engineering foundation: API design, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), CI/CD for prompt/agent versioning, and observability tooling for non-deterministic systems. People leadership experience — able to set technical direction for and review the work of less experienced AI engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management — able to translate agentic AI capability and risk in language that resonates with senior risk managers, compliance, and technology leadership. Awareness of responsible-AI concepts relevant to finance: hallucination risk, data leakage, model explainability, and the need for human oversight in high-stakes decisions.
* Substantive market risk domain expertise — VaR methodologies, sensitivities/Greeks, stress testing, limit frameworks, regulatory capital (FRTB, SIMM) — gained through direct experience in a market risk function.
* FRM (Part I & II), PRM, CQF, or CFA — as evidence of quantitative risk fluency, thoughd irect experience can substitute.

title: Salesforce Agentic AI Engineer
description:
Agent force and Data 360 Engineer (Salesforce Agentic AI Engineer)

**Project**

Enterprise Agentic AI Assistant

**Experience**

2 to 3 years overall, with hands-on Agentforce work

**Profile**

Salesforce Agent force and Data 360 specialist with broader agentic AI engineering skills

**About the project**

The project is an enterprise agentic chat assistant built with Salesforce Agentforce. It uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer user questions from a large library of enterprise documents, cites its sources, and declines when the documents do not support an answer.

The agent also calls tools and APIs to fetch context and complete tasks, and works alongside other agents. We want an engineer who can deliver this on Salesforce and is open to working with the wider agentic AI stack.

**The role**

You will be the hands-on Salesforce AI engineer on a small team of architects and data, integration and platform engineers. You will design and build grounded, retrieval-based agents on Agentforce and Data 360, connect them to non-Salesforce systems, and show the customer that the answers are accurate, cited and safe.

**What you will do**

Build and improve Agentforce agents, including their topics, instructions and actions.

Set up Data 360 so the agent can search documents and answer with citations.

Connect the agent to other systems through APIs and tools.

Test answer quality and work with the wider team to deliver and demo the solution.

**Must-have skills**

Hands-on Agentforce delivery (production or an advanced pilot), including agent design, actions and Agent Script or prompt templates.

Hands-on Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud) experience, ideally with unstructured data, search indexes and retrievers used to ground agent answers.

Solid Salesforce development: Apex, Flow, permission sets, sandboxes and deployment.

Working knowledge of RAG: chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, metadata filtering, citations and reducing hallucinations.

Clear communication with customer architects and business stakeholders.

**Good to have**

These strengthen a profile but are not all required. A strong agentic AI engineer who can show real Agentforce and Data 360 work is a good fit even without every item.

Salesforce Development: Apex, LWC, SOQL, Flows, and APIs

Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer (certified): the ideal profile for this role.

Salesforce certifications or Trailhead Academy training in Agentforce and Data 360 (for example Agentforce Specialist or Data 360 Consultant), backed by a Trailhead profile or completion record.

Exposure to building agentic AI with tool-calling, multi-agent patterns, Python or LLM evaluation

Experience building knowledge assistants or customer support agents

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Neva

Neva Technologies builds AI tools and engineering support for the US construction industry. Our first customer is a US general contractor doing ~$250M a year in work. We are early stage, and building the first versions of our products directly against their real data: submittals, drawings, estimates, pay applications, and project files.

What you'll do

You will be an early engineer. You take a workflow from a project manager or estimator, rapidly build a custom AI tool from it, ship it, and keep it running. Each build has a user, a dataset, and a number that tells us whether it worked. The first few on the list:

* A cost-estimating tool that reads historical project data and a new set of plans and produces a rough budget with its assumptions stated.
* A pay-application checker that compares a subcontractor's monthly invoice against the schedule of values, prior invoices, lien waivers, and stored-material backup, and returns a discrepancy list.
* Be comfortable working with parallel teams building physical AI applications (~12 months after start).
* Claude skills and plugins that package our customer's working rules so every team gets the same result.
* Integrations with the tools contractors already use: Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft 365.

You will talk directly to the people who use what you build, including the customer's executives, and you will be expected to tell them what the tool gets wrong.

Must have

* 3+ years building software, with Python as your main language and enough full-stack experience to ship a small web app on your own.
* Have shipped an LLM-backed tool to real users, including tool use or agents, and kept it running afterward.
* Can extract and structure data from PDFs, drawings, and messy spreadsheets.
* Build evaluations as a habit: a test set and a number, not "it looked right."
* Can deploy and operate what you build: cloud hosting, scheduled jobs, logging, and fixing it when it breaks.
* Have worked against third-party APIs and can judge whether an outside AI tool is good enough to use.
* Can explain what you built, and its limits, to a non-technical person.

Nice to have

* Construction, civil engineering, or AEC software exposure (Procore, Bluebeam, Revit).
* Experience as a forward-deployed or customer-facing engineer.
* Team management and hiring experience
* Comfortable living in Excel.

What you get

* You set the engineering bar for a team that will grow around you in 2027.
* Your work goes into production for a real US contractor within weeks, not quarters.
* Direct exposure to how an AI consulting and product business gets built from the first customer onward.

title: Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer
description:
**HRS As a Company**
HRS, a pioneer in business travel, aims to elevate every stay through innovative technology. With over 50 years of experience, their digital platform, driven by ProcureTech, TravelTech, and FinTech, transforms how companies and travelers Stay, Work, and Pay.
  
  
ProcureTech digitally revolutionizes lodging procurement, connecting corporations and suppliers in a cutting-edge ecosystem. This enables seamless efficiency and automation, surpassing travelers' expectations.
  
  
TravelTech redefines the online lodging experience, offering personalized content from selection to check-in, ensuring an unparalleled journey for corporate travelers.
  
  
In FinTech, HRS introduces advancements like mobile banking and digital payments, turning corporate back offices into touchless lodging enablers, eliminating legacy cost barriers. The innovative 2-click book-to-pay feature streamlines interactions for travelers and hoteliers.
  
  
Combining these technology propositions, HRS unlocks exponential catalyst effects. Their data-driven focus delivers value-added services and high-return network effects, creating substantial customer value.
  
  
HRS's exponential growth since 1972 serves over 35% of the global Fortune 500 and leading hotel chains.
  
  
Join HRS to shape the future of business travel, empowered by a culture of growth and setting new industry standards worldwide.
  
  
**BUSINESS UNIT**
You'll join HRS's Product & IT organization, in the team that builds the AI agent layer for our global sales organization. Our goal: give Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Learning & Development, and leadership teams trusted AI agents that work directly inside the tools they use every day, such as our CRM, Microsoft 365, and our data platforms. The foundation is already in place. A central AI gateway on AWS gives every agent secure, audited access to approved AI models, and a dedicated platform engineer builds and maintains the secure connections into our core business systems. That lets you concentrate on building agents that solve real business problems for our teams worldwide. We are deliberately not a single-vendor shop: we build on Microsoft Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, and other cloud-native agentic workflow engines, with the platform for each use case selected based on the agent capabilities it requires.
  
  
**POSITION**
As Senior Agentic Workflow Engineer (all genders), you are the lead architect and builder of HRS's growing portfolio of AI agents and agentic workflows. You define the multi-agent architecture and the development standards the team follows across platforms, and personally drive the delivery of production-grade agents that account executives, sales operations managers, and customer success teams use every day — in Microsoft Teams and beyond.
  
  
Our central AI gateway connects agents to approved AI models, and our platform engineer (a separate role) owns the detailed technical integrations into Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, and our other data systems. That leaves your focus on what makes agents valuable: design, orchestration, quality, and scale. You will mentor the mid-level engineer, set the technical bar, and make sure every agent ships as a reliable, well-governed product, whichever platform it runs on.
  
  
**CHALLENGE**

* Architecture and delivery standards: Define the platform-agnostic multi-agent topology, conversation and workflow design principles, naming conventions, guardrail patterns, and release standards the team follows across all engines.
* Multi-agent framework: Design the orchestrator and sub-agent structure, handoff protocols, context passing, and fallback behaviors, including cross-platform communication via open standards like MCP and A2A.
* New use cases: Lead design and delivery of agents for pipeline queries, opportunity stage updates, forecasts, opportunity creation, approval workflows, and AI-generated content across a growing sales and customer-facing backlog.
* Enterprise data access: Partner with the platform engineer to define tool, API, and connector contracts for Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint, OneDrive, SAP, Clay, AWS data products, and internal APIs. Enforce governed interfaces only: no direct database access, no free-form SQL, no plaintext credentials.
* Guardrail framework: Define and implement RBAC, DLP controls, prompt-injection defenses, output validation, and audit logging standards for every agent on every platform.
* Release management: Own versioning, regression testing, and staged rollout to production, including human approval gates for write-back actions, and sign off on every production promotion.
* Mentoring: Guide the mid-level engineer through architecture advice, reviews, and structured onboarding, building a team that delivers independently.
* Stakeholder translation: Work with sales and sales operations to scope use cases, define acceptance criteria, and manage delivery expectations.

**FOR THIS EXCITING MISSION YOU ARE EQUIPPED WITH**

* Experience: Typically 7+ years in software, automation, or integration engineering, with a track record of shipping AI agents or agentic workflows that real users rely on in production.
* Agent platforms: Proven experience deploying production agents, including multi-agent orchestrator/sub-agent architectures, on at least one agentic engine (e.g. Copilot Studio, n8n, Dify, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock Agents, LangGraph). Production experience on multiple platforms is a strong plus.
* M-shaped profile: Deep agentic engineering expertise plus broad knowledge of enterprise systems such as CRM (e.g. Dynamics 365), ERP (e.g. SAP), Microsoft 365, and cloud data platforms.
* Agentic AI patterns: Deep understanding of orchestrator/sub-agent design, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, MCP, agent memory, and evaluation.
* Platform judgment: Clear view of each platform's strengths and limits, designing every agent to make the most of where it runs.
* API fluency: Confident with REST, JSON, webhooks, and OAuth 2.0 / service principals; consumes APIs, connectors, and MCP servers and specifies precisely what agents need from the platform team.
* Governance: Solid knowledge of identity and RBAC (e.g. Entra ID), DLP, secrets management, environment and solution lifecycle, and CI/CD for agents.
* Compliance: Understanding of GDPR and EU data residency for agent data handling.
* Mentoring: Proven ability to coach engineers and uphold quality standards across a team.
* Design and documentation: Strong skills in architecture decision records, conversation and workflow specs, and runbooks.
* Certifications (a plus): Microsoft PL-400 or AI-102, AWS, or platform-specific equivalents.
* Communication: Fluent English, verbal and written, able to lead discussions with technical and business stakeholders.

title: AI Researcher: Reasoning & Retrieval
description:
**About Auric AI**

**We're building a reasoning system over millions of messy, multilingual intelligence documents, and it has to run entirely inside India, on infrastructure we control.**

No fine-tuning. No external APIs. Self-hosted open-weight models, air-gapped. Every point of performance comes out of architecture. We're hiring one research engineer to own it.

**Why this works**

India has been caught by surprise before. Not because the warning didn't exist, but because it existed somewhere in the system and nobody put it together in time. People died because of that gap. We're closing it.

We're building the intelligence system that helps India see the next attack coming before it happens, and helps it win the next war before the first shot is fired. Not with better sensors; India already collects enough. With the ability to actually use what it collects, at the speed the threat moves.

This doesn't get built by a foreign company, and it doesn't get built for a demo. It gets built by people who decided this mattered enough to build it here, for real, before it's needed. If we do this right, the payoff is a warning that gets acted on in time, and a war that's already won in preparation before it's fought at all.

**What you'd work on**

•
**Retrieval that knows what it missed:**
A production RAG system returns a confident answer and has no idea what it failed to surface. Here that's the one failure we can't ship. What it would take for retrieval to bound its own recall is open.

•
**Reasoning across many hops and sources:**
Real questions don't resolve in one lookup. They need decomposition, retrieval that notices its own gaps, and synthesis across sources that disagree, with contradictions surfaced rather than averaged away.

•
**Uncertainty that survives the chain:**
Evidence varies wildly in reliability and precision, and inference runs several steps deep. Confidence has to propagate explicitly, because a wrong answer delivered with false confidence is worse than no answer.

•
**Investigations longer than a context window:**
Work spanning days and hundreds of tool calls can't live in context. What gets externalised, compressed, and reconstructed is mostly unsettled, and everything else depends on it.

**Why it's hard**

The models are fixed, so architecture is the only lever. The data resists every clean assumption: decades of documents, a dozen languages, no schema, the same entity written five different ways. Nothing gets to be a black box; a person accountable for a decision won't act on a system they can't interrogate, which rules out a lot of otherwise convenient architectures. No standard playbook exists. You'd derive it.

**Who this is for**

No experience requirement, no degree requirement. We're reading for one thing: given an open problem with no paper to follow, can you reason your way to an architecture, build it, and measure it honestly.

You should understand language models and retrieval mechanically, not as APIs. Why naive RAG fails on multi-hop temporal questions should be something you can explain without a blog post. You should have built something that survived real, messy data. A publication record is a real signal, not a requirement. So is a repository that does something nobody asked for.

Not this role: prompt templates, API integration, backend or UI, fine-tuning on labelled datasets.

* Experience with knowledge graphs, NLP, and structured and unstructured data (text and image).

* Exceptional technical judgement, balancing innovation with pragmatism, risk and cost.
* Strong written and verbal communication, explaining complex methods to non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative approach to working with global, multi-functional teams.
* Curiosity and an aim to keep learning in a fast-moving field.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. If you are ready to define the standards for AI that powers real-world decisions and deliver impact at scale, step forward and help us build what’s next!

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a seasoned Software Architect with deep expertise in cloud-native enterprise systems and Generative AI. You will define and deliver scalable, secure, and production-grade GenAI architectures — including multi-agent, RAG, LLMOps and AgentOps systems — and lead cross-functional teams to build and operate them. This role combines hands-on technical leadership, systems thinking, and strong stakeholder management.

Key responsibilities

Architecture & System Design

1. Design scalable, modular, and cloud-native architectures for GenAI applications(microservices, event-driven, serverless).
2. Define system boundaries, data flows, orchestration, and integration patterns forLLMs, vector DBs, embedding services, and tool integrations.
3. Produce architecture artifacts ( Layered Architecture Diagrams, C4 Models, DFDs,Class, Sequence, ER & Use Case diagrams, different types of blueprints, APIcontracts, design and trade-off decisions).
4. GenAI & Agentic Systems
5. Architect and deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, NaturalLanguage to SQL Flows, fine-tuning strategies, multi-modal capabilities, and tool-augmented agents.
6. Design agent orchestration and multi-agent frameworks enabling planning,reasoning, and secure tool invocations, implement and design Agent prototypes andCommunication Protocols.
7. Define prompt engineering standards, memory models(episodic/semantic/procedural), and context management.

LLMOps & AgentOps

1. Define and implement model lifecycle pipelines: training, fine-tuning, validation,deployment, rollback, and monitoring.
2. Build AgentOps processes for agent lifecycle, behavior tracking, governance andperformance optimization.
3. Automate CI/CD for models, agents and services (MLflow, TFX, BentoML, custompipelines).

Integration, Security & Compliance

1. Integrate GenAI services with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) usingsecure, scalable interfaces.
2. Ensure secure access controls, data privacy, encryption, and compliance (GDPR,HIPAA, SOC2).
3. Define responsible AI practices: bias mitigation, explainability, audit trails, andoutput governance.
4. GenAI security — classify, encrypt & sign data/models; enforce least-privilege withshort-lived creds and CI/CD security gates; telemetry, drift/hallucination alerts, kill-switch & runbooks.
5. Agentic AI security — provable agent identity/attestation, tool allowlist + human gatefor high-risk actions; ephemeral scoped tokens, sandboxed execution,and replayable audit traces.

Observability, Ops & Cost Optimization

1. Define telemetry, tracing, and logging for models and agents; monitor performance,drift, hallucination rates and user feedback loops.
2. Build dashboards, alerts and runbook guidance for operational health.
3. Design systems for cost efficiency (autoscaling, spot instances, serverlesschoices) and support FinOps practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Documentation

1. Lead cross-functional teams (product, data science, AI engineers, platform)through architecture reviews, workshops, and technical decisioning.
2. Maintain architectural standards, documentation, playbooks, and patternlibraries for GenAI systems.
3. Mentor engineers and evangelize best practices across the organization.

Required qualifications & experience

1. 10+ years software engineering experience with 3+ years in architecture or seniortechnical leadership roles (or equivalent).
2. Proven track record designing and delivering cloud-native, production systems atenterprise scale.
3. Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM systems, RAG, NL-SQL,agentic frameworks or similar productionized AI applications.
4. Strong knowledge of system design patterns (microservices, event-driven,CQRS, hexagonal architecture), and Low Level Design Patterns.
5. Experience integrating ML/LLM services with enterprise data platforms and APIswhile meeting security/compliance requirements.
6. Solid engineering background in at least two languages (Python, TypeScript, Go,Java, C#) and familiarity with modern frameworks.

Technical skills & technologies (comprehensive)

1. Cloud & Infra: AWS / Azure / GCP; Kubernetes, Docker, serverless (Lambda, Functions, Cloud Run), GPU instances
2. GenAI & ML: Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, ,LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Haystack
3. Vector Stores: FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Postgres+pgVector, and other cloud vector stores
4. LLMOps / MLOps: Custom Development of Ops Pipelines, MLflow, TFX, BentoML, Kubeflow
5. Data & Integration: Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, ETL/ELT concepts, data lakes, API gateways (Apigee etc)
6. DevOps & IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
7. Observability & Security: Prometheus, Grafana stack, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, ELK, Datadog; Vault,
8. IAM, LDAP/OAuth2/OIDC/SAML Connect, Snyk, SonarQube, SAST/SCA in pipelines, OWASPs, CWEs, CVEs.
9. Databases & Storage: Relational (RDS/Cloud SQL), NoSQL (Mongo, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), Redis, S3/Blob/GCS, ORM/ODM frameworks.
10. Agent frameworks / tools: Understanding of Basics of Agents required, Langgraph, Autogen, AutoGPT, AgentVerse, MetaGPT, CrewAI etc.
11. Performance & scalability: SSR/ISR, caching strategies (CDN, edge), lazy loading, bundle optimization, performance budgets.
12. Realtime & asyncRealtime & async: WebSockets, SSE, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), background workers. Frontend frameworks: React (Next.js), Angular, Vue; component libraries and state (Redux/RTK, Context, Pinia, Zustand)
13. Styling & UI tooling: Component Libraries, Accessibility best practices, Responsive UI
14. Frontend build & tooling: Vite, Webpack, Storybook, UI Frameworks.
15. Backend frameworks: Node.js/Express, FastAPI, serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Cloud Functions)
16. API design & integration: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning and contract testing, GraphQL(Optional)
17. UX & product mindset: Design-system familiarity, usability, accessibility, and working with designers

Behavioral & leadership skills

1. Strategic thinking with the ability to align architecture to product and businessgoals.
2. Excellent communicator: simplify complex technical concepts for technical andnon-technical stakeholders.
3. Strong mentorship skills — able to raise team capability in GenAI architectureand engineering.
4. Pragmatic decision-maker with a bias for measurable outcomes and trade-offanalysis.
5. High attention to detail, ownership, and accountability for reliability, security,and cost.

Nice-to-have

1. Experience operating LLMs in regulated industries (pharma).
2. Familiarity with prompt auditing, hallucination detection, and automated qualitychecks.
3. Background in knowledge engineering, semantic search, or knowledge graphs.

9. Reduced model hallucination/incidents and measurable improvement inretrieval quality.

11. Cost targets achieved through optimized infra and autoscaling policies.

Job Description About the Role and Team

Join Wipro's AI-Native Business & Platforms unit, a forward-thinking team dedicated to advancing the future of enterprise artificial intelligence. This team plays a vital role in pioneering agentic AI technology, integrating delivery and client partnerships across India and the United States to drive innovation at enterprise scale.

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Engineering Head to spearhead the technical vision and development of the Agentic Hive platform. The ideal candidate will lead architecture design, development, and deployment of agentic AI capabilities with a strong focus on security, scalability, and reliability. In this pivotal leadership role, you will guide a dynamic engineering team responsible for delivering production-ready AI solutions and integrating them seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Operating from India, you will collaborate closely with leadership and technical peers based in the U.S., ensuring alignment and fostering innovation across global teams. This is a unique opportunity to influence the trajectory of agentic AI in a large enterprise context, blending deep technical expertise with strategic leadership and enterprise architecture sensibilities.

͏ Key Responsibilities

* Take full ownership of the architecture and engineering delivery of the Agentic Hive platform, ensuring it meets business priorities, is modular, scalable, and aligned with product roadmaps.
* Lead the design and hands-on development of AI agents and automated workflows leveraging Claude and state-of-the-art agentic AI methodologies, including reasoning algorithms, tool integrations, and interactive human-in-the-loop processes.

title: Agentic Growth Marketer
description:
**Agentic Growth Marketer**

**10-12 LPA**

**Location: Bangalore, Koramangala**

**Build the future of marketing. Not another marketing campaign.**

**Company:**
**Porcellia**

**Experience:**
No minimum years required

**Mandatory background:**
Engineering, software development, data, or a closely related quantitative field

**The opportunity**

We believe the future of marketing will be built by people who understand both marketing and technology.

Not marketers who occasionally use ChatGPT.

Not developers who build AI tools without understanding the business problems they’re solving.

We’re looking for someone who sits at the intersection of
**engineering, data, AI agents, and marketing.**

Someone who can look at a marketing problem and think,
*“Why is a human still doing this?”*

Someone who understands how agents work, how to connect them, how to make them reliable, and how to turn them into systems that produce measurable business outcomes.

**You don’t need to be a great marketer yet. I’ll teach you that.**

You need to be an exceptional problem solver who loves numbers, understands technology, and is obsessed with what AI makes possible.

**What you’ll actually do**

Your job is simple:
**Learn marketing. Then agentify it.**

You’ll work directly with me to understand how some of India’s fastest-growing D2C brands are built and scaled.

Then you’ll turn that knowledge into intelligent systems.

You’ll:

* Build AI agents that solve real marketing problems across creative strategy, performance marketing, analytics, CRO, retention, and growth.
* Create agentic workflows that can research, reason, execute, evaluate, and improve with minimal human intervention.
* Connect LLMs, APIs, databases, marketing platforms, and automation tools into working systems.
* Turn complex marketing decisions into repeatable, scalable processes.
* Work with large amounts of data to find patterns, identify opportunities, and make better decisions.
* Experiment constantly with new models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities.
* Build solutions that don’t just save time, but actually make businesses more money.

**The goal isn’t to automate what marketers do today. It’s to build what marketers will be capable of doing tomorrow.**

**Who we’re looking for**

**1. You understand agents. Really well.**

You should know the difference between an AI chatbot, a workflow, and an autonomous agent.

You should be comfortable with concepts like tool calling, MCP, orchestration, memory, context engineering, APIs, evaluation, and multi-agent systems.

You don’t need to know every framework. But you should be the kind of person who experiments with new AI capabilities before everyone else starts talking about them.

**You should have built things. Not just watched tutorials about them.**

**2. You’re exceptionally good with numbers.**

You should be able to do mental math faster than most people can reach for a calculator.

Percentages, ratios, growth rates, margins, unit economics, probability, and data interpretation should come naturally to you.

You should be able to look at a spreadsheet and quickly figure out what’s happening, what’s wrong, and what matters.

Because great marketing is ultimately a numbers game.

**3. You have a technical or quantitative background.**

This is mandatory.

Ideally, you’re a software developer, data analyst, data scientist, engineer, or someone from a quantitative finance background.

You should be comfortable with structured thinking, logic, and solving problems using technology.

You don’t need a computer science degree. You do need to demonstrate genuine technical ability.

**4. You love marketing.**

You should be genuinely curious about why people buy things.

Why does one advertisement work while another fails? Why do people pay more for one brand than another? Why do some products become categories of their own?

You should find consumer psychology, copywriting, persuasion, business models, and growth fascinating.

You don’t need formal marketing experience. But you need to want to become world-class at it.

**5. You’re a builder, not a spectator.**

You should be someone who experiments relentlessly.

Someone who would rather build a working prototype over the weekend than spend two weeks discussing whether it’s possible.

You don’t wait for instructions. You find problems worth solving and start solving them.

**What you’ll get**

**I’ll teach you everything I know about marketing.**

You’ll learn how positioning works, how to create winning advertisements, how to read performance data, how to understand consumer behaviour, and how to build profitable growth engines.

You’ll get to work on real problems with real businesses, real budgets, and real consequences.

And then you’ll use your technical skills to turn that knowledge into products, agents, and systems.

You’ll be working at the frontier of a rapidly changing industry.

While most marketing teams are learning how to use AI tools,
**you’ll be building the tools and systems that redefine how marketing works.**

You won’t be joining a marketing team that simply follows instructions.

You’ll be helping create the future that other marketing teams eventually follow.

**Who should NOT apply**

* You’re looking for a conventional marketing job.
* Your understanding of AI is limited to writing prompts in ChatGPT.
* You dislike spreadsheets, calculations, or quantitative problems.
* You enjoy talking about ideas more than building them.
* You want a clearly defined role where someone tells you exactly what to do every day.

**Our hiring process**

We don’t care how many years you’ve worked.

We care how you think, what you can build, and how quickly you learn.

**Round 1: Make a video that catches our attention.**

This is the first and most important filter.

Make a video introducing yourself and convincing us why you should be the person building the future of marketing with us.

Show us how you think. Show us what you’ve built. Show us why you’re different.

There is no prescribed format.

You can be creative, technical, funny, analytical, or completely unconventional.

**We will shortlist candidates based on their videos. Not their resumes.**

**Round 2: Live interview**

If your video catches our attention, we’ll invite you for a live interview.

We’ll test two things:

1. **Data fluency:**
   Mental math, business logic, numerical reasoning, and your ability to make sense of unfamiliar data.
2. **Copywriting:**
   Your ability to understand people, communicate clearly, and persuade through words.

You don’t need to know marketing jargon. We’re looking for raw ability, not rehearsed answers.

**Salary**

10-12 LPA
