title: AI Inference Engineer
description:
**Hiring for FlexAI**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

FlexAI is building a high-performance, cloud-agnostic AI compute platform for training and inference. Its Token Factory serves 20+ open models through one OpenAI-compatible API, from serverless to dedicated endpoints and private cloud, running across NVIDIA, AMD and emerging AI accelerators. The company is led by the team that deployed the Aurora supercomputer and managed 50,000+ GPUs at Intel, is headquartered in Paris, and is growing its Bengaluru engineering centre as inference demand scales.

**About the Role**

As an AI Inference Engineer you'll design, build and optimise the serving stack that runs large language and multimodal models in production on heterogeneous hardware. It's a hands-on role at the intersection of model architecture, hardware and production serving: you'll own critical parts of an inference runtime built on vLLM, SGLang and PyTorch, help set direction on performance, and work with engineering, research and product to deliver fast, reliable and cost-efficient tokens to customers.

**What you'll do**

* Own the serving stack for LLMs and multimodal models: engine configuration, tensor/expert/data parallelism and deployment across NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
* Bring new open-weight models to production quickly and correctly: chat templates, tool-calling and reasoning parsers, structured outputs, quantized checkpoints.
* Profile and optimise throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency and cost per token, from kernels to the request path.
* Apply and evaluate FP8/FP4 quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse and offloading, prefix caching and prefill/decode disaggregation.
* Maintain and contribute patches to vLLM and SGLang, and upstream fixes where it makes sense.
* Run inference on Kubernetes across clusters and clouds with autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts and graceful failure handling.
* Build observability, benchmarking, load-testing, evaluation and model-release tooling that catches silent quality regressions before customers do.

**What you bring**

* 2+ years building performance-critical systems software in Python and C++.
* Hands-on experience serving LLMs in production with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar engines.
* A deep understanding of transformer inference: attention and the KV cache, batching and scheduling, and when a workload is memory-bandwidth bound versus compute bound.
* Experience profiling GPU workloads (Nsight, rocprof, PyTorch profiler) and turning findings into measured improvements.
* Familiarity with distributed inference: tensor and expert parallelism, NCCL/RCCL, high-speed interconnects.
* Comfort with Kubernetes, containers and running production services.
* A habit of measuring before and after every change, and of verifying correctness, not only speed.

**Nice to have**

* Contributions to open-source inference engines or GPU kernels (CUDA, HIP, Triton).
* Experience with AMD ROCm or non-GPU AI accelerators.
* Experience with KV-cache systems (e.g. LMCache, Mooncake), speculative decoding or disaggregated serving.
* Experience with model quantization and accuracy evaluation.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
to work directly with frontier AI labs to solve their most complex engineering challenges.
  
  
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments—from understanding technical requirements to architecting, building, and scaling production systems that improve customer workflows and model performance. You'll operate across the stack, partnering closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in both India and the US to deliver solutions for our most strategic customers.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep software engineering with customer partnership, helping shape how Handshake AI delivers solutions to the world's leading AI labs.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India. This is an in-office role.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Partner directly with frontier AI labs to understand complex technical challenges and translate them into scalable engineering solutions
* Partner closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and Operations teams in the US to execute against a shared roadmap
* Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that solve high-impact customer problems
* Own technical architecture for customer deployments with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on solutions based on customer feedback
* Build reusable tools, frameworks, and deployment patterns that improve delivery across customer engagements
* Mentor engineers through technical leadership, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Help establish a strong engineering culture as we continue building our India engineering organization

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Experience leading technically complex customer-facing, solutions engineering, or forward deployed engineering projects
* Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and modern backend architectures
* Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), system design, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Experience building and operating production systems on AWS or GCP
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to solve complex engineering problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, including teams based in the US

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered products, LLM infrastructure, or machine learning platforms
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers or strategic technical partners
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience supporting applied AI or ML research teams
* Experience working in a fast-growing startup or high-growth engineering organization

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customer deployments launch successfully and deliver measurable value
* Technical solutions become reusable across multiple customer engagements
* Deployments are reliable, scalable, and easy to maintain
* Customer feedback directly informs platform improvements and future product capabilities
* You become a trusted technical partner across customers and engineering teams in both India and the US

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

**Perks**

* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

title: Software Engineering Manager, AI/ML Infrastructure and Performance Engineering
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software engineering, machine learning infrastructure, computer architecture, distributed computing, people management, debugging tools, communication.
* Experience with people management, and building infrastructure to improve performance of Machine Learning (ML) systems and applications.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Performance Optimization, Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Programming, High Performance Computing, Large Language Model, Open Source Contributor.
* Experience with the Machine Learning infra and frameworks and hands-on experience with GPU or Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) performance analysis.
* Experience in building agentic workflows for performance debugging and optimization. Ability to generate ideas and resolve ambiguity.
* Hands-on experience with Machine Learning (ML) frameworks such as TensorFlow, JAX, and PyTorch, Keras. Experience with ML Inference frameworks such as vLLM, SG Lang, Pathways and experience in open-source software development, including experience in releasing and supporting open-source projects.

**About the job**
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.
  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
  
  
Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stacks through providing insightful performance debugging for workloads and custom kernels. We provide insights by summarizing different views of captured profile data - such as trace timelines, memory usage, Compiler profiles, ML graph summariesThe ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.
  
  
We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Learn and build an intuitive understanding of existing data collection, analysis, and visualization workflows with deep introspection across Frameworks, Accelerated Linear Algebra (XLA) and runtime stack.
* Support new and exciting ML paradigms (such as horizontal scaling for upcoming TPU chips) by making contributions across the end to end stack and analysis tools. Partner with ML Stack leads to understand model optimization use cases and bring debugging to feel native in 3P environments (VSCode, Cursor, Grafana, etc).
* Work with OSS ML inference frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang to provide insights in Xprof about performance improvement opportunities.
* Partner with other teams that own various parts of the ML stack to understand performance optimization use cases. Work with OSS ML inference frameworks such as TorchTPU, vLLM, SGLang to provide insights into performance bottlenecks.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Member of Technical Staff (Senior - Specialized Indexing)
description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.
  
  
For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.
  
  
At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.
  
  
**The Role**
The
**SQL Queries**
team is responsible for the core of CockroachDB’s query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads.
  
  
AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up.
  
  
We’re forming a new
**Specialized Indexing**
subteam within SQL Queries to expand CockroachDB’s indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as
**vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes**
to support the next generation of
**AI-native and search-driven applications**
.
  
  
As part of this team, you’ll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make CockroachDB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data.
  
  
**You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for CockroachDB, including vector, full-text, and geospatial indexing.
* Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows.
* Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine.
* Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization.
* Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release.

**The Expectations**
**In your first month**
, you’ll get familiar with CockroachDB’s SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You’ll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes.
  
  
**Within three months**
, you’ll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability.
  
  
**After six months**
, you’ll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features.
  
  
**You Have**

* Passion for databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures.
* A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with Go, C/C++, or Rust.
* Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data.
* A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team.
* Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems.
* Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions.
* A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility — your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on.
* Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.

**The Team**
The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how CockroachDB powers intelligent, hybrid applications.
  
  
You’ll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You’ll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use CockroachDB.
  
  
If you’re excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.
  
  
Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Mental Wellbeing Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Wellness Allowance
* Food Allowance
* Office Commute Reimbursement
* And more!

title: Technical Lead & Manager
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for our first Technical Lead & Manager in India. This role will help shape the next chapter of that organization while remaining deeply involved in the technical work itself.
  
  
**How We Work**
**Hands-On Leadership**
We don't see management and engineering as separate tracks.Our Technical lead will participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, hiring decisions, and occasionally jump into code themselves. The ideal balance is roughly 40% leadership and 60% technical contribution.
  
  
**Ownership**
Both the geographies - India and US - own meaningful parts of the product and platform. Engineers are trusted with end-to-end ownership and leaders are expected to create the environment where that ownership thrives.
  
  
**Talent Density**
We're intentional about every hire.The team includes engineers from companies such as Google, Meta, Rubrik, Glean, and other world-class organizations. Maintaining and raising that bar is one of the most important responsibilities of this role.
  
  
**Product Thinking**
The best engineering decisions start with understanding the customer problem.We look for leaders who can connect technical choices to customer outcomes and help teams prioritize accordingly.
  
  
**Builders**
We value people who can build from first principles.Processes, operating rhythms, performance management, career development, organizational design—none of these are finished products. You'll help create and evolve them as the organization grows.
  
  
**What You'd Work On**
**Scaling a High-Performance Engineering Organization**
The India team has grown rapidly and now spans backend systems, platform infrastructure, frontend experiences, and machine learning.
  
  
You'll help build the systems that allow that team to scale without losing speed, quality, or culture.
  
  
**Developing Future Technical Leaders**
Many of our engineers are capable of becoming future staff engineers, tech leads, and engineering managers.
  
  
A significant part of this role is helping them get there through mentorship, coaching, feedback, and career development.
  
  
**Raising the Hiring Bar**
We're actively growing.
  
  
You'll partner closely with leadership to identify exceptional talent, evaluate candidates, and ensure every hire improves the organization.
  
  
**Driving Technical Excellence**
As the organization grows, maintaining a high technical bar becomes harder.
  
  
You'll help guide architecture discussions, participate in design reviews, review code, and ensure engineering quality scales alongside headcount.
  
  
**Building the Next Generation of Analytics**
From agent orchestration and reasoning systems to distributed data infrastructure and AI-powered user experiences, you'll work alongside the team solving technically ambitious problems at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise software.
  
  
**You may be a good fit if you**

* Have spent years building and shipping complex software systems
* Have managed engineers and genuinely enjoy helping people grow
* Still love engineering and want to remain technically involved
* Hold a high bar for technical quality and execution
* Operate with high ownership and low ego
* Can balance speed with sound engineering judgment
* Have strong product instincts and care about customer outcomes
* Want to help build an organization, not simply inherit one

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience at companies that have built at scale and have strong engineering cultures
* Startup or founding engineer experience
* Experience scaling engineering organizations from
* Experience with distributed systems, infrastructure, AI, data platforms, or developer tools
* Experience hiring and developing senior engineering talent

**Not sure this is the right fit?**

* Looking for a pure people-management role with little technical involvement? This probably isn't it.
* Looking for a remote role? We work together in-office five days a week.
* Looking primarily for title progression? We're more interested in builders than titles.

**Why WisdomAI?**
You'll join a company founded by repeat entrepreneurs and early builders from companies including Rubrik and Glean.
  
  
We're tackling one of the largest software categories in the world: business intelligence and analytics.
  
  
We're backed by leading investors including Kleiner Perkins and NVIDIA Ventures.
  
  
Most importantly, you'll inherit a strong team and have the opportunity to shape what engineering leadership looks like in India from the ground up.
  
  
**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

**Role Title: 2603010 AVP, AI Security Architect (L11)**

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Security Architecture organization enables Synchrony to innovate and grow securely by embedding security-by-design into technology solutions. We partner with engineering, platform, data, cloud, and business teams to translate security strategy and evolving threats into practical architecture requirements, reusable patterns, blueprints, and guardrails. Through risk-based architecture reviews, threat modeling, and scalable security guidance, the team helps protect Synchrony’s digital assets and customer data while supporting resilient, compliant, and efficient technology delivery. This role will contribute to advancing our AI Security Architecture capabilities, helping establish secure patterns and assurance practices for Generative AI, AI agents, and other emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**The AVP, AI Security Architect**
will design and advance security architectures for Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and emerging AI technologies. The role will translate enterprise security strategy and evolving AI threats into practical requirements, reusable patterns, and engineering guidance that enable secure innovation while protecting company, customer, and sensitive data.
  
  
Working across Cybersecurity, Technology, Data, AI/ML Engineering, Cloud, Risk, and Business teams, the architect will lead solution-level security assessments, contribute to enterprise standards, and embed security-by-design through threat modeling, control validation, testing, and continuous assurance across the AI lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply and help mature enterprise AI security architecture principles, standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Design reusable security patterns for Generative AI, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), model and inference APIs, autonomous or agentic AI, and enterprise AI platforms.
* Lead security architecture assessments for complex AI solutions across cloud, SaaS, API, data, application, and enterprise technology environments.
* Partner with AI/ML engineers, application teams, cloud architects, data teams, and product owners to embed security throughout design, development, deployment, integration, monitoring, and retirement.
* Perform AI threat modeling using MITRE ATLAS and OWASP guidance, translating identified threats into actionable controls and engineering requirements.
* Define and validate controls for model access, identities, service accounts, secrets, APIs, prompts, training and retrieval data, outputs, plugins, tools, and third-party AI services.
* Assess risks such as prompt injection, data poisoning, sensitive information disclosure, insecure tool interaction, excessive agency, model manipulation, and AI supply-chain compromise.
* Contribute to automation of architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, control validation, and security testing.
* Document architecture decisions, material risks, trade-offs, and recommendations for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud, Application Security, Data, Responsible AI, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Business partners.
* Create implementation guidance and enablement that help engineering teams adopt approved AI security patterns consistently.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, application security, or enterprise architecture, including delivery of complex security initiatives.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.
* Strong foundation in identity and access management, application and API security, cloud security, data protection, secrets and key management, DevSecOps, and software supply-chain security.
* Knowledge of AI security and risk frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience designing or reviewing enterprise architectures on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Ability to convert technical risks into architecture requirements, reusable patterns, engineering guidance, and clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical stakeholders, facilitate architecture decisions, and build alignment across teams.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience securing platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI services.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, model security assessment, prompt-injection testing, or AI vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance, ISO/IEC 42001, and evolving AI governance expectations.
* Ability to move effectively between detailed technical architecture, engineering execution, risk discussions, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing reference architectures, security blueprints, automated guardrails, and scalable control-assurance capabilities.
* Financial-services cybersecurity, regulatory, risk-management, or data-protection experience is a plus.
* Collaborative and execution-oriented approach, with a focus on simplification, automation, measurable outcomes, and responsible innovation.

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor's degree with 6+ years of experience in Cyber industry, security architecture experience including on-prem and hybrid environments and practical knowledge of modern AI architectures, including Large Language Models, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, model gateways, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, managed AI services, and model or inference APIs.

title: Research Scientist II, Grocery ECO
description:
**Description**
We are looking for a talented Research Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions
  
  
Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions
  
  
Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements
  
  
Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency
  
  
Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes
  
  
Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems
  
  
Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Research Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
**About The Team**
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree
* Experience investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products
* Experience analyzing both experimental and observational data sets
* 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of R, MATLAB, Python or similar scripting language
* 3+ years of applied research experience
* Knowledge of deep learning, machine learning and statistics
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

title: AI Security Operations Engineer (Teradyne, India)
description:
**Our Purpose**
TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are challenged to innovate and learn something new every day.
  
  
We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
**Overview**
Teradyne is building dedicated, in-house AI security engineering capability within the Information Security organization to keep pace with the rapid adoption of AI agents, large language models (LLMs), and AI-enabled tooling across the enterprise. As AI becomes embedded in how the company operates, from everyday productivity tools to autonomous agents to security operations itself, Teradyne needs an engineer who can both lock down how AI is used across the enterprise and put AI to work strengthening our own cyber defenses. The AI Security Engineer owns both halves of that mission.
  
  
**Securing AI Across the Enterprise:**
This role secures the use of third-party and internally deployed AI tools across Teradyne, ensuring sensitive data, intellectual property, and engineering workflows are protected as AI becomes deeply embedded in how work gets done.
  
  
**Leading the Evolution of AI Cybersecurity Defense:**
This role also leads the evolution of AI cybersecurity defense and AI-driven security automation, shaping how Teradyne's security operations and solutions leverage AI to detect, investigate, and respond to threats at scale.
  
  
This role sits within the Information Security organization and works closely with the Deputy CISO, Product Security, and the broader AI Transformation program to ensure new AI investments (including enterprise platforms already in use such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, as well as internally built agents) are secure by design and aligned to frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) and Teradyne's AI Cyber Operational Capabilities Framework.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong security engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience testing and securing modern AI systems, including LLMs, autonomous agents, and the protocols and tooling that connect them (e.g., MCP-based integrations), and brings an automation-first mindset to reduce manual effort and strengthen detection and response across the security program.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Securing AI Across the Enterprise**

* Enterprise AI Security: Define and implement security controls and guardrails for the use of AI tools (LLM APIs, SaaS AI platforms, internal AI services, and agents) across the organization, including AI/agentic gateway controls that manage and monitor access and enforce identity, authorization, and tool-use constraints for autonomous or semi-autonomous agents.
* AI Security Platform Ownership: Own, operate, and continuously improve Teradyne's AI security solutions and platforms, including AI/agentic gateways, AI-aware monitoring, and enterprise AI security tooling, keeping capabilities current, well-configured, and effective against the latest AI and agentic threats as the technology and threat landscape evolve.
* Data Protection for AI Usage: Develop and enforce controls to prevent sensitive data and IP leakage through AI systems, including input/output filtering, data classification, and secure handling of prompts, embeddings, and outputs, integrated with Teradyne's existing DLP tooling and processes.
* AI Threat Modeling: Develop threat models for new and existing AI use cases, identifying risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, model misuse, supply-chain risk from AI vendors, and unauthorized agent actions.
* AI Security Reviews & Architecture: Own AI-related security reviews within the architecture review process, defining controls for agent identity, tool/API access, data-use constraints, and auditability, and acting as the security gate for new AI projects, agents, and integrations before they reach production.
* Vendor & Platform Security: Evaluate third-party AI vendors and platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM APIs, other SaaS AI tools) for data handling practices, model behavior, and integration risk, favoring proven commercial AI security capabilities over custom builds where practical.
* Security Enablement: Contribute to internal guidance and education on safe AI usage, including secure prompting, data handling, and appropriate use of AI tools.

**Leading AI Cybersecurity Defense & Automation**

* AI-Driven Security Automation: Lead the evolution of AI-enhanced cybersecurity defense, applying AI and agentic approaches to detection engineering, automated response, threat hunting, and broader security automation.
* Tooling & Automation: Build and maintain automation (playbooks, scripts, and AI-assisted tooling) that reduces manual effort across security operations and incorporates AI-aware detections into Teradyne's existing security stack (SIEM, SOAR, DLP, EDR).
* Incident Response for AI-Related and AI-Assisted Cases: Serve as a technical resource for security incidents involving AI systems (e.g., sensitive data exposure via AI tools, compromised API keys, agent misuse), and apply AI-driven tooling to accelerate investigation and response for security incidents more broadly.
* Attack Simulation: Build and automate realistic attack simulations and adversary emulation scenarios to continuously validate detection and response capability.
* Frameworks & Standards: Track and apply emerging AI security and defense frameworks and guidance, including the NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP guidance for LLM applications, to keep internal practices current, and contribute technical evidence to support internal and third-party AI security assessments and audits.

**Cross-Cutting**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the AI Transformation program, Product Security, Enterprise Architecture, Legal, and Compliance to align AI usage and AI-driven defense capabilities with regulatory requirements, data governance policies, and responsible AI practices.
* Documentation: Document AI security standards, playbooks, and review criteria as Teradyne's AI usage and AI-driven defense capabilities mature.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and demonstrated experience.
* 5-7+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or another hands-on technical security role.
* Working knowledge of how large language models, AI agents, and agent-to-tool integrations (e.g., MCP-style protocols) function, including common security weaknesses such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data/model poisoning, and unsafe autonomy.
* Familiarity with how enterprise AI platforms in active use at Teradyne (such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and other LLM or agent tools) are typically deployed, governed, and secured.
* Familiarity with security operations concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response) and how AI and automation can be applied to strengthen them.
* Experience with security testing techniques such as penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and threat modeling, and the ability to apply them to novel AI and agentic systems.
* Proficiency in at least one modern scripting or programming language (e.g., Python) for building security automations and tooling.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and API-based integrations, and how to secure them.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, given how new and fast-moving AI security practices are.
* Clear communicator, able to translate technical AI security findings into guidance for engineers, architects, and leadership.
* Self-directed and comfortable operating within a small, growing team and evolving processes.

**Preferred**

* Experience building or integrating AI-driven or agentic approaches into security automation, orchestration, or SOAR-style tooling and playbook development.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex) or MCP-based agentic tooling.
* Familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), MITRE ATLAS, OWASP guidance for LLM applications, and related AI governance and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001).
* Familiarity with Microsoft/Azure AI security controls (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure AI Foundry), given Teradyne's Microsoft-centric environment.
* Experience evaluating third-party AI vendor security posture (e.g., SOC 2 / ISO reports, penetration test summaries) to support buy-versus-build decisions.
* Experience with DLP, EDR/XDR, or SIEM platforms.
* Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, GIAC, CISSP) or AI-security-focused training or certifications.
* Experience working within a distributed or offshore team model, collaborating across time zones with a US-based security leadership team.

We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.
  
  
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
  
  
**Benefits**
Teradyne offers a variety of robust health and well-being benefit programs, insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, and more.

title: Lead Performance and Optimization Engineer
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
**Together, we advance your career.**
**Lead Performance and Optimization Engineer**
**The Role**
We are seeking a Performance Engineer with strong expertise in serverclass CPUs, CPU microarchitecture, and ML inference, responsible for benchmarking, analysing, and optimizing CPU inference performance using EPYCoptimized ML libraries (e.g., ZenDNN) with common frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime). The role includes handson work in performance debugging, OS/BIOS tuning, thread/core affinity, multiinstance execution, and Python/scriptingbased automation. .
  
  
**The Person**
The ideal candidate should be passionate about software engineering and possess leadership skills to drive sophisticated issues to resolution. Able to communicate effectively and work optimally with different teams across AMD.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Engineering & Optimization

+ Run and optimize ML inference workloads on CPUs using EPYCoptimized libraries (ZenDNN), improving throughput/latency across singleinstance and multiinstance scenarios.
+ Configure and tune NUMA, HugePages, SMT, power/performance modes, CPU isolation, scheduler settings, scaling governors, and other OS/BIOS parameters.
+ Design and validate thread/core affinity strategies for singleinstance, multiinstance, multisocket, and frameworklevel multiinstance execution models.
+ Optimize workload behaviour through NUMAaware locality, thread scheduling/pinning, batch size tuning, operatorlevel parallelism, and other CPUfocused techniques.
+ Contribute to multiinstance execution framework development, including policies for instance partitioning, core allocation, memory distribution, and orchestration of parallel runs on large EPYC systems.

Benchmarking & Analysis
  
  

* Develop and run structured benchmarks across EPYC SKUs, core counts, caching/topology variations, sockets, and diverse batch sizes.
* Analyze scaling for singleinstance vs. multiinstance execution, instance placement strategies, and workload isolation.
* Use perf, VTune, ftrace/tracecmd, PMU counters, flame graphs to identify bottlenecks in compute, memory, thread scheduling, or instancelevel competition.
* Perform rootcause analysis for regressions in latency, throughput, multiinstance efficiency, memory bandwidth, and pipeline behaviour.

ML Inference Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Understand how ML frameworks execute models on CPU, including tensor shapes/layouts, operator behavior, threading models, kernel dispatch, scheduling strategies, and multiinstance runtime interactions.
* Interpret how model architecture and operator composition influence performance across single and multiple concurrent inference instances.
* Collaborate with ZenDNN and kernel/ops teams to relay findings and help guide kernel/operatorlevel improvements.

Automation & Tooling
  
  

* Build automation pipelines for singleinstance and multiinstance benchmarking, profiling, orchestration, scaling studies, and regression detection.
* Develop Python/Bash tooling that manages instance spawning, CPU core partitioning, memory pinning, performance data capture, reporting, and visual dashboards.
* Maintain reproducible experiment workflows for both singleinstance and multiinstance configurations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

description:

Lead AI Engineer

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
  
  
**General Description Of Role**
We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to lead a small, high-caliber AI engineering team within our Human Capital Solutions team, embedded within the HCA platform engineering group. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will drive delivery of production-grade AI agents and LLM-powered features that enhance how clients and internal teams interact with Aon’s compensation and workforce analytics platform. Working closely with our AI Research and Product Team to adopt established patterns and infrastructure, you will take those patterns and deliver real agentic capability - from natural language interfaces over client data to AI-assisted compensation benchmarking workflows.
  
  
The ideal candidate pairs strong Python and backend API development skills with genuine hands-on experience building agentic AI systems and has the technical leadership maturity to give direction to experienced engineers, and own delivery end to end. Given how new this space is, we value deep, demonstrable hands-on capability and sound engineering judgement - whether from professional work or significant personal projects - over years in a formal AI title.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery for the team: planning, prioritisation, and predictable execution, so the team makes tangible, visible progress.
* Oversee engineering standards, patterns, and best practices, aligning with the architectural direction set by the AI Research and Product Team.
* Design and build production-grade AI agents using agentic frameworks (initially LangGraph/LangChain, with other frameworks adopted as the space evolves, including exploration of Claude Agent SDK in sandbox environments), integrating with existing platform APIs to deliver intelligent, context-aware features.
* Develop and maintain Python-based backend services (such as FastAPI) that expose agent capabilities via REST and server-sent event (SSE) streaming endpoints.
* Implement secure agent pipelines that correctly propagate user identity and entitlements, ensuring agent behaviour is scoped to individual client subscriptions.
* Apply a strong understanding of AI-specific security concerns - including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, agent behaviour risks, and reputational exposure - to design agents that are robust and trustworthy in a production enterprise environment.
* Integrate AI agents with Azure cloud services and internal platform APIs, following established architectural patterns set by the AI Research and Product Team.
* Instrument agent runs with structured logging, tracing, and observability tooling to support debugging, performance monitoring, and regression prevention.
* Collaborate closely with the HCA platform team in an agile delivery environment - helping steer and contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and ceremonies.
* Work alongside the AI Research and Product Team during onboarding and early delivery, absorbing patterns and progressively taking on more independent ownership of agent design decisions.
* Proactively communicate blockers, unknowns, and design questions - particularly when working at the frontier of rapidly evolving AI tooling.
* Stay current with the fast-moving AI engineering landscape; evaluate new frameworks, models, and patterns and bring relevant developments back to the team.

**Skills/Competencies Required**

* 8+ years of overall software development experience, including at least 4 years in Python and backend API development, together with a track record of technical leadership - leading delivery, mentoring engineers, or owning significant systems.
* Substantial, demonstrable hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-powered systems. Given how new this space is, we value depth of capability over years in a formal AI title.
* Proven ability to give technical direction to strong, experienced engineers and to run delivery autonomously, making sound decisions independently and knowing when to align with the wider team.
* Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns:
* Tool use, state management, and multi-step reasoning
* Checkpointing, human-in-the-loop flows, and agent interrupts
* Multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on experience with agentic or LLM frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Claude Agent SDK, or similar); formal professional experience is a plus but demonstrable hands-on capability - including personal projects and sandbox work - is equally valued.
* Strong Python development skills:
* Async Python and asyncio patterns
* Building and consuming REST APIs and SSE streams
* Python backend frameworks such as FastAPI
* Experience working with Azure cloud services; familiarity with deploying and operating cloud-hosted AI workloads on Azure.
* Good understanding of authentication and authorisation patterns (JWT, OAuth2, OIDC) and how to propagate user identity and entitlements securely through an agentic pipeline.
* Awareness of AI-specific security risks including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, and agent behaviour vulnerabilities - and how to design against them.
* Experience with observability practices in backend systems: structured logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring; familiarity with AI-specific evaluation and tracing concepts (e.g. MLflow, LangSmith, or similar) is a strong advantage.
* Experience with containerisation (Docker) for packaging and deploying backend services.
* Comfortable using AI coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor) as part of a day-to-day development workflow.
* Comfortable leading delivery in an agile environment and setting the pace for iterative, dependable execution.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; proactive in surfacing blockers, unknowns, and design questions across teams and time zones.
* Genuine curiosity and drive for self-directed learning in a fast-moving technical space.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have**

* Hands-on experience with LangGraph and/or LangChain in a production or near-production context.
* Experience with AWS cloud services (ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, S3).
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL and async database access patterns (psycopg3, SQLAlchemy, or similar).
* Experience with agent evaluation frameworks and experiment tracking (MLflow, Databricks Agents, or equivalent).
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for AI systems - automated testing, evaluation gates, and deployment of model-backed services.
* Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL - useful when working alongside the existing HCA platform team.
* Exposure to .NET/C# - helpful for understanding the broader HCA platform codebase these agents integrate with.
* Prior experience building AI features within enterprise SaaS platforms or data-heavy products.
* Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty).

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)**

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)

**About Us**

Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.

Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.

We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.

Technical Skills

* Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
* Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
* Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
* Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
* Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.

Leadership & Ownership

* Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
* At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.

Mindset & Collaboration

* Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
* Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.

Nice to Have

* Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
* Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
* Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
* Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
* Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.

What to Expect

* We value humility and collaboration — we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
* We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You'll Make

* Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
* Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
* Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
* Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.
* Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals.
* Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
* Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.
* Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About the Company

Eigenstate AI is looking for a Senior AI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in computer vision and deep learning.

The role involves designing, developing, optimizing and deploying AI solutions for real-world applications. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of end-to-end AI development, from problem-solving and model development to evaluation, optimization and production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop and deploy computer vision systems for image and video-based applications.
* Build solutions involving object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking and visual understanding.
* Develop and optimise models using architectures such as CNNs (ResNet, EfficientNet), Vision Transformers (ViT, Swin, DeiT) and detection/segmentation models (YOLO, DETR, Mask R-CNN).
* Implement multi-object tracking algorithms such as SORT, DeepSORT and ByteTrack.
* Develop video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities using RNNs, Transformers and other relevant approaches.
* Explore multimodal AI systems combining vision and language using models such as CLIP, BLIP and similar architectures.
* Apply classical computer vision and geometric techniques, including camera calibration, pose estimation, feature matching and depth estimation.
* Train, fine-tune, evaluate and optimise deep learning models for accuracy, latency and scalability.
* Build data pipelines for dataset curation, annotation, augmentation and model training.
* Deploy and integrate AI models into production environments, including GPU-based and edge infrastructure.
* Research and experiment with emerging AI techniques to solve complex technical challenges.

Required Skills & Experience

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in computer vision and applied deep learning.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Practical experience with object detection, segmentation and tracking systems.
* Experience with model training, fine-tuning, evaluation and optimisation.
* Strong understanding of representation learning, loss functions and deep learning fundamentals.
* Good understanding of evaluation metrics such as mAP, IoU, precision, recall and F1-score.
* Experience with image and video processing using OpenCV or similar frameworks.
* Experience building and deploying end-to-end AI solutions in production environments.
* Understanding of inference optimisation, GPU acceleration and scalable deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with multimodal models such as CLIP, BLIP or similar Vision-Language Models.
* Knowledge of action recognition, video understanding and temporal modelling.
* Experience with human pose estimation, skeletal tracking and 3D vision.
* Familiarity with NeRFs, SLAM, point clouds and depth estimation.
* Experience with ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA and model quantisation.
* Knowledge of active learning, hard-negative mining and synthetic data generation.
* Experience with distributed training and large-scale data pipelines.
* Familiarity with Docker, cloud infrastructure and edge deployment.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong practical experience building and deploying AI solutions, beyond academic projects and experimentation.
* Ability to independently approach complex computer vision problems and identify suitable technical solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete model development lifecycle.
* Ability to translate research and experimentation into reliable, production-ready systems.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving skills and collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.

Candidates whose experience is limited to academic projects or model experimentation without practical implementation and deployment experience may not be suitable for this role.

title: Applied AI R&D Engineer
description:
Testsigma is an AI-native company building autonomous agents that verify software as fast as AI can write it.

AI has transformed how code is written, but not how it is trusted. When the same AI writes both a feature and the checks for it, both inherit the same blind spots. Our agentic AI coworkers act as the independent judge: they understand what changed in an application, identify what is at risk, adapt as the application evolves, and tell engineering teams whether a release is safe to ship, bringing in a human whenever judgment is needed.

We're solving this in production for global enterprises such as Cisco, Samsung, DHL and IndusInd Bank. Testsigma is headquartered in San Francisco, with engineering in Bangalore, and is backed by MassMutual, Accel, Strive and Bold Cap.

**THE ROLE**

You'll join our AI team building the core agent layer of our platform, working directly with the founding team. The team is small, so your architecture decisions will shape the platform for years.

This isn't a role for someone who chains LLM API calls and calls it agentic. The systems you build have deterministic rule layers, multi-stage reasoning pipelines, confidence scoring when the answer is ambiguous, feedback loops that improve over time, and escalation logic that knows when to stop and ask a human.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

• Build multi-agent orchestration: agents that plan, execute, correct themselves and escalate, owning the intelligence behind our autonomous agents for generation, self-repair, judgement and gap detection

• Build context graph infrastructure: a living knowledge graph connecting requirements, DOM elements, agent-generated checks, code functions and user behaviour signals

• Build browser crawl agents that understand a running application by meaning, not just structure

• Build the agent evaluation layer that tells us whether an agent's decision was correct, and gates every prompt and model change

• Integrate LLMs at production scale: prompt engineering, structured output, context window management, fallback strategies and confidence calibration

• Build feedback loops that make the system measurably smarter with every agent run, self-repaired step and confirmed bug

**MUST-HAVE**

• 3+ years of software engineering, including recent hands-on work building multi-agent systems in production, not prototypes or demos

• Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or an equivalent orchestration framework, and the ability to explain why you chose it

• Designed and queried knowledge graphs or graph databases, such as Neo4j or a graph layer on a relational system

• Built systems that detect absence: not just what's wrong, but what's missing

• Production Python that is async, typed, modular and observable

• Browser-use or equivalent browser and computer-use agents, beyond basic scripting

**GOOD TO HAVE**

• Agent evaluation frameworks, such as RAGAS, custom evals or LLM-as-judge pipelines

• Vector stores alongside graph databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate), and knowing when to use which

• Developer tooling or AI infrastructure products

• GitHub API, Jira API or similar developer integrations

• Some TypeScript or Node.js

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Direct access to the founding team and real influence over product direction

• The chance to be a core architect of a category-defining platform

• 100% company-paid medical insurance

• Daily catered lunch and free snacks

description:
Overview of Role:
  
  
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
KPIs:
  
  

* Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.
* Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.
* Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.
* Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.
* Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.
* Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

Key Year One Deliverables:
  
  

* Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.

* Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.
* Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.
