title: Senior AI Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are looking for a full-stack engineer who has built production applications, and who has also helped build software that other engineers then built on top of — a shared library, an internal tool, a reusable component set or a software development kit — establishing engineering standards through automation rather than documentation.
  
  
The role combines application development with internal platform and developer-tooling engineering, and the two feed each other: building a real application end to end is how we discover which capabilities the platform should own.
  
  
On The Platform Side You Will Build GE HealthCare's Internal AI Engineering Framework — The Shared Libraries, Code Generation Tools, Standardised Interfaces And Automated Verification Our Data Scientists And Engineers Use To Take Their Own AI Solutions Into Production. It Exists To Deliver Four Outcomes For The Company
  
  

* reduce time from working prototype to production from months to days;
* allow data scientists to ship production-grade AI without expertise in cloud infrastructure, deployment, application security or front-end development;
* make security, compliance and consistency automatically enforced properties of every solution, rather than outcomes dependent on scarce expert review;
* allow underlying technologies to be replaced — model provider, agent framework, user interface approach — without rewriting the solutions built on them.

On the application side you will develop selected AI applications end to end — front end, back end and agents — for priority business use cases, and for the reference implementations that prove each platform capability before it is offered to others. Expect the balance to sit somewhat more on the platform side than the application side, and to shift as the platform matures. It is not an infrastructure operations role.
  
  
tex
  
  
**Job Description**
GE HealthCare's Chief Data and Analytics Office delivers data, insight and AI products across Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing and Operational Excellence.
  
  
Most people creating AI solutions here are data scientists and analysts rather than career software engineers. Their modelling, evaluation and domain expertise is what these programmes need; deep infrastructure and front-end expertise is not reasonable to require of them. Every solution must nonetheless reach production as a secure, reliable, supportable enterprise system. A defining characteristic of our approach is that
**correctness is established by automated tooling — type systems, generated code, schema validation, pipeline checks — rather than by expert human review**
, which does not scale to the pace required. Your users are colleagues, and your work is measured by how much they accomplish correctly and independently.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Build shared platform capabilities**

* Reusable libraries used across AI applications: configuration, structured logging and tracing, error handling, resilience, messaging, data access, API scaffolding, authentication, and access to cloud and AI services.
* The shared execution layer for AI agents — the runtime that takes an agent's declared configuration, instructions and business logic functions and supplies everything else needed in production: lifecycle, messaging, retries, tracing, permission enforcement, output evaluation and deployment.
* The configuration-driven user interface capability, in which a business or data science user describes a dashboard in a structured data file and the platform renders it, so no application code is written per view — including the typed, validated visual components it draws from and the design token system that keeps every view consistent and accessible.
* The data access layer that resolves a declared dataset into a validated result, applying security filtering, parameter validation, resource limits, caching and observability centrally rather than in each solution.

**Build applications, where that is the fastest way to prove the platform**

* Develop selected AI applications end to end — user interface, API, data access and agents — as reference implementations and early pilot use cases, and harvest from them the capabilities the platform should own. Shared capability here is derived from working code with real consumers, not designed speculatively.

**Build the tooling that makes standards real**

* Code generation tools and project templates (for example copier or cookiecutter) producing complete, standards-compliant starting points needing no manual correction — including the mechanism by which existing projects adopt later improvements instead of diverging.
* Automated verification in the delivery pipeline — formatting, strict static type checking, architectural boundary rules, interface and schema compatibility, migration checks, security and dependency scanning, automated quality evaluation of AI output — built once as shared components used by every project.
* The machine-readable interfaces between components and roles (for example OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Zod), and the checks that detect when either side has drifted.

**Maintain and evolve the platform**
—
*a core responsibility; it will be in continuous use and change for years, and its value depends on staying dependable while it changes*

* Manage published interfaces: semantic versioning, change logs, migration paths, deprecation, and compatibility tests that catch a breaking change before it reaches a consuming application.
* Assess, validate and complete automated dependency upgrade proposals (for example from Renovate or Dependabot).
* Improve error messages, documentation and reference examples continuously. Where a colleague had to ask a question, treat the question as a defect and remove the need for it.
* Contain scope: add shared capability only where repeated need is demonstrated by more than one real consumer, keeping what a solution author must write as small as possible.

**Collaborate and support**

* Support colleagues using the platform, converting recurring difficulties into tooling, checks, clearer messages or documentation; review code substantively and document design decisions and rationale.
* Express each service's infrastructure, permission and operational requirements as version-controlled declarations that satisfy automated validation, working with infrastructure specialists on anything not yet available.
* Use AI coding assistants (for example Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) effectively and responsibly — scoping work, supplying context, remaining accountable for the output.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome but not required.

**Software engineering**

* Strong Python, with static type checking (mypy, Pyright) and runtime validation (Pydantic) as a normal part of development rather than an added burden; working TypeScript and a modern component-based front-end framework (React, Vue, Angular) with an understanding of strict type safety.
* Well-structured HTTP API design — specification (OpenAPI), versioning, backward compatibility — and relational databases and SQL: schema design, migrations, query behaviour, parameterised queries as an ingrained habit.
* Version control, code review and CI/CD, including authoring and debugging pipeline configuration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins); automated testing at unit, integration and interface-contract level, with judgement about which suits a given risk.

**AI and Generative AI engineering**

* Practical experience integrating large language models into production software: instruction design, tool and function calling, structured output, and management of cost, latency and failure modes. Retrieval-augmented generation in practice — embeddings, vector search (pgvector, FAISS, OpenSearch, Pinecone), retrieval quality.
* Experience with at least one AI agent framework (for example LangGraph, LangChain, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or CrewAI), and the ability to build software that uses it without becoming dependent on its specific types.
* Evaluation of non-deterministic systems. You have defined test cases and quality measures for a system whose output varies — with a framework (Ragas, DeepEval, LangFuse) or a purpose-built harness — and used the results to make a release decision. Automated evaluation is a mandatory gate before deployment here.

**Required**
**Cloud and delivery engineering**
*Infrastructure and production operations are specialist disciplines owned elsewhere in the organisation; our applications request what they need through version-controlled declarations validated automatically, rather than by authoring infrastructure or access policies directly. You are
**not**
expected to author infrastructure modules, access policies or network components, nor to own cloud estate design, release execution or infrastructure on-call. Required at this depth:*

* Containerisation (Docker), and working knowledge of a major public cloud, ideally AWS, at service level — serverless compute (Lambda), object storage (S3), messaging (SQS), secret management, managed databases (Aurora, RDS), managed AI model services (Bedrock) — sufficient to design against them and reason about behaviour, cost, quota and failure.
* Read and review infrastructure-as-code fluently (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation), and understand access permissions at the level of consequence: what a grant allows, and when a request is broader than the task requires.

Operational literacy — interpreting distributed traces and structured logs (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana), defining service level objectives and runbooks — and awareness of delivery security practice: immutable artefacts, build provenance, secret scanning, dependency vulnerability management, short-lived federated credentials

Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management

Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank’s AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.
  
  
The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products.
  
  
As a Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group.
  
  
You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity.
  
  
You will help reduce duplication of knowledge, manual research effort, and rework by transforming fragmented information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, and controls.
  
  
You will build enterprise AI/ML and knowledge platform capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale.
  
  
You will strengthen governance, explainability, and risk management through metadata, provenance, permissions, evaluation, and auditability built into the knowledge lifecycle.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Enterprise Knowledge Products:**
Design and build enterprise-scale knowledge products that transform unstructured information into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets.
  
  
**AI/ML Platform Development:**
Design and develop scalable, production-grade AI/ML platforms and capabilities supporting enterprise AI, knowledge management, retrieval, and GenAI use cases.
  
  
**Ontology, Taxonomy & Knowledge Graphs:**
Develop and maintain enterprise ontology, semantic models, metadata, taxonomy, and knowledge graphs that provide shared context across business domains.
  
  
**Knowledge Platform Engineering:**
Engineer knowledge ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, APIs, integrations, and lifecycle management capabilities for governed knowledge products.
  
  
**Knowledge Governance:**
Build and enforce knowledge governance controls covering ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, permissions, auditability, and lifecycle policies.
  
  
**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**
Implement policy-as-code and deterministic decisioning capabilities to deliver consistent, explainable, and compliant AI outcomes.
  
  
**AI Guardrails & Retrieval Controls:**
Develop AI guardrails, retrieval controls, and policy-aware access mechanisms to ensure only authorised and trusted knowledge is exposed to LLMs and agents.
  
  
**AI & Agent Integration:**
Integrate the knowledge platform with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, and AI platform services to accelerate safe adoption of agentic AI solutions.
  
  
**Quality, Evaluation & Observability:**
Establish quality, observability, evaluation, and feedback loops to continuously improve knowledge accuracy, trustworthiness, retrieval effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration:**
Work across engineering, CAIO, CDO, product teams, business SMEs, and knowledge owners to translate complex business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.
  
  
**Essential Skills:**
**Python Engineering:**
Minimum
**10+ years of strong hands-on experience in Python development**
, with experience building enterprise-grade applications, platforms, APIs, data pipelines, and/or AI/ML solutions.
  
  
Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience developing scalable, reliable, secure, and reusable platform components.
  
  
**AI/ML Platform Development:**
Strong hands-on experience designing and developing
**enterprise AI/ML platforms**
and production-grade AI capabilities.
  
  
Experience with scalable platform architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data/AI pipelines, observability, security, and cloud-native engineering.
  
  
**Knowledge Management & Ontology Development:**
Strong understanding and hands-on experience in
**Knowledge Management and ontology development**
, including knowledge graphs, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems.
  
  
Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines.
  
  
**RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval:**
Hands-on experience in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems.
  
  
Experience building enterprise search, retrieval, discovery, recommendation, or similar knowledge capabilities is desirable.
  
  
**Knowledge Graph & Semantic Technologies:**
Knowledge of semantic and graph technologies including RDF, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, ontology engineering, taxonomy management, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, and graph modelling concepts.
  
  
**Enterprise Knowledge Platform Engineering:**
Proficiency in designing enterprise knowledge platforms with scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cloud-native architecture principles.
  
  
Knowledge of ingestion pipelines, enrichment, retrieval, lifecycle management, APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise platform engineering.
  
  
**Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI:**
Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, permissions, classification, and auditability frameworks.
  
  
Experience implementing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access, evaluation mechanisms, and governance controls for safe consumption of enterprise knowledge.
  
  
**GenAI & Agentic AI Integration:**
Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services.
  
  
Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable.
  
  
**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**
Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes.
  
  
Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable.
  
  
**Programming Languages & Tools:**
Strong proficiency in
**Python with 10+ years of hands-on development experience**
as a key requirement, together with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL exposure for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations.
  
  
Experience with cloud-based AI, knowledge management, semantic technologies, or knowledge graph platforms is desirable.
  
  
**Risk, Compliance & Enterprise Knowledge:**
Knowledge of risk, compliance, regulatory, and control frameworks within highly governed financial services environments is advantageous.
  
  
Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling to capture and operationalise organisational knowledge is desirable.
  
  
**Collaboration & Engineering Capability:**
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
  
Ability to work effectively across engineering, CAIO, CDO, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Clear communication and documentation skills with the ability to explain complex AI/ML platform, knowledge architecture, governance, and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
Strong ownership mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, scalability, and reusable engineering practices.
  
  
**Education Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
  
  
Relevant cloud or AI certifications, including AWS, AI/ML, or Generative AI certifications, are advantageous.

You will build the shared runtime and learning systems that Sycamore’s product engineers and customer applications use to create dependable agents.
  
  
One half of the work is the agent runtime: multi-turn sessions, model routing, tool execution, connectors, memory, human approvals, durable workflows, and the APIs and libraries that expose those capabilities.
  
  
The other half is the intelligence loop around that runtime: collecting useful signals from production behavior, connecting feedback to business outcomes, reproducing failures offline, evaluating changes, and turning what we learn into safer and more capable versions of agents. That can include improvements to prompts, tools, skills, context, memory, retrieval, routing, policies, and—where the evidence supports it—learning or optimization techniques.
  
  
You will also carry these systems all the way into product surfaces. You will build React interfaces for composing and running agents, inspecting live traces and tool calls, reviewing evaluations, resolving approvals, and understanding why a system behaved the way it did. Core AI engineers are expected to own coherent end-to-end slices across backend services, APIs, state, and user experience—not stop at a service boundary.
  
  
You will work closely with Product engineers when a customer workflow exposes a missing primitive or a difficult failure mode. You will find the durable abstraction, build it without overfitting to one deployment, and operate it in production.
  
  
Product owns the customer-specific application and last mile. Infrastructure owns the execution and deployment substrate. Core AI owns the horizontal runtime, intelligence, and improvement capabilities that both depend on, along with the experiences that make those capabilities usable.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Build provider-independent agent loops, state management, streaming, context handling, recovery, and graceful degradation.
* Develop the learning data plane around agents: structured trajectories, feedback and outcome signals, offline datasets, lineage, privacy controls, and reliable links between an agent version and its behavior.
* Create evaluation systems for task completion, tool use, long-horizon behavior, safety, latency, cost, accessibility, and business outcomes.
* Build offline analysis and improvement loops that can surface failure clusters, grow golden datasets, and propose changes to prompts, tools, skills, context, retrieval, memory, policies, and model routing.
* Design experiment and versioning systems for comparing changes through replay, shadow traffic, canaries, or controlled rollouts, with clear promotion and rollback criteria.
* Explore where approaches such as preference learning, reward modeling, reinforcement learning, or continual learning can improve agent behavior—and recognize when a simpler evaluation or systems change is the better answer.
* Build detectors that identify regressions and opportunities across quality, reliability, cost, latency, and user adoption without mistaking noisy proxy metrics for real progress.
* Design typed tool interfaces and protocol-based execution across internal capabilities and customer-authorized services.
* Build connectors and credential flows with explicit read/write modes, permissions, auditability, and predictable failure behavior.
* Develop memory extraction and retrieval while enforcing tenant, user, and project visibility boundaries.
* Build durable orchestration for long-running tasks, checkpoints, approvals, handoffs, timers, and human-in-the-loop interactions.
* Publish reliable APIs, event-driven interfaces, reusable libraries, and pluggable improvement strategies that work across different agent categories and enterprise deployments.
* Build and refine React product surfaces for agent configuration, live execution, traces, evaluations, approvals, and improvement workflows.
* Own full-stack product slices across UI state, streaming, typed APIs, backend services, and persistence, with attention to accessibility, responsiveness, and failure recovery.
* Translate powerful platform primitives into product interactions that enterprise users can understand and trust.
* Debug difficult failures across models, prompts, tools, state, data, experiments, APIs, and distributed services.
* Join customer conversations when a repeated requirement or production outcome reveals a missing horizontal capability.

The environment you will work in
  
  
Our current Core AI environment includes Python cloud services; React and TypeScript product surfaces; asynchronous and streaming systems; typed APIs and data models; relational and vector data; durable workflows; protocol-based tool execution; multiple model providers; and cloud-native deployment.
  
  
We use coding agents, automated tests, traces, evaluations, browser automation, offline replay, cost and latency signals, and production feedback as part of everyday engineering. We are building toward a governed collect, learn, evaluate, and apply loop rather than a single monolithic training system.
  
  
This is context, not a checklist. We do not require previous experience with every language, framework, model provider, cloud platform, database, or infrastructure tool in our stack. Comparable experience building distributed runtimes, experimentation platforms, retrieval or recommendation systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or production AI systems is highly relevant.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  

* 5-12 years of software engineering experience. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction.
* Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including typed API design, asynchronous workflows, persistence, reliability, and production debugging.
* Practical experience shipping LLM, agent, search, retrieval, recommendation, experimentation, workflow, or developer-platform systems into production.
* An empirical approach to AI quality: you can form a hypothesis, design a useful evaluation, interpret noisy evidence, and distinguish a real improvement from movement in a proxy metric.
* The ability to reason about retries, idempotency, partial failure, long-running state, concurrency, latency, cost, experiment design, and safe rollout.
* A security-minded approach to multi-tenant systems, identity, authorization, credentials, tool execution, privacy, and auditability.
* Product judgment. You can find a durable abstraction behind a real requirement without generalizing too early or freezing customer-specific behavior into the platform.
* AI-native. You use coding agents and modern models as a force multiplier while still owning architecture, correctness, evidence, and operational outcomes.
* Clear communication and high EQ. You can work with Product, Infrastructure, customer engineering teams, and applied AI researchers without losing technical depth.
* A generalist mindset and comfort moving between libraries, services, data, experiments, integrations, evaluations, and product surfaces.
* Comfort building product-facing software. You can work in React and TypeScript when a capability needs a great interface, and you can reason about streaming state, accessibility, and end-to-end user experience.
* Comfort with startup ambiguity, fast feedback loops, and broad ownership.

Experience with reinforcement learning, preference learning, reward modeling, post-training, continual learning, ranking, causal inference, or large-scale experimentation is valuable but not required. We care more about whether you can connect learning ideas to production evidence and reliable systems than whether you have used a particular technique.
  
  
Engineers from agent-runtime, distributed-workflow, retrieval, recommendation, experimentation-platform, integration-platform, developer-platform, or production applied-AI backgrounds often do well here. We care more about the systems you personally built, measured, and operated than a particular company, school, language, or model vendor.
  
  
What this role is not
  
  

* It is not a prompt-engineering role detached from software and systems engineering.
* It is not pure foundation-model research. It combines empirical AI work with production systems engineering.
* It is not ungoverned online self-modification or a system that optimizes a metric without understanding its consequences.
* It is not generic infrastructure or cluster ownership.
* It is not the primary owner of one-off customer application delivery.
* It is not a narrow backend role disconnected from agent behavior, learning, and product outcomes.

Interview process
  
  

* A 30-minute introductory conversation.
* Two 60-minute technical interviews, one focused on systems design and one on coding.
* A take-home assignment where you build and present a real solution using the tools you would use on the job.

Why join
  
  

* Build the cloud services that help enterprise agents learn from production experience.
* Work across agent runtimes, tools, connectors, memory, durable workflows, evaluations, experimentation, security, and product.
* Ship Core AI capabilities end to end, from cloud service and API design through the React experience customers use.
* Turn production outcomes into governed improvements used across customers.
* Shape how feedback-driven learning, agent evaluation, and safe self-improvement work in a high-trust enterprise setting.
* Join early enough to shape the Core AI architecture and the India engineering team.
* Work as one engineering team across India and Palo Alto.
* Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build.

title: Applied AI Scientist/Engineer
description:
**Applied AI Scientist/Engineer — Training LLMs for Cybersecurity**

Join Averlon's AI research lab, built to lead research at the frontier of cybersecurity. As attackers increasingly use automation and AI, the security community needs models that can reason about systems, find weaknesses, and help defenders respond faster.

Our lab trains and evaluates large language models (LLMs) across both defensive and offensive security. On the defensive side, it includes triage, mitigation, remediation, detection engineering, and digital forensics. On the offensive side, this includes penetration testing, red teaming, vulnerability discovery, and exploitation. We host our task experts on inference platforms, models specialized for individual security tasks, for use by other companies as well as internally.

As an Applied AI Scientist/Engineer, you will help shape Averlon's research agenda and model capabilities. You will train, evaluate, and benchmark LLMs on real-world security tasks, design reinforcement learning environments, and help publish findings that advance the field.

**About the Team**

The lab aims to publish one to two research papers and technical reports each month, including work on new reinforcement learning frameworks.

Research at Averlon spans LLM post-training involving continual learning, reinforcement learning, as well as agentic tool use, evaluation design, and large-scale benchmarking. You will work closely with our research team and alongside engineers with deep security expertise, who will help you learn the cybersecurity domain on the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Benchmark open-weight and proprietary LLMs on hundreds of offensive and defensive security tasks.
* RL of LLMs for security use cases as a post-training or continual learning process. This involves designing RL environments and reward signals for security tasks, including agentic settings that involve multi-step tool use.
* Track the research literature, reproduce relevant results, and assess new methods for adoption.
* Document results, negative as well as positive, to support internal decision-making.
* Contribute to research papers, technical reports, and blog posts that communicate the lab's findings to the wider community.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Strong grounding in deep learning, evidenced by coursework and hands-on projects in which you trained DNNs or fine tuned LLMs/VLMs.
* Working knowledge of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, and language (or vision) models training.
* Proficiency in Python and in PyTorch or a comparable deep learning framework.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to design rigorous experiments and draw sound conclusions from them.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical results to researchers and engineers.

Prior knowledge of cybersecurity or compute clouds is not necessary. You will learn the domain on the job, working alongside our team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with LLM post-training or continual learning.
* Experience applying reinforcement learning, particularly to language models.
* Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, or EMNLP, including workshop papers and preprints.
* Open-source contributions or software projects that others have adopted.
* Experience running and debugging distributed training on multi-node GPU systems.

**Education and Experience**

* An MS or PhD from the IITs, ISI, IISER, IISc, BITS Pilani, the IIITs, or top NITs is preferred.
* MS and PhD graduates do not need prior professional experience.
* Undergraduate candidates are encouraged to apply if they meet the required qualifications and have hands-on deep learning experience beyond coursework, such as research projects, internships, or publications.

Software Engineering

• Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.

• Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.

Engineering Excellence

• Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.

• Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.

• Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.

• Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

Architecture & Governance

• Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.

• Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.

• Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.

• Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third-party model risk.

• Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.

• Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.

• Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.

• Establish and support communities of practice around AI-assisted software engineering.

• Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.

• Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

As an individual contributor, you will implement models and GenAI features end to end, from data preparation, prompt engineering, agent/workflow building, testing and performance tuning, working within established engineering patterns and under the guidance of senior engineers.
  
  
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role (approximately 90% execution and 10% strategy). You will solve well-defined to moderately complex problems, collaborate closely with the delivery team, and ship reliable AI capabilities that generate value for the business.

* Implement and deploy GenAI features and models, including data preparation, prompt engineering, agent/workflow building, testing and performance tuning, within established engineering patterns.
* Solve well-defined to moderately complex problems, applying proven tools and techniques and escalating novel or architectural challenges to senior engineers.

As a
**Founding AI Engineer at ZynnexAI**
, you will work on building and optimizing the core AI infrastructure powering our conversational and voice AI products.

The role is particularly suited for an engineer interested in speech technologies, LLMs, and applied AI research, who enjoys taking models from experimentation to production.

You will work across the AI stack, including STT, TTS, LLMs, fine-tuning, model evaluation, benchmarking, inference optimization, and deployment. You will experiment with open-source models, explore different architectures, build training and evaluation pipelines, and optimize models for low-latency, real-time voice interactions.

You will also work on intelligent decision-making systems that enable AI agents to understand context, determine appropriate actions, and execute complex workflows.

This is a hands-on founding team role where you will have ownership of AI research, model selection, experimentation, architecture, and production deployment.

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Work Mode:**
Full-time, On-site

Key Responsibilities

* **Voice AI Engineering:**
  Work with STT, TTS, voice activity detection, speech processing, and real-time conversational pipelines.
* **LLM Engineering:**
  Experiment with open-source LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, quantization, and model adaptation for domain-specific use cases.
* **Model Development:**
  Build and optimize neural networks, NLP pipelines, classification models, and intelligent decision-making systems.
* **Model Benchmarking:**
  Evaluate models across accuracy, latency, TTFT, throughput, resource utilization, and inference cost.
* **Training & Fine-tuning:**
  Develop data preparation, synthetic data generation, training, fine-tuning, and evaluation pipelines.
* **Deployment & Optimization:**
  Deploy models on GPU infrastructure, optimize inference, and build scalable model-serving systems.
* **Agent Intelligence:**
  Develop context-aware decision models and reasoning workflows that enable AI agents to take appropriate actions.
* **Research & Experimentation:**
  Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, architectures, frameworks, and techniques to improve our AI stack.

Qualifications

* Strong foundation in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Structures & Algorithms.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Practical understanding of LLM architectures, Transformers, embeddings, tokenization, and inference.
* Interest or experience in voice AI technologies, particularly STT, TTS, speech processing, and conversational systems.
* Experience experimenting with open-source LLMs, fine-tuning, quantization, or model optimization.
* Understanding of model evaluation, benchmarking, and performance metrics.
* Familiarity with GPU-based model deployment, inference frameworks, and serving technologies.
* Experience building APIs and integrating ML models into production applications.
* Ability to independently research, experiment, troubleshoot, and take AI systems from proof of concept to production.

Good to Have

* Experience with frameworks and tools such as Hugging Face, Transformers, vLLM, Ollama, ONNX Runtime, and TensorRT.
* Exposure to speech frameworks and technologies such as Whisper, NeMo, Indic speech models, LiveKit, and real-time audio pipelines.
* Experience with multilingual LLMs, Indian languages, speech synthesis, and voice cloning.
* Familiarity with model quantization techniques such as INT8, INT4, and FP8.
* Experience with GPU infrastructure, distributed inference, and model serving at scale.
* Experience building conversational AI agents, decision-making systems, or agentic workflows.
* Exposure to BFSI, fintech, or other regulated domains.
* **We value strong fundamentals, practical experimentation, and the ability to build things from scratch over familiarity with any particular framework or tool.**

title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
description:
**Description**
Are you excited about building the future of Retail Automation powered by Generative AI?
  
  
Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon's Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enriches ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination, where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow; and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops intelligent automation powered by GenAI, LLM and Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of highly complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time.
  
  
Why join us
  
  
We believe in "Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History" value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you love designing elegant abstractions for messy real world problems, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you get a kick out of seeing your code improve the shopping experience for millions of customers worldwide, we definitely need you. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world's most beloved brands, customer obsession is part of our company DNA. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer II to join the SAMAI team and help us push the boundaries of what's possible with Generative AI in retail automation. As an SDE2, you will not just write code, you will architect systems that think. You will design scalable, distributed platforms that orchestrate LLM powered agents, build robust pipelines that process millions of data points daily, and make critical design trade offs that directly influence a multi billion dollar business. You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, distributed systems and real world business impact. Every system you build will be tested against the unforgiving scale of Amazon's catalog, hundreds of millions of ASINs, dozens of marketplaces and billions of customer interactions. You will collaborate closely with Applied Scientists and senior engineers to turn cutting edge research into production systems that work at scale. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.
  
  
If you enjoy designing and building GenAI powered platforms, highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come join us!
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
RBS Tech team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal and Senior Engineers from RBS Tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'Reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications. And on a team building Gen AI systems every day, the learning opportunities are endless.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are building SAMAI, our Gen AI powered automation platform that is redefining how RBS delivers at scale. SAMAI harnesses the power of LLMs, agentic AI workflows and cutting edge ML to automate complex retail business processes end to end. Think of it as the brain behind RBS's next generation automation, orchestrating intelligent agents that can reason, act and deliver outcomes that previously needed hundreds of human hours. We are not just using Gen AI as a feature; we are building a platform that makes GenAI the foundation of retail operations.

description:

Flipkart is committed to the cause of transforming commerce in India through our investments in

made-in-India technology innovations, customer-centric features and constructs, a diverse category landscape and a world-class supply chain. end-to-end solutions for business functions that lack engineering bandwidth, while also partnering with the

core Data Science team to optimize and scale state-of-the-art models (FK LLMs, Open Source,

Commercial).

management).

task-specific models for cost efficiency.

○ Act as a technical liaison between Business Leaders and Engineering.

○ Design end-to-end architecture for mid-sized AI applications.

○ Mentor Grade 8/9/10 engineers on AI-native workflows.

● Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

● 6-9 years exp. Deep expertise in Distributed Systems & NLP.

● Experience deploying LLMs at scale.

● Strong communication and analytical skills

description:
**Job Opening:**
Gen AI Engineer / Senior Gen AI Engineer

**Experience-**
3-8 years

**About the Role**

* As a Gen AI Engineer / Senior Gen AI Engineer, you will drive the end-to-end architecture, development, and operationalization of production-ready Generative AI solutions. This role goes beyond proof-of-concept experimentation—you will be responsible for building robust, scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, adapting and fine-tuning models for domain-specific requirements, and seamlessly embedding generative capabilities into mission-critical enterprise systems.

**Core Responsibilities**

LLM Architecture & Orchestration: Build, evaluate, and maintain modular LLM workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Design and tune scalable RAG pipelines using vector storage and search engines (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search).

Model Adaptation & Tuning: Fine-tune both open-weight and proprietary foundation models to optimize domain accuracy, inference latency, and computational costs.

API & Service Development: Build asynchronous, high-throughput microservices using FastAPI, containerize via Docker, and deploy across cloud environments (Azure Functions / AWS) for low-latency production serving.

Enterprise Solutions: Architect and scale commercial AI products, autonomous copilots, and structured content automation tools utilizing OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Hugging Face ecosystems.

Prompt Engineering & Tool Use: Establish systematic prompt versioning, structured output parsing, and dynamic context-routing workflows to ensure deterministic performance.

Quality, Evaluation & Observability: Implement automated evaluation suites using frameworks like RAGAS or TruLens to monitor hallucination frequency, retrieval relevance, token drift, and answer faithfulness in real time.

POC to Production Lifecycle: Partner with engineering, data, and product teams to translate enterprise challenges into production-ready AI services with clear operational SLAs.

Engineering Rigor & Governance: Establish development standards for model routing, guardrails, context management, and responsible AI practices.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Total Experience: 3 to 6 years of core software engineering and system design experience.

Specialized GenAI Experience: Minimum of 2 years dedicated to shipping LLM-powered applications, GenAI workflows, and document/OCR processing pipelines to production.

Core Language: Strong command of Python, specifically modern async paradigms (asyncio), strict type annotations, object-oriented design, and maintainable software architecture.

Model Ecosystem: Practical experience integrating both proprietary endpoints (GPT-4o, Claude, Azure OpenAI) and open-weights (Llama 3, Mistral), alongside modern agentic design patterns.

Retrieval & Vector Search: Hands-on expertise implementing hybrid search (dense semantic + sparse BM25/lexical), re-ranking strategies (cross-encoders), metadata partitioning, and index optimization.

Deployment & Cloud Infrastructure: Solid foundation in containerization (Docker), API framework design (FastAPI), CI/CD release automation, and cloud services (Azure or AWS).

Engineering Problem Solving: Demonstrated capability in resolving real-world GenAI hurdles, including hallucination mitigation, context-window compression/budgeting, and data grounding verification.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
Software Development Engineer II, ML Systems — Marketing (Meta/SEM Bidding)
  
  
**Introduction to the team**
We create and deliver an aligned, dedicated marketing strategy to fuel each Expedia Group brand's success. Since our travelers interact with us through our brands, we have a brand focus in our marketing, while leveraging the scale and efficiency we've built in functional expertise.
  
  
The Meta/SEM Bidding Programs team builds and operates the high-scale data and machine learning systems that power our bidding programs. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who writes clean, reliable, production-grade software and partners closely with machine learning engineers to build the pipelines, services, and platform that bring ML models to life in production.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Implement and enhance well-scoped software and data components within complex, business-critical services — from design input through coding, testing, deployment, and production support, with guidance on larger decisions.
* Build and maintain the data pipelines, services, and infrastructure that support model training, evaluation, and serving, working alongside ML engineers to turn experimental workflows into robust production systems.
* Contribute to batch and streaming (online) data and inference workflows, learning how models are trained, served, and monitored at scale.
* Instrument systems and pipelines to capture operational and quality metrics (latency, throughput, errors, and key business signals), and help diagnose and resolve production issues.
* Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and incident response, taking ownership of the reliability and observability of the components you build.
* Use AI as a co-pilot across the software development lifecycle — to clarify requirements, generate and refine code, and strengthen automated tests — and apply generative AI/LLM techniques where they add value.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Strong problem-solving skills — the ability to deeply understand a problem and reason clearly about the right approach — which we value above any single technology.
* 2+ years of relevant professional experience building and shipping production software, ideally including data-intensive or backend services in a cloud or hybrid environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* A strong command of Python, along with experience building APIs and services (FastAPI, REST).
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
* Experience building, deploying, and supporting distributed systems and cloud services on AWS, including contributing to monitoring, alerting, and basic performance improvements.
* Experience running containerized and orchestrated workloads with Kubernetes at scale.
* Working knowledge of Go and Spark (Scala/PySpark) or similar big data frameworks, including basic evaluation, optimization, and debugging of large-scale data processing applications.
* Familiarity with a range of databases (e.g., Hive, Iceberg, Postgres) and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Flyte, Argo).
* Exposure to MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment and monitoring tooling) and to machine learning concepts or ML pipelines — deep ML expertise is not required, but curiosity and a willingness to grow into data/ML engineering are important.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent) in day-to-day work, consistent with Expedia Group's expectation that engineers actively build and apply AI skills.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Data and Applied Scientist -(AIREE) ARC - AI Research to Capability
description:
**We help the world run better**
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
  
  
**Machine Learning Engineer**
**What You'll Do**

* At SAP, we amplify the strength of AI technology, fusing it with our robust industry-focused data
* and deep process knowledge. ARC (AI Research to Capability) is the engineering team inside AI
* Research, Experiments and Evaluation (AIREE) that turns new AI research into real capabilities
* for SAP products. We pick up new ideas, pressure-test them with experiments, measure them
* with rigorous evaluations, and ship the winners to production alongside product teams.
* As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will be the bridge between research and production. You
* will take promising experiments, PoCs, and evaluation tooling and turn them into scalable,
* reliable, cloud-native services and APIs that bring AI capabilities — including LLM- and agent-
* based solutions — into the hands of SAP's Lines of Business, product teams, and customers worldwide.

**The Role**

* Design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning services and APIs on SAP Business
* Technology Platform (BTP) and other cloud platforms.
* Productionize experiments and PoCs — taking research prototypes from the ARC team to
* production-ready state with high availability, performance, and reliability.
* Build and maintain reusable AI engineering foundations: agent harnesses, SDKs, MCP
* servers and tools, and common components that other teams can adopt.
* Operationalize evaluation tooling and observability at scale, so teams know whether their AI
* is ready before release and stays healthy after it ships.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and MLOps workflows to
* streamline model deployment, versioning, and monitoring.
* Collaborate with data and applied scientists to productionize models, optimize inference
* performance, and integrate capabilities seamlessly into enterprise applications.
* Build robust, secure, and compliant cloud-native applications, leveraging containerization
* (Docker, Kubernetes) and serverless architectures.
* Contribute to architectural decisions for ML and AI platforms, balancing scalability, cost,and developer experience.
* Stay current with advances in MLOps, cloud engineering, Generative AI, and agentic
* systems — and bring what works back into the team's foundations.

**What You Bring**

* 5 +years of professional experience in software engineering or machine learning
* engineering, with a strong focus on cloud-native development and ML model deployment.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or
* another relevant discipline.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is strongly preferred;
* experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is also valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, with experience using ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow,
* Hugging Face, or similar.
* Solid experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD
* tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Working knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, deployment pipelines,
* monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
* Understanding of LLM serving frameworks and inference optimization techniques is a plus.
* Exposure to Knowledge Graph technologies (e.g., RDF, SPARQL, property graphs, Cypher)
* or vector databases is a plus.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile and cross-
* cultural teams.
* A curiosity to experiment with and adopt emerging technologies and frameworks.

**Meet your team**
ARC sits inside SAP's AI Research, Experiments and Evaluation (AIREE) organization — thebridge between AI research on one side and LoBs, Joule, and product engineering teams onthe other. We run fast experiments, build evaluation tools and reusable engineering foundations, and carry the winners from research idea to working capability in production. Based in Bangalore, you will join a dynamic, innovative, and globally connected team where engineeringexcellence meets cutting-edge AI research, with abundant opportunities for personal growth,echnical depth, and cross-border collaboration.
  
  
#SAPBusinessAICareers #SAPAICareers
  
  
**Bring out your best**
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. * Design, implement and track key metrics; and architect data-driven solutions.
* Improve machine learning infrastructure for scalable training and inference.
* Innovate and develop proof of concept solutions showcasing novel capabilities.

* Excellent programming skills – Python (required) and C++ (desired).
* 9+ yrs with Research or industry experience within computer vision and machine learning models.
* Ability to take abstract product concepts and turn them into reality.
* Ability to innovate on cutting-edge problems without documented solutions.

* Experience with time-series data
* Experience with Camera calibration, multi-view geometry, 3D reconstruction, SLAM.
* Experience with road scene understanding (objects, lanes, intersections, signs etc.)

title: Applied Scientist
description:
**Description**
Help millions of authors around the world get their books published, discovered, and supported. As one of the first scientists on our new team in Bengaluru, you'll help turn ideas into models authors rely on every day, building agentic solutions with large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, and fine-tuning.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build the multi-agent system behind KDP's author support assistant: orchestration across specialized agents and tools, personalization, and the evaluation that drives its continuous improvement.
* Build multimodal models of book attributes, and use them for similar-book search across languages, catalog quality, and category and keyword recommendations.
* Post-train open models on KDP expertise (for example with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning), and deploy them where they beat general-purpose models on accuracy, cost, or speed.
* Work closely with our scientists in the US and with engineering partners to take your work to production, design rigorous offline and online experiments, and write clear readouts with recommendations.

**About The Team**
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) lets anyone publish a book. We are the science organization for Amazon's Books business, now building our science teams in Bengaluru. Our team works in three connected areas: a support assistant that answers authors' questions from their own account data, in every language KDP supports; multimodal models that use book attributes to keep the catalog trustworthy and help authors reach the right readers; and fine-tuned models that power the assistant and catalog models with KDP expertise. We serve authors, from first-time writers to full-time publishers. You will work closely with engineering, product, and policy partners. We value safety before speed and shared foundations over one-off fixes. Scientists here get dedicated time for innovation, which can lead to patents and conference papers.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
* 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building LLM-based agents or multimodal generative AI workflows, including tool use, retrieval-augmented generation, or evaluation
* Experience fine-tuning or post-training models, including with reinforcement learning
* Experience with large-scale retrieval, embeddings, or ranking, including text and image embeddings
* Experience with multilingual natural language processing or computer vision
* Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting

title: Applied Scientist II, Advertising Trust
description:
**Description**
Amazon Advertising operates at a scale few places in the world can match, and every ad shown to a customer must meet a high bar for trust and quality. We are looking for an Applied Scientist II to advance the machine learning systems that evaluate advertising content at scale — balancing accuracy, latency, and cost so that we protect the customer experience without slowing advertisers down. You will own meaningful scientific problems end to end: framing the problem, building and validating models, and taking them to production where they make decisions on live traffic.
  
  
This is a hands-on science role with real ownership. You will work across large multilingual datasets, modern ML and large language model techniques, and tight engineering constraints, partnering closely with other scientists, engineers, and product teams to turn research into measurable customer impact.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and ship ML models and systems that classify and evaluate content accurately and efficiently at scale.
* Translate ambiguous business and policy problems into well-scoped scientific problems with clear success metrics.
* Apply and adapt modern techniques — including deep learning, representation learning, and large/small language models — to production problems under real latency and cost constraints.
* Own the full model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining in response to drift and changing requirements.
* Define evaluation methodology and the metrics that matter (precision, recall, cost of error, latency), and defend trade-offs with evidence.
* Collaborate with engineering and product partners to integrate models into live systems, and mentor junior scientists.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience programming or scripting language like Python, Java, C or C++
* Experience in investigating, designing, prototyping, and delivering new and innovative system solutions

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience with machine learning techniques for fast and accurate extraction of visual features of humans (i.e. shape, pose, segmentation) from photographs
