**Recruiter: Mounika Nagabhiru**
**Hiring Manager: Dinesh Negi**
**Career Grade: E**
**Internal Closing Date: 15-July-2026**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a GenAI Engineer to create, build, and scale production-grade Generative AI solutions that drive measurable business impact across enterprise operations. In this role, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, LLM-powered applications — including copilots, conversational agents, document intelligence platforms, and AI-driven automation deeply integrated with core enterprise systems.
  
  
You will work hands-on with leading managed and open-source LLM platforms — including Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models — alongside enterprise-grade create frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot Studio. A critical dimension of this role is integrating GenAI capabilities into SAP S/4HANA and adjacent enterprise applications using APIs, events, OData services, and process orchestration.
  
  
This is a high-impact engineering role sitting at the intersection of AI innovation and enterprise technology. You will collaborate closely with product managers, SAP functional teams, backend engineers, and cloud platform architects to deliver AI capabilities that are not just technically sound but secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
** GenAI Platform Engineering:**

* Create, develop, and deploy GenAI solutions using Azure OpenAI Service and AWS Bedrock, selecting appropriate foundation models (GPT-4o, Claude, Titan, Llama, Mistral) based on use-case requirements.
* Build, configure, and publish enterprise copilots using Microsoft Copilot Studio or equivalent low-code/pro-code frameworks, integrating with M365, Teams, SharePoint, and Dataverse.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines using vector databases (Azure AI Search, OpenSearch, Pinecone) and structured knowledge bases.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies — including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, and system instruction create — to optimize LLM output quality and consistency.

** Enterprise System Integration:**

* Integrate GenAI capabilities with SAP S/4HANA using OData APIs, SAP Business Accelerator Hub connectors, event-driven architectures (SAP Event Mesh, BTP), and process triggers
* Build and maintain secure API layers (REST, GraphQL) tyingcting AI services to ERP, CRM, and operational data sources
* Collaborate with SAP functional and Basis teams to align AI touchpoints with existing business processes, authorization models, and data governance policies

** Architecture & Collaboration:**

* Contribute to GenAI architecture decisions including platform selection, cost optimization strategies, multi-region deployment, and security design.
* Mentor associate engineers and participate in internal knowledge sharing through design reviews, documentation, and community of practice sessions.
* Engage with product managers and business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into technically feasible AI solution designs.

** Evaluation, Monitoring & Capable AI:**

* Design and implement LLM evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, cost per token, and end-user satisfaction metrics.
* Establish monitoring pipelines for production AI applications using tools such as Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, and LangSmith.
* Apply capableble AI practices including content filtering, guardrails (Azure Content Safety, Bedrock Guardrails), bias detection, and explainability mechanisms.
* Manage model versioning, deprecation cycles, and prompt version control to ensure production stability

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on Generative AI, LLMs, or applied ML in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI Service and AWS Bedrock — including model deployment, API integration, token management, and cost governance.
* Practical experience building copilots or AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Studio, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agentic frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RAG architecture, vector embeddings, chunking strategies, and retrieval optimization.
* Proficiency in Python (primary) and at least one secondary language (TypeScript, Java, or Node.js).
* Experience integrating AI services with enterprise systems — ideally SAP S/4HANA — using OData, REST APIs, or event-driven patterns.
* Solid understanding of enterprise security requirements including OAuth 2.0, managed identities, RBAC, secret management, and data residency compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms: Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP for deploying and scaling AI workloads.
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines for AI application deployments.
* Experience with SAP Joule and SAP AI Core.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) services, SAP Integration Suite, or SAP AI Core

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
**Our Package**
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Distinguished Research Engineer - Speech & Language AI
description:
**About GreyLabs AI**

GreyLabs AI is an Agentic AI company transforming how businesses interact with their customers through Voice AI and Conversational AI. We build AI solutions for enterprise customers, particularly in Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), where accuracy, reliability, latency and cost are critical.

Our ambition is to build AI models that power conversations touching billions of lives every day. We are focused on developing intelligent, reliable and efficient models that deliver exceptional quality while operating at massive scale.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an exceptional AI researcher and engineer to shape and build GreyLabs’ next generation of speech and language models.

This is a senior, deeply technical role for someone with substantial hands-on model-building experience who wants to own a major AI charter at a high-growth startup. We value demonstrated technical depth and shipped model outcomes over tenure alone.

You will work across speech recognition, language models, model training and adaptation, and inference optimisation. You will define technical direction, solve our hardest modelling challenges, and translate research into production systems powering real-world Voice AI applications.

This is a builder-leader role, not a management-only position. You should be comfortable writing code, designing and running experiments, debugging model failures, fine-tuning models and optimising inference yourself. You will set direction while remaining directly involved in the hardest technical problems, and mentor researchers and engineers as the team grows.

You will own the end-to-end speech and language model charter—from research strategy and model development to production deployment and continuous improvement. You will make build-versus-adapt decisions and be accountable for model quality, inference economics and production performance.

The mission is to build models that deliver the right balance of quality, scale, latency and cost, creating differentiated AI capabilities for Indian languages and enterprise conversations.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Build and Advance Speech Models**

* Develop, train, fine-tune and improve Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models for Indian English, Hindi, code-mixed speech, regional languages, diverse accents and BFSI terminology.
* Solve real-world challenges including noisy telephony audio, Indian names, numbers, dates, financial terminology and other business-critical entities.
* Drive model architecture, training, domain adaptation, data strategy and evaluation to improve performance on real-world conversations.
* Explore emerging speech architectures, training techniques and modelling approaches to push the boundaries of recognition quality and efficiency.

**2. Develop Language Models for Conversational AI**

* Research, adapt and optimise open-weight LLMs for real-time voice conversations and enterprise use cases.
* Improve instruction following, tool calling, conversational consistency, task completion and adherence to business rules.
* Evaluate emerging models and training techniques, making informed decisions about fine-tuning, post-training, distillation and training from scratch where justified.
* Develop systematic approaches to identify and address hallucinations, reasoning failures and inconsistent model behaviour.

**3. Build for Scale, Quality and Cost**

* Design and optimise model architectures and inference systems for high throughput, low latency and reliable production performance.
* Improve compute efficiency, GPU utilisation and cost per call or minute through techniques such as quantisation, batching, distillation and inference optimisation.
* Establish rigorous benchmarks for model quality, latency, throughput, reliability and cost, ensuring improvements translate into measurable customer outcomes.
* Take models from research and experimentation to production at enterprise scale, with robust monitoring, regression testing and continuous improvement.

**4. Own Technical Direction and Research**

* Own the technical roadmap for GreyLabs’ speech and language models, identifying high-impact research and engineering opportunities.
* Make build-versus-adapt decisions across open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation and training from scratch, based on quality, latency, cost and strategic differentiation.
* Build robust datasets, evaluation frameworks and experimentation pipelines using representative, appropriately governed conversational data.
* Stay at the forefront of advances in speech and language modelling and translate relevant research into practical product capabilities.
* Make critical architecture and research investment decisions based on technical merit, scalability, quality and business impact.
* Establish high standards for scientific rigour, reproducibility and engineering excellence.

**5. Mentor and Multiply Technical Talent**

* Mentor and collaborate with research engineers, applied scientists and ML engineers.
* Lead through technical depth: review architectures, challenge assumptions, guide experiments and help solve the most difficult problems.
* Help recruit and develop a high-calibre team while remaining personally involved in critical model-building work.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, ownership, technical excellence and measurable outcomes.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Substantial experience in AI, machine learning, speech technology or related fields, typically 13–15+ years, with a strong record of hands-on model building.
* Deep expertise in at least one of speech recognition, speech-language modelling or language model development, with the ability to influence work across the broader speech and LLM stack.
* A proven track record of personally building, training, fine-tuning or materially improving models—not just integrating APIs or managing teams that do the work.
* Strong foundations in deep learning, model architectures, optimisation and experimentation, with hands-on proficiency in Python, PyTorch and modern ML frameworks.
* Experience taking models from research to production, including evaluation, inference optimisation, deployment and performance at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to make sound technical trade-offs across quality, latency, computational requirements and cost.
* Ability to operate independently, challenge conventional approaches and take ownership of complex technical problems.
* A track record of mentoring engineers or researchers and influencing technical direction through strong individual technical contributions.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience at a frontier AI research lab, a research-intensive technology company or a startup that builds its own models.
* Experience with multilingual ASR, Indian languages, code-switching, speech processing or challenging real-world audio.
* Experience with large-scale training, LLM post-training, model distillation, inference optimisation or model-serving systems.
* An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Speech Processing or a related field—or equivalent demonstrated technical depth.
* Significant technical contributions demonstrated through research publications, open-source projects, model releases or production deployments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Establish a clear, outcome-oriented technical roadmap for GreyLabs’ speech and language models.
* Deliver measurable improvements in recognition accuracy, conversational quality, latency, reliability and cost per interaction.
* Take improved models from experimentation into production at enterprise scale.
* Reduce dependence on expensive proprietary model APIs where open-weight or internally adapted models can meet quality and performance requirements.
* Establish robust evaluation and research-to-production workflows that enable continuous model improvement.
* Build differentiated technical capabilities for Indian enterprise Voice AI and support conversations at massive scale.

**Why Join GreyLabs AI?**

* **Build AI that matters:**
  Develop models with the ambition to power conversations touching billions of lives every day.
* **Own a major technical charter:**
  Shape the research, architecture and evolution of core AI capabilities.
* **Stay hands-on:**
  Solve challenging modelling and engineering problems rather than moving exclusively into people management.
* **Build for real-world impact:**
  Take ideas from research to production systems where quality, scale and cost all matter.
* **Influence the future of AI:**
  Work with talented engineers and researchers and help establish a world-class model-building capability.

title: AI and Agent Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior AI and Agent Engineer will develop, integrate, test, deploy, and monitor AI-enabled applications and agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. The role is responsible for the intelligence, orchestration, actions, integrations, and behavioral quality of AI solutions.
  
  
This is an AI application engineering role, not a prompt-writing position. The successful candidate must be able to build production software, integrate enterprise systems, create evaluation frameworks, troubleshoot complex behavior, and operate deployed solutions.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**AI and agent development**

* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, triggers, workflows, and generative orchestration.
* Develop AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure services.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, multistep orchestration, and human approval patterns.
* Develop custom APIs, Azure Functions, connectors, and supporting application services.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Power Platform, and approved enterprise systems.

**Prompt, context, and behavior engineering**

* Develop system instructions, prompts, grounding logic, response structures, fallback behavior, and escalation rules.
* Implement model selection and routing based on accuracy, risk, latency, and consumption requirements.
* Design agent behavior that distinguishes between answering, recommending, requesting clarification, escalating, and taking action.
* Maintain version control for prompts, instructions, tools, actions, and model configurations.

**Testing and evaluation**

* Develop evaluation datasets with practice SMEs.
* Automate tests for groundedness, relevance, completeness, citation quality, task completion, response consistency, and escalation behavior.
* Perform adversarial testing involving prompt injection, data leakage, unsupported instructions, excessive agency, and unauthorized actions.
* Build regression tests to detect changes caused by models, prompts, source content, integrations, or application releases.
* Document known limitations and expected failure behavior.

**Operations and improvement**

* Instrument solutions for usage, latency, failures, cost, task completion, user feedback, and model behavior.
* Review production telemetry and interaction patterns.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective changes.
* Optimize token consumption, retrieval performance, application latency, and integration reliability.
* Develop reusable agent templates, integration components, evaluation harnesses, and error-handling patterns.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python development skills.
* TypeScript or JavaScript development experience.
* REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, OpenAPI, webhooks, and event-driven integration.
* Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and Azure AI Search.
* Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, SharePoint, and Teams integration.
* Retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, and structured generation.
* Agent orchestration, state management, tool invocation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Automated testing, Git, pull requests, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
* Application Insights, Azure Monitor, logging, alerting, and performance diagnostics.
* Understanding of prompt injection, data exfiltration, overreliance, hallucination, unsafe actions, and AI-specific failure modes.

**Preferred Experience**

* 5 or more years of software, integration, automation, or data application development.
* Demonstrated production experience with generative AI or conversational AI applications.
* Experience building applications across Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure.
* Familiarity with Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Basic C# experience within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience in regulated, confidential, or professional-services environments.

**Success Measures**

* Evaluation performance against approved acceptance thresholds.
* Task-completion and appropriate-escalation rates.
* Production defect and regression rates.
* Retrieval and grounding quality.
* Response latency and cost per transaction.
* Integration reliability.
* Reuse of standard components.
* Completeness of technical documentation and automated testing.
* Speed and effectiveness of incident remediation.

**Role Boundaries**
This role engineers the behavior of AI applications. Practice SMEs remain accountable for defining and validating authoritative professional content, business rules, acceptable conclusions, and circumstances requiring human review.

Target Tech is on a mission to build the systems, tools, and platforms that enable our teams, guests, and partners to operate effectively and deliver meaningful experiences at scale.
  
  
Our AI Platform team is focused on building production-grade AI capabilities that can be adopted across engineering and business use cases. The team works at the intersection of modern AI, software engineering, and distributed systems to build reliable platforms that make AI useful beyond experimentation and into real production environments.
  
  
We are building capabilities around LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, and tool-enabled workflows, with a strong focus on reliability, observability, scalability, and responsible engineering.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a
**Senior Engineer - AI Platform**
, you will be a senior individual contributor responsible for designing and building production-grade AI capabilities and helping shape the technical direction of the platform.
  
  
You will work hands-on across
**LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, MCP, Java/Kotlin and distributed systems**
, translating emerging AI capabilities into reliable software that can operate at scale.
  
  
The role is a combination of strong software engineering and practical AI engineering. You will be expected to make sound architectural decisions, solve complex technical problems, contribute to engineering standards, and mentor other engineers.
  
  
The key to success in this role is having
**real production experience building and shipping AI applications**
, not just experimenting with LLMs or proof-of-concepts.
  
  
Use your skills, experience, and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals.
  
  
**AI Engineering & Agentic Systems**

* LLM Applications: Build and integrate production-grade applications using large language models, including prompt engineering, model integration, structured outputs, and inference workflows.
* RAG: Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions covering retrieval, embeddings, metadata filtering, reranking, grounding, citations, and evaluation.
* AI Agents: Build agentic workflows using agent frameworks and tool-enabled architectures, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-step agent interactions.
* Agent Architecture: Design reliable patterns for agent, tool, and service interactions with clear separation of responsibilities and measurable execution behavior.
* Evaluation & Quality: Build approaches to evaluate AI systems for correctness, reliability, grounding, tool usage, and regression across model and prompt changes.

**Software Engineering & Architecture**

* System Design: Design scalable, resilient distributed systems that support AI workloads and high-volume production use cases.
* Java / Kotlin Engineering: Build backend services using Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native patterns.
* Architecture: Drive design decisions for core platform components, balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, and operational requirements.
* Code Quality & Mentorship: Raise engineering standards through thoughtful code reviews, design reviews, mentoring, and strong implementation practices.
* Technical Problem Solving: Investigate and resolve complex issues across distributed services, AI workflows, performance, latency, and production reliability.

**Platform Reliability & Observability**

* Production Reliability: Build AI systems that are resilient, fault-tolerant, and suitable for production workloads.
* Observability: Design monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, and operational signals that make AI applications measurable and diagnosable.
* Performance: Identify and improve latency, throughput, resource utilization, and model/tool execution efficiency.
* Operational Excellence: Participate in production readiness, incident analysis, reliability improvements, and engineering practices that reduce operational toil.

**Requirements**

* Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 4–7 years of software engineering experience, with meaningful experience as a senior individual contributor.
* AI Experience: Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered or agentic applications into production.
* LLM / GenAI: Strong experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and production AI application patterns.
* RAG: Practical experience building RAG systems, including retrieval, embeddings, metadata filtering, reranking, grounding, and evaluation.
* Agentic AI: Experience with AI agent frameworks, tool calling, agent orchestration, MCP, or similar agentic architectures.
* Backend Engineering: Strong proficiency in Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot, with experience building APIs and distributed services.
* Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of microservices, asynchronous systems, APIs, resilience, scalability, and failure handling.
* Reliability & Observability: Hands-on experience building production systems with monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational readiness.
* Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud-native environments and technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and managed cloud services.
* Engineering Practices: Strong coding, debugging, design, testing, code review, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience building multi-agent systems or agent-to-agent architectures.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool/context integration patterns.
* Experience with vector databases, embedding systems, reranking, or modern retrieval infrastructure.
* Experience designing AI evaluation frameworks, including deterministic evaluation, LLM-based evaluation, and production regression testing.
* Experience with observability platforms and distributed tracing for AI or microservice workloads.
* Experience working with Kafka, Redis, or other distributed infrastructure technologies.
* Experience building internal platforms or reusable AI capabilities consumed by multiple engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of AI system reliability, security, governance, and responsible engineering practices.

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, success means becoming a strong technical owner for important AI platform capabilities and helping move the team from experimentation to reliable production engineering.
  
  
**You Will Be Expected To**

* Own and deliver major AI platform components.
* Make architectural decisions and defend them with data and engineering judgment.
* Build AI capabilities that are reliable, observable, and reusable.
* Establish strong engineering practices for agentic and LLM-based systems.
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the team.
* Help shape the platform's next generation of AI and agentic capabilities.

title: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
description:
**Description**
Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.
  
  
The Mission
  
  
Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.
  
  
What You'll Build
  
  
You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.
  
  
Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.
  
  
This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  

* Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models
* Track record of building scalable ML systems
* Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
* Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As an Applied Scientist-II, you'll be a key contributor to end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—developing and refining algorithms that detect and eliminate false information, building models that identify vulnerabilities exploited by bad actors, and training systems that understand human values across diverse cultures. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily.
  
  
But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll contribute to identifying, defining, and mitigating AI safety risks early—helping protect customers before they're impacted—while building deep expertise in responsible AI. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. Every model you build and every experiment you run—from consensus-driven reasoning modules to orchestration components—will directly strengthen trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI.
  
  
The term “sensitive content” includes within its scope a wide range of categories of content such as offensive content (e.g., hate speech, racist speech), profanity, content that is suitable only for certain age groups, politically polarizing content, and religiously polarizing content. The term “content” refers to any material that is exposed to customers by Alexa (including both 1P and 3P experiences) and includes text, speech, audio, and video.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

title: Forward deployed AI engineer
description:
**Forward-Deployed AI Engineer | Outcome Engineering | Mid-senior**

You own an AI system from first commit to the client's reported outcome: built on their data, running inside their IT, measured against a number agreed before you wrote any code. Every enterprise has a demo that worked once. You build the one that is still working in month six.

**Your Mission: The Role**

Outcome Engineering
is how Searce turns AI from a pilot into a line on the P&L. As a Forward-Deployed AI Engineer, you own the whole chain: scope the outcome, prove it with working software, harden it for production, and stay until the number moves.

You will build with the best models from Google, Anthropic and OpenAI, route between them on merit, and be judged on outcomes, not demos. The agent is the last tool we reach for, not the first.

If you write production Python, can argue with a CFO about a number, and have opinions on eval harnesses you would defend in a code review, this is your seat. Bring the opinions. We bring real data and a problem that has a budget.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Prove it in days, not decks**

* **Own the POC end to end:**
  Scope it against an outcome metric agreed upfront, build it on real client data, and demo working software.
* **Win the room with code:**
  Run workshops and demos for CxOs and engineers where the thing on screen is the thing being sold.

**Build agents that survive production**

* **Architect the system:**
  Orchestrate with Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK or OpenAI Agents SDK. Connect agents to enterprise data, APIs and business systems through standard tool and context interfaces (MCP). Handle sessions, memory, vector and state storage, and sandboxed tool execution.
* **Make it deterministic where it must be:**
  Output validation, tool routing, fallbacks and hybrid model routing.
* **Ship the evals before the agent:**
  Evaluation suites and tracing are part of the build, tracked as eval pass rate.

**Ship it into the client's world**

* **Run it inside enterprise IT:**
  Turn the reference architecture into a secure, observable production system. Success is tracked as POC-to-production conversion.
* **Tune for performance and cost:**
  Across Google, Anthropic and OpenAI stacks, tracked as cost per task.
* **Stay until it is real:**
  Monitor drift, bias and privacy, and report the client's outcome number back to the client.

**Compound every deployment**

* **Be the engineer the CxO trusts:**
  Say what not to build as readily as what to build.
* **Leave patterns behind:**
  Reference architectures, eval sets and agent templates that make the next Searce deployment faster. Track what is emerging across ADK, Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK, and adopt only what survives production.

**Functional Skills**

* **Problem Framing:**
  Turns a vague ambition into a testable hypothesis with a number attached.
* **Systems Judgment:**
  Knows when the answer is an agent, a workflow, a script, or "don't build it."
* **Technical Storytelling:**
  Explains an agent's behavior and trade-offs to a CFO and to a staff engineer without changing the substance.
* **Commercial Sense:**
  Ties architecture choices to cost, revenue and risk.
* **Ownership Under Ambiguity:**
  Moves forward in messy client environments with no spec and no hand-holding.

**Tech Superpowers**

* **Agentic Systems Depth:**
  Hands-on with Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph. Fluent in MCP and A2A, session and memory management, and sandboxed execution. Computer-use agents are a plus.
* **Evals and Observability:**
  You have built evaluation harnesses and agent tracing for systems in production.
* **Retrieval and State:**
  RAG, vector stores, prompt caching, hybrid model routing.
* **Production Engineering:**
  Strong Python, APIs and microservices. Delivery on GCP (Vertex AI), AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker) or Azure (OpenAI/Foundry), with enterprise security and responsible-AI practice (monitoring, bias, privacy).
* **AI-Native Build Workflow:**
  Ships daily with Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, and knows where not to trust them.

**Experience & Relevance**

* 5+ years in software engineering, including 2+ shipping LLM or agent systems to production.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* At least one production agent, copilot or AI workflow with real users, and the metric it moved.
* Delivery in a complex or regulated enterprise environment.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About the job

Company: AutoVRse

Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: On-site/work from office

Experience: 2-4 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: Up to 12 lacs

**About AutoVRse**

AutoVRse is a Bengaluru-based industrial XR and AI company building VR Training, AR/AI solutions and Smart Glasses based solutions for enterprise clients in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, oil & gas, and allied sectors. We work with some of the largest industrial organizations in India and globally, and we're scaling rapidly off a recent funding round. Since 2016 we have run 250+ deployments, worked with 100+ enterprise clients, and trained over 300,000 workers across manufacturing, pharma, energy, oil and gas.

**About the Role**

We are building AI products for real industrial workflows - systems that have to make sense of video, images, audio, documents and structured data together, and produce reliable, grounded output that a plant team can actually act on.

We already have strong engineers who know how to build and scale production software: a Unity-based product used by external developers, and Node.js and React services running at scale on AWS. What we are adding is a different kind of engineer - someone who has spent the last few years deep inside applied AI, has built multiple AI systems, watched some of them fail, worked out why, tried alternative architectures, compared models, and developed an instinct for which approach is appropriate for which problem.

This is not a role for someone whose AI experience is limited to calling LLM APIs.

A typical problem here is not “which prompt should we send to GPT?”. It is closer to: “given these SOP documents, plant videos, inspection photos and field recordings, what combination of parsing, retrieval, embeddings, vision models, LLMs and deterministic processing gives us the most reliable result?”

Sometimes the correct answer will be an LLM. Sometimes it will be a VLM, an embedding model, a reranker, a classical ML or vision technique, or an entirely different architecture. We expect you to know the difference - and to be able to say “not with this data, not yet” when that is the honest answer. You will own AI work end to end, including its integration into our existing services, and you will have real influence on what we build.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own AI systems end to end - problem framing, retrieval and model design, evaluation, deployment, and integration into our Node.js and React services.
* Design, test and rebuild retrieval architectures - chunking and indexing strategies, dense vs sparse vs hybrid retrieval, reranking, multimodal and cross-modal retrieval - and understand why each one breaks.
* Work on multimodal understanding across video, images, audio and documents: knowledge extraction, structured information generation, grounding and citations, and hallucination reduction.
* Select and benchmark models rather than defaulting to them - LLMs, VLMs, embedding models, rerankers, vision and OCR models, speech models and smaller specialist models - and make the case for the boring option when it is the right one.
* Build evaluation before features: ground-truth sets, benchmarks, failure taxonomies and regression checks.
* Optimize inference for latency and cost, and design agentic / multi-stage workflows and model routing where they genuinely earn their complexity.
* Look at a new customer data source and quickly identify what is technically possible, what is not, and what would need to be in place first - with your confidence level stated.
* Prototype fast, discard fast, and document what you learned.
* Raise the AI engineering capability of the wider team. You will be explaining and teaching as much as building.

**Required Skills**

* 1-3 years of hands-on applied AI experience, with multiple AI projects that reached real users.
* Excellent Python and fluency with the surrounding ecosystem: PyTorch, Transformers / Hugging Face, NumPy, Pandas, vector databases, LlamaIndex / LangChain or equivalent, and model APIs and inference SDKs.
* Multiple retrieval approaches built and compared - dense vs sparse vs hybrid, embedding model selection for a given dataset, when reranking materially helps, how to index large documents or long videos - with an opinion on where each one fell over, and a view on when RAG is the wrong architecture entirely.
* A clear, practical understanding of what LLMs are good at, what their output quality actually depends on, and where a non-generative model is simply the better tool.
* Breadth beyond the heavily marketed AI stack - open-source models, vision and multimodal embedding models, object detection and image understanding, speech and audio models, OCR and document intelligence, and newly published architectures and retrieval techniques.
* Production experience - AI services and APIs you have shipped and that were actually used, deployment on cloud infrastructure, async and distributed processing, queues and background jobs, observability, and handling large, messy real-world datasets.
* Comfort going from a paper, model card or repository to a working prototype within days.

**Good to Have**

* A multimodal project involving video, images or audio.
* Fine-tuning, adapting, quantising or locally running open-source models - especially getting a smaller model to beat a larger one on a narrow task.
* Computer vision experience, or work involving multimodal embedding spaces.
* Open-source contributions, technical blogs, papers or detailed engineering write-ups.
* Exposure to AR/VR, Unity or 3D applications.
* Any experience with industrial, manufacturing or field-operations environments.

**What We're Looking For**

We value curiosity, ownership, experimentation and evidence over credentials. You are probably a strong fit if :

* You experiment with new AI models and papers because you genuinely enjoy it, not because someone asked you to.
* Your GitHub, notebooks or side projects contain things you built purely because you wanted to understand how they worked.
* You have strong opinions about when certain systems perform well vs bad.
* You enjoy ambiguous problems where the solution architecture is not already known.
* You move fast and you take ownership rather than waiting for a perfectly specified task.

**Work Environment**

This is an on-site role based out of our Bangalore office. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across AI, software engineering, 3D, AR/VR and product development.

**Why Join AutoVRse?**

* You will bring the AI depth on the team - your model and architecture decisions will materially shape the product rather than implement someone else's roadmap.
* Problems from real enterprise deployments, not isolated research exercises: incomplete data, long videos, noisy field recordings, complex documents, domain-specific knowledge and strict accuracy requirements.
* Genuine freedom to investigate better approaches, challenge existing architectures and introduce technologies the rest of the team may not yet know about.
* Work at the intersection of AI and immersive technology, in a company that already has enterprise distribution and production software running at scale.
* A small, fast-moving team and a very short distance between your work and a customer using it.

**How to Apply**

If you or anyone you know feels like joining us for this ride - please feel free to reach out to us at: paulomi.karmakar@autovrse.in /careers@autovrse.in

**About Your Team**
Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.
  
  
Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.

To transform business operations and drive growth for enterprises across the globe. We’re more than just a service provider—we’re a committed partner driving meaningful impact every day. We leverage global expertise and local insights to help customers navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. With a focus on innovation, collaboration, and results, we continue to pave the way for the future of business.

**Position Title:**
Principal AI & Service Line Leader

**Location:**
PAN India

**Job Description:**
Digitide is hiring a Principal AI & Service Line Leader to own the AI services across Digitide's Domestic BPM, International BPM, and Global Tech & Digital businesses. This is a builder's role, not a people-management post — you will personally architect and stand up Digitide's AI capability (the Pulse.ai persona stack, the AI operating stack, and AI Value Packs) while also getting hands-on AI strategy – services portfolio, market narrative, positioning and overall business plan. A hands-on leader with sharp focus on opportunities crafting — advise for customer, building demos and PoCs, architecting solutions, and sitting in the room as the technical and domain credibility behind Digitide's AI story. You'll own the charter end to end: strategy, build, and go-to-market, with the freedom and accountability of a founder inside a large, established global platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously evolve Digitide's AI service line strategy and roadmap across Domestic BPM, International BPM, and Global Tech & Digital — as a core pillar of Digitide's growth strategy.
* Owns the overall service line plan, strategy, growth, internal assets and capability build and managing partner ecosystem.
* Architect and build out Digitide's AI operating stack, frameworks and AI Value Packs — hands-on, from architecture through working prototype, not just slideware.
* Get into opportunities directly — guide/ build demos, PoCs, and reference architectures for presales and client pursuits, and sit in deal rooms as the AI technical/domain authority alongside the presales and solutioning team.
* Own Digitide's AI/LLM technology and hyperscaler partnerships (AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, Microsoft, Google, and emerging GenAI/agentic tooling vendors), including evaluating, piloting, and making fast build-vs-buy calls.
* Champion Digitide's AI-led Master Systems Integrator (MSI) positioning — embedding AI into the Cloud & Infra, BPaaS, Collections, RCM, and other service lines in direct partnership with their leaders.
* Represent Digitide's AI capability in CEO/CXO-level client conversations and with analysts and advisors (Gartner, Everest, HFS, ISG, and similar), building Digitide's credibility and rankings in the AI space.
* Partner with Presales, Alliances, and Analyst/Advisor Relations to embed a genuine AI differentiator — not a bolted-on slide — into every major bid.
* Build and mentor a high-calibre AI team over time, while staying personally hands-on with architecture, tooling, and solution build — this is a working leader role, not a purely supervisory one.
* Move fast: take ideas from concept to a working pilot in weeks, not quarters, and iterate in the field with real client problems.

**Qualifications:**

* 15–18 years of experience with substantial hands-on AI/ML/GenAI architecture and delivery — not primarily AI strategy, program oversight, or vendor management.
* A genuine builder track record: has personally designed, architected, or shipped AI/GenAI products, platforms, or agentic systems — not only directed teams that did.
* Background from fast-paced, high-growth environments — AI-native startups, product companies, or boutique AI/tech consulting firms — strongly preferred over large, heritage IT/BPM services organizations.

description:

As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day."
  
  
Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
  
  
The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
  
  
**Think you have what it takes?**
Kaufman Rossin is seeking an experienced AI Developer based in Bengaluru to play a central role in building KR's AI application capability on Azure. This is a full-stack AI engineering role — spanning LLM integration, RAG architecture, API development, Azure-native deployment, local/self-hosted model operations, and responsible AI implementation — with a focus on delivering real, production-grade solutions that create measurable value for KR's advisory practice and its clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate is deeply technical, intellectually curious, pragmatic about shipping working software, and acutely aware of the cost and security implications of every architectural decision. You will work directly from well-defined user stories, collaborate with the Azure Architect on model and infrastructure decisions, and leverage Claude Code and AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of your engineering workflow.
  
  
**Requirements**
**AI Application Development**

* Design, build, and deploy scalable AI-powered applications on Azure infrastructure — including internal productivity tools for KR staff and client-facing solutions for RAS and advisory engagements
* Develop and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure AI Foundry — handling document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector indexing, and query-time retrieval
* Build and maintain LLM-powered features: document intelligence, contract analysis, automated summarization, regulatory content extraction, conversational agents, and structured data extraction from unstructured sources
* Integrate a broad range of AI models into application workflows — including Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3), Anthropic Claude (via Azure or API), Meta Llama, Mistral, and other open-source models — selecting the right model for each use case based on capability, cost, latency, and data sensitivity requirements
* Stand up, configure, and maintain local/internal AI model deployments using Ollama, vLLM, or Azure AI Foundry local compute — for use cases requiring on-premises processing, data residency compliance, or cost-controlled inference at scale
* Leverage Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools throughout the engineering workflow — using agentic coding capabilities to accelerate development, improve code quality, generate tests, and explore solution options faster
* Architect multi-turn conversational interfaces and agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain — for use cases requiring reasoning, tool use, or multi-step orchestration

**Security & Responsible AI**

* Apply KR's AI governance framework in every build — content filtering via Azure AI Content Safety, DLP controls, usage audit logging, data sensitivity classification, and Conditional Access enforcement for AI-powered tools
* Implement security best practices across all AI application components — Entra ID authentication, RBAC, Managed Identity for service-to-service access, secret management via Azure Key Vault, and Private Endpoint connectivity — treating security as a first-class design requirement, not an afterthought
* Implement responsible AI practices in every deliverable — input/output validation, PII detection, content filtering, audit logging, and explainability documentation for regulated advisory contexts
* Document model behavior, known limitations, bias considerations, and risk mitigations for each AI feature delivered — producing responsible AI summaries that satisfy KR's governance requirements for client-facing deployments
* Implement secure, multi-tenant data isolation patterns in AI applications — ensuring client data, internal data, and model context are correctly scoped and never cross tenant boundaries

**Cost-Conscious Architecture & FinOps**

* Design AI application architectures with cost efficiency as a first-class concern — selecting models, deployment tiers, and inference patterns that deliver the required capability at the lowest sustainable cost
* Configure and manage Azure AI Foundry deployments — model selection, deployment slots, token quotas, rate limiting, and cost monitoring — ensuring efficient and cost-controlled model consumption
* Evaluate build vs. buy vs. local model decisions for each AI use case — weighing commercial API costs against self-hosted model operational costs, latency trade-offs, and data sensitivity requirements
* Integrate Azure Monitor and Application Insights into AI applications — instrumenting latency, token usage, error rates, and custom AI quality metrics to support ongoing cost and performance monitoring
* Produce regular AI cost reports — token consumption by application, model cost per query, and cost-per-outcome metrics — giving IT leadership visibility into AI spend and ROI

**Azure Infrastructure & Deployment**

* Deploy AI applications and services on Azure using containerized architectures — Azure Container Apps, AKS, or Azure App Services — depending on workload requirements and scale

**Data & Integration**

* Integrate AI features with KR's enterprise data sources and application ecosystem — Azure Data Lake Storage, APIs, and internal platforms — through well-designed, maintainable integration layers

title: Research Scientist - Nemotron India
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
  
  
We are looking for Research Scientists passionate about large generative models! We are searching for world-class researchers in deep learning and natural language processing (NLP) to join our applied deep learning research team which pioneered the Megatron, MT-NLG, and DLSS projects at NVIDIA. Our team is pushing the boundaries of generative AI by building state-of-the-art large language and multi-modal foundation models and applying them to solve real-world problems. If you are passionate about the latest research and technologies revolutionizing generative AI and want to explore creative new paradigms for applied foundation models such as software assistants and customized multi-modal agents, this team will be a great fit for you. **What You Will Do**

* Develop deep learning-based approaches to improve and advance large language models (LLMs) and large multi-modal models.
* Design and implement machine learning techniques to adapt foundation models to downstream tasks of interest such as software assistant and multi-turn multi-modal and multi-lingual dialogue system.
* Construct and curate datasets for large-scale machine learning, for learning from human preferences, and for specific domains of applications.
* Work closely with product and hardware architecture teams to integrate your research and developments into products.

* MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience.
* Extensive machine learning / deep learning research or work experience.
* Knowledge of application areas such as natural language processing and computer vision.
* Excellent programming skills in some rapid prototyping environments such as Python; C++ and parallel programming (e.g., CUDA) is a plus.

* A track record of research excellence demonstrated in publications at leading conferences and journals.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: AI Senior Engineer
description:
****Description****
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own client engagements end to end — technical discovery, solution architecture, hands-on build, and delivery — acting as the technical authority on feasibility.
* Translate ambiguous real-world problems into concrete perception and robotics ML architectures; lead demos and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Design and build CV and perception systems — detection, segmentation, pose estimation — on the 3D geometry underneath (SE(3), camera models, projection, coordinate frames).
* Own sensor calibration and fusion — intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, and LiDAR–camera — plus LiDAR processing (registration, ground segmentation, object detection).
* Design egocentric data collection pipelines using wrist/head-mounted cameras, depth sensors, and IMU for robot learning.
* Bridge simulation and deployment via domain randomisation, sim setup, and sim-to-real gap analysis.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate VLA models, and fine-tune large pretrained models under data and compute constraints.
* Build supporting services — agentic loops, REST/gRPC APIs, and PostgreSQL — to expose model inference and robotics services.
* Mentor engineers, drive principled decisions (diagnose before solving), and translate current research into practical client implications.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years in robotics ML, computer vision, or technical solutions engineering.
* Strong CV and perception — detection, segmentation, pose estimation, optical flow.
* Solid 3D geometry — SE(3) transformations, camera models, projection, coordinate frames.
* Sensor calibration — intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, and multi-modal alignment.
* LiDAR processing and sensor fusion, including LiDAR–camera calibration.
* Sim-to-real experience — domain randomisation and sim environments (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or Unity Robotics Hub).
* Conceptual grasp of VLA architectures and the current SOTA landscape.
* Strong Python (PyTorch); able to read and implement research papers.
* Prior client-facing or presales technical experience.
* Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences.

* Agentic systems and prompt engineering — tool-use agents and multi-step planners.

* ROS / ROS2 or equivalent robotics middleware.
* C# for Unity-based simulation and tooling.
* Fine-tuning large pretrained models under data/compute constraints.
* Edge/onboard optimisation — TensorRT, ONNX, quantisation.
* RL / RLHF, motion planning, kinematics, or URDF.
* Hands-on with robot hardware (Franka, UR, Unitree, or similar).
* Research orientation — tracks arXiv, forms opinions from first principles.
* Publications, open-source work, or notable projects in robot learning or Physical AI.

* Perception / 3D: OpenCV, Open3D, PCL, point cloud processing

* Models: VLA models (RT-2, OpenVLA, π₀, Octo), ViTs, multimodal, hosted and open-source
* Deployment: REST/gRPC, Docker, PostgreSQL; TensorRT / ONNX for edge
* Core Areas: CV and perception, 3D geometry, calibration, LiDAR, sensor fusion, sim-to-real, agentic systems

* Client engagements delivered with clear architecture, working perception/robotics systems, and evaluation coverage.
* Reusable solution patterns and accelerators created from recurring engagement needs.
* Robust calibration, data collection, and sim-to-real workflows that transfer reliably to real hardware.
* Sound VLA and model-selection/fine-tuning decisions, grounded in the current SOTA landscape.
* Effective mentorship and principled technical guidance across the Technical Solutions team.

title: Application Engineer (AI Automation)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer for AI Automation**
, you will be at the clinical edge of our intelligence layer. This isn't just about writing code; it's about architecting the nervous system of our automated enterprise. You will bridge the gap between heavy-duty enterprise platforms (Salesforce, Zuora, ServiceNow) and the next generation of Agentic AI.
  
  
Your primary mission will be building high-performance
**Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
servers that allow AI agents to interact deeply with complex business logic—specifically within the Salesforce ecosystem (Quote, Opportunity, and Renewal services). You’ll move from building RAG-based retrieval to orchestrating
**Agent-to-Agent communication**
, creating a seamless autonomous workflow across our tech stack.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect MCP Servers: Design and implement robust MCP servers to expose Salesforce services (Quote, Opportunity, Renewal) and other core platforms to AI agents.
* Data Model Synthesis: Rapidly decompose the data models of enterprise applications like Zuora, Salesforce, and ServiceNow to build effective schemas for AI interaction.
* Build AI Pipelines: Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and AI agents that can execute complex tasks with minimal human intervention.
* Agentic Orchestration: Lead the transition from simple chatbots to Agentic AI, focusing on multi-agent collaboration and autonomous "Agent-to-Agent" communication.
* Integration Engineering: Build and maintain secure, scalable integrations using REST APIs across disparate cloud environments.
* Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert for AI automation, guiding the evolution of our automation strategy and mentoring junior engineers.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years in professional software engineering.
* Expert-level proficiency in Python (for AI/ML orchestration) and JavaScript/TypeScript or Java (for enterprise services).
* Knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud (Apex knowledge is a plus, but understanding the API/Object model is mandatory).
* AI Specialization: Proven experience building AI agents using MCP (Model Context Protocol) and implementing RAG architectures.
* API Mastery: Deep expertise in designing and consuming RESTful APIs and handling complex authentication/OAuth flows.
* Autonomy: A "hunter" mindset for information—you can pick up a new tool like Zuora, read the docs, and understand the underlying data relationships without needing a guided tour.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
* Background in SalesOps automation (specifically Quote-to-Cash processes).
* Contributions to open-source MCP servers or AI frameworks.

**The Future of This Role**
This role is designed for an engineer who wants to move beyond "GPT wrappers." You will eventually be responsible for building a decentralized network of agents where a "Sales Agent" can autonomously negotiate data with a "Billing Agent" (Zuora) and a "Contract Agent" (ServiceNow) to close renewals without manual data entry.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 7 to 12 years of relevant industry work experience as a specialist/individual contributor
* Proficiency in Python with exceptional coding and debugging abilities
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications:
