title: GPU Compute & MLIR Compiler Engineer — AI Workloads
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering
  
  
**General Summary**
We are looking for a highly skilled GPU compute, MLIR compiler, and kernel optimization engineer with deep expertise in GPU compute, MLIR-based code generation, and end-to-end performance optimization for AI workloads. In this role, you will design, optimize, and deploy high-performance GPU compute kernels, build and extend MLIR compiler backends, and collaborate closely with ML, runtime, and hardware teams to push the limits of performance on modern GPU architectures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and optimize GPU compute kernels targeting OpenCL and Vulkan compute backends for high-throughput AI/ML workloads.
* Design, build, and extend MLIR dialects across multiple abstraction levels — including frontend dialects, graph-level IR, tensor IR (e.g., Linalg, Tensor, Tosa), and runtime/low-level dialects — to enable efficient end-to-end model compilation.
* Implement and maintain MLIR-based compiler passes and transformations, including tiling, fusion, bufferization, vectorization, and lowering pipelines targeting OpenCL and Vulkan GPU backends.
* Conduct profiling and bottleneck analysis of compiled kernels using GPU counters and vendor-specific profilers, and drive performance improvements through compiler-level optimizations.
* Build and maintain GPU runtime infrastructure for both OpenCL and Vulkan, including memory management, pipeline setup, command buffer orchestration, and resource scheduling.
* Develop and extend code generation pipelines, enabling automatic lowering from tensor IR through MLIR to efficient OpenCL and Vulkan GPU kernels.
* Implement performance-critical schedules — tiling, loop fusion, parallelism, and caching strategies — within MLIR-based backends targeting OpenCL and Vulkan runtimes.
* Collaborate with framework teams to optimize end-to-end model lowering for computer vision and LLM workloads using MLIR compilation stacks.
* Design and implement robust compiler and runtime components using modern C/C++, leveraging advanced programming paradigms for high-performance systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience with MLIR framework, including authoring and extending custom dialects, writing compiler passes, and building end-to-end lowering pipelines.
* Deep expertise across MLIR abstraction levels:
* Frontend dialects — ingestion and representation of ML models (e.g., TOSA, StableHLO, ONNX-MLIR)
* Graph-level IR — high-level operation fusion, shape inference, and graph transformations
* Tensor IR level — structured op representation using Linalg, Tensor, and Vector dialects; tiling and fusion strategies
* Runtime/low-level dialects — bufferization, MemRef, SCF, GPU, and LLVM dialects for final code generation
* Strong hands-on experience in OpenCL programming, including kernel development, memory model, work-group/work-item optimization, and OpenCL runtime management.
* Solid understanding of Vulkan compute programming, including descriptor management, compute pipelines, synchronization primitives, and Vulkan runtime internals.
* Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and async compute.
* Proficiency in C/C++ for system-level development.
* Experience with kernel profiling and bottleneck analysis on GPU platforms.
* Strong background in machine learning fundamentals, covering both CV and LLM workloads.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with IREE (Intermediate Representation Execution Environment) or other MLIR-based deployment frameworks such as TVM, XLA, or LLVM.
* Familiarity with IREE's compiler and runtime architecture — including HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer), executable compilation, and dispatch mechanisms — particularly its OpenCL and Vulkan HAL backends.
* Experience contributing to open-source MLIR or IREE projects.
* Knowledge of quantization, mixed-precision inference, and model optimization techniques for edge and server GPU targets.
* Exposure to multi-target compilation (CPU, GPU, NPU) using MLIR-based toolchains.
* Familiarity with cross-vendor GPU profiling tools (e.g., ARM Streamline, Qualcomm Snapdragon Profiler, Intel VTune) for OpenCL and Vulkan workloads.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. title: Senior Architect — AI Enablement
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
**Senior Architect — AI Enablement**
is responsible for serving as the guiding star for AI across our software engineering organization. This is not a strategy-only role: associate will be personally building proofs of concept, embed with scrum teams to implement AI-driven solutions, and shape how our organization adopts AI — from developer productivity tooling to AI capabilities in our products. Associate will work across all engineering teams and their leaders, and partner with Danaher-level AI leadership to ensure our direction stays aligned with the broader enterprise AI strategy.
  
  
This position reports to the VP Software, Cepheid and is part of the Software Engineering located in IDC Bangalore and will be an on-site role.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Hands-on AI implementation - Design, build, and demonstrate AI proofs of concept (POCs) that solve real problems for our teams, and carry successful POCs through to production-ready patterns.
* Implement solutions using modern AI tooling — LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, AI coding assistants — integrated with our Java-based technology stack.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable components, and coding standards for AI features so teams can adopt them quickly and safely.
* Drive AI adoption across teams - Act as the organization's AI evangelist and trusted advisor: coach engineers, managers, product owners, and directors on where and how AI can improve their work.
* Set Strategy, trends, and governance for the s/w organization - Continuously scan industry trends in AI/GenAI, evaluate emerging tools and models, and recommend enhancements to the organization's AI roadmap.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 16+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in an architect or technical leadership role.
* Strong hands-on Java expertise (e.g., Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs) with a track record of shipping production systems. - Proven experience building AI/GenAI POCs and taking at least some of them into production.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI tools and technologies: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code).
* Excellent communication and influencing skills — able to work effectively across multiple teams, senior leaders, and enterprise stakeholders without direct authority.
* Ability to translate business problems into pragmatic, implementable AI solutions and to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience with agentic AI frameworks, MCP, or workflow orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Spring AI).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation, monitoring, cost management, and guardrails for AI systems.
* Experience driving AI adoption or developer-productivity programs in a multi-team engineering organization.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Advanced Research Intern - Artificial Intelligence
description:
**About The Job**
GE Vernova is seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join the Advanced Research business as an Advanced Research Intern in the field of Artificial Intelligence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in designing and developing research experiments to address key challenges in time series analysis, machine vision, and deep learning applications.
* Develop novel AI/ML algorithms and implement them in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar environments.
* Build and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models for the analysis of time series data and visual data; conduct experiments to validate algorithm performance across various datasets and scenarios.
* Analyze experimental results to validate theoretical assumptions, assess model accuracy, and derive actionable insights for further refinement.
* Conduct comprehensive literature reviews to stay abreast of state-of-the-art techniques in time series forecasting, computer vision, and deep learning architectures.
* Document research methodologies, experimental setup, results, and findings in technical reports, papers, and presentations for both internal and external dissemination.

**Requirements**
**Requirements**

* Currently enrolled in a Master’s or Ph.D. program in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, with a focus on AI, Machine Learning, or Data Analytics.
* Experience developing in Python and familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
* Proficiency in building and evaluating statistical, machine learning, and deep learning models for time series and/or image data.

title: AI Demo Engineer
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join us as an AI Demo Engineer, a truly ground-floor role where you’ll be instrumental in shaping the future of Scout, our brand-new AI product. You’ll tackle the exciting challenge of building, not just maintaining, dynamic AI-powered demonstrations that empower our Sales Engineers and directly drive deal closures. This is your chance to build a critical function from scratch, defining processes and making a tangible impact on our market approach, bringing real variety and ownership to every project.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As our first AI Demo Engineer in Bangalore, you will occupy a unique, pivotal position, bridging the gap between traditional Demo Engineering and AI engineering. Your primary focus will be on constructing sophisticated agentic Scout workflows, moving beyond static demo data to craft intelligent, multi-step solutions. You will own the creation of a comprehensive library of reusable standard demo agents, complete with robust data and documentation, serving as the essential foundation for all sales demonstrations. Furthermore, you will design and implement prospect-specific agents tailored to individual deal requirements, directly contributing to successful sales outcomes. A crucial part of your role involves maintaining the main demo template, ensuring it remains current, functional after platform updates, and populated with fresh data and golden records. Beyond building, you will become a diagnostic expert, analyzing prospect usage within Proof-of-Concept (POC) instances, identifying why a solution might not be landing, and expertly tuning agents, data, and configurations to optimize outcomes and secure conversions. You won't inherit a fixed process; instead, you'll help define the operating model for this critical new team function.
  
  
The Skills You'll Have
  
  
**Agentic AI / Scout Configuration**

* You'll build or configure at least one agentic AI workflow, demonstrating proficiency with agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi-step tasks
* You'll possess hands-on prompt engineering experience, having written and iterated prompts/instructions for LLM-based tools
* You'll have a basic understanding of MCP (Multi-Cloud Platform) or comparable tool-calling/connector patterns
* You'll have designed multi-system agentic workflows end-to-end, showcasing your ability to move beyond single-agent/single-tool solutions
* You'll have built or worked directly with MCP connectors, leveraging your deep technical expertise

**Business Translation & Demo Enablement**

* You'll translate complex business requirements into working demos, prototypes, or configurations without extensive guidance
* You'll produce clear documentation or handoff guides that empower others to successfully run a build you created
* You'll quickly understand a prospect's business process, translating it into value-led Scout workflows and compelling demo scripts
* You'll scope realistic deliverables and deadlines in collaboration with Sales Engineers, proactively closing gaps in incomplete requirements
* You'll hold one or more Salesforce certifications, and/or possess direct Sitetracker platform experience, enhancing your industry relevance

**POC Analysis & Tuning**

* You'll analyze the usage of a live tool or instance and implement changes that measurably improved its performance
* You'll be comfortable reading how a system is actually being used, rather than relying solely on its intended design
* You'll diagnose why a POC instance is or isn't landing, treating challenges as diagnostic problems to solve
* You'll tune agents, data, and configurations to improve POC outcomes, directly affecting conversion rates
* You'll have run structured POC or pilot programs end-to-end, demonstrating a robust feedback loop from usage data back into configuration

**Industry Knowledge**

* You'll have some exposure to Telecom, Utilities, Renewables, or another infrastructure-heavy industry, or to a software company that targets these verticals
* You'll possess the ability to quickly learn new infrastructure-heavy industries and deepen your expertise in existing ones
* You'll ensure Scout demos are credible and specific to a prospect's vertical, enhancing their impact
* You'll have worked directly in one of Sitetracker's target industries, or for a software company serving them
* You'll leverage your industry depth to keep Scout demos compelling and highly relevant to prospects

**Within 90 Days, You'll**

* Establish the foundational components of a working standard demo agent library, with initial reusable Scout demo agents, data, and documentation available for SEs.
* Take ownership of the main demo template, ensuring its stability and beginning the process of refreshing demo data and documentation.
* Contribute your first prospect-specific agent builds to active sales opportunities, gaining hands-on experience in high-stakes scenarios.

**Within 180 Days, You'll**

* Significantly expand the standard demo agent library, incorporating new use cases and refining existing agents based on SE feedback and market needs.
* Demonstrate clear contributions to closed deals through your custom Scout builds, directly impacting sales wins and validating your approach.
* Successfully diagnose and tune struggling POC instances, applying your analytical skills to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates.

**Within 365 Days, You'll**

* Own a comprehensive, high-performing library of Scout demo agents that are consistently leveraged by the Sales Engineering team, becoming an indispensable asset for sales cycles.
* Regularly contribute to the closure of significant deals through your expert prospect-specific agent builds and POC tuning, directly influencing revenue growth.
* Help define and standardize the operating model and best practices for demo engineering within the Scout product team, shaping the long-term strategy for this critical function.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

**How You’ll Grow**

title: AI Engineer, Harness & Eval
description:
You'll be one of the first engineers in NAVEX's AI Centre of Excellence, a new function with a company-wide mandate to put AI into how the business runs. We build AI for business operations and internal agentic products.

You'll build production agents and, more importantly, the harness around them: the evals, tracing and guardrails that tell us an agent works before a user finds out it doesn't. Some agents you'll build from scratch. Others were built by external partners and are moving in-house. You'll own both.

**At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world-making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.**

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose - as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.

**You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to innovation, speed, and measurable outcomes. Join us and help shape what’s next!**

**What you’ll get:**

* **Meaningful Purpose.**
  Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people-at a scale few companies can match.
* **High-Performance Environment.**
  We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* **Candid, Supportive Culture.**
  We communicate openly, challenge ideas- not people-and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* **Growth That Matters.**
  You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* **Rewards for Results.**
  We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**

* Build and ship agents for business operations and internal products. End to end: retrieval, tool use, orchestration, state, and handoffs to human
* Build MCP servers and tool integrations that give agents safe, reliable access to company systems and data
* Design the eval harness. Golden sets, regression suites, LLM-as-judge where it earns its place, human review loops. Every change ships with evidence that it made things better
* Instrument agents in production. Tracing, failure taxonomies, cost and latency tracking. When something degrades, you find out first and know why
* Take over agents built by external partners. Read the code, find where it breaks, add the evals and observability it shipped without
* Hold a verification bar. In a compliance company, an answer we can't source or explain doesn't ship

**What you’ll bring:**

* 3+ years of AI engineering experience, most of it building LLM systems that real users depend on
* Hands-on experience building with agentic harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar
* You've built MCP servers, eval harnesses or LLM Systems, not just used them and can explain how you knew a change was an improvement
* You've owned a system that degraded in production and diagnosed why, and can walk us through it
* Strong Python. Comfortable with at least one agent framework, and willing to go below it when it gets in the way
* Experience deploying on a major cloud provider: AWS, GCP or Azure
* You've shipped end-to-end and own outcomes, not just tasks
* You can take a non-technical team's workflow and turn it into a working system
* Bonus points for:
* Building RAG over messy enterprise documents—proposals, contracts and policies
* Working with AWS Bedrock or inside VPC-constrained enterprise environments
* Building in regulated or compliance-heavy domains
* Sharing your work through writing, talks or open source
* **Culture Agility.**
  Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* **Fuel performance and outcomes.**
  Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is 3,000,000 INR with 10% MBO. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

description:

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. .

Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary:**

Daignostix builds clinical AI for CT, MR, X-ray and ultrasound, with algorithms spanning neuro and stroke, pulmonary embolism, aortic pathology, urology, spine and rib fracture, solid-organ trauma and paediatric chest. Our models are used alongside radiologists (US, Indian certified), so quality is judged by clinical performance and reliability, not benchmark scores.

As a Junior AI Engineer, you will own scoped model workstreams (data, training, evaluation and error analysis) under the guidance of senior AI engineers, and support the move of validated models into production. Medical-imaging experience is welcome but not required; serious hands-on deep-learning work is.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

● Model development. Train, fine-tune and evaluate CNN- and transformer-based models for classification, detection and segmentation, starting from strong baselines and running disciplined, reproducible experiments.

● Scoped ownership. Own a defined model workstream under senior review, from dataset preparation through training, validation, documentation and hand-off.

● Data pipelines. Build and maintain DICOM pipelines for ingestion, de-identification, series selection, pre-processing, augmentation, annotation handling and dataset versioning.

● Evaluation and error analysis. Report clinical metrics (sensitivity, specificity, PPV/NPV, ROC-AUC/PR-AUC, per-case and per-lesion), analyse false positives and negatives by subgroup, and explain why the model fails.

● Radiologist collaboration. Work with radiologists (US, Indian certified) to define labels, review difficult cases and turn clinical feedback into measurable model improvements.

● Production support. Contribute to packaging validated models as tested inference services (Python, Docker, FastAPI), including unit and regression tests that confirm changes do not alter clinical outputs. Senior engineers lead serving architecture, optimisation and deployment.

**Requirements:**

**Must-have:**

● Education. B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

● Experience. 2-4 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering or research experience, including deep-learning work beyond coursework, tutorials, notebooks or API wrappers.

● Proof of building. At least one substantial computer-vision system or research contribution that you personally drove into a reproducible pipeline, service or real downstream use, and can defend in technical depth.

● Programming. Strong Python and NumPy, and deep hands-on experience in PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras. Able to debug data loaders, leakage, incorrect metrics and unstable training.

● Fundamentals. Solid grounding in deep learning and computer vision (CNNs, vision transformers, detection, segmentation, transfer learning) and in statistics and experimental design (ROC/PR analysis, thresholds, calibration).

● Engineering basics. Linux, Git, clean modular Python, Docker, pytest and basic CI/CD.

Good-to-have:

● Medical imaging. Experience with DICOM/NIfTI, MONAI or nnU-Net.

● Production exposure. Model serving with FastAPI, ONNX/TensorRT, and experiment tracking with MLflow or Weights & Biases.

● LLMs and cloud. Exposure to LLMs, embeddings or RAG, and to one of AWS, Azure or GCP. These add to, but do not replace, core deep-learning skills.

**Key Skills:**

Python | PyTorch | TensorFlow / Keras | NumPy | OpenCV | scikit-learn | CNNs | Vision Transformers | Detection | Segmentation | DICOM / NIfTI | Clinical Metrics | Error Analysis | Git | Linux | Docker | FastAPI | pytest | MLflow / Weights & Biases

**Why Join Daignostix:**

● Real clinical AI. Build models for real medical-imaging workflows and see how they affect radiologists and patients.

● Direct access to radiologists. Work closely with subspecialist radiologists (US, Indian certified) on ground truth, difficult cases and failure analysis.

● Mentorship with ownership. Senior technical review, dedicated on-premise GPU infrastructure, and visibility across development, deployment, clinical validation and regulatory pathways.

across

This role goes beyond prompt design, you’ll own the end-to-end application of LLMs, from architecting internal tools and APIs to ensuring robust performance, usability, and compliance in real-world deployments.

**What You’ll Own & Drive**

* Design and implement LLM-based features across Qure’s products, from clinician-facing assistants to automated diagnostic flows.
* Build internal tools, APIs, and developer-facing utilities to enable scalable LLM integrations.
* Collaborate with prompt engineers to design modular, composable workflows (e.g., RAG, chaining, structured prompting).
* Evaluate model performance and behavior across tasks using both human feedback and automated metrics.
* Optimize latency, cost, and reliability of LLM systems using caching, batching, and fallback strategies.
* Deploy and monitor LLM services in production, integrating observability and usage analytics.
* Build systems to manage prompt versioning, LLM configurations, and multi-model experimentation.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and drive end-to-end project execution across engineering, product, and clinical teams.
* Contribute to internal LLM guidelines, safety practices, and developer enablement.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and technical excellence in building impactful LLM-driven solutions.

**Core Skills Required**

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**Job Description**
6sense has agents and an MCP server in production today, used by real customers. This role takes them further by building more capable agents, strengthening the API and tool layer, and creating an ecosystem that external agents, clients, and partners can connect to.
  
  
You'll work across the full journey from a customer's agent to 6sense data and actions—including APIs, tools, MCP, orchestration, context, evaluation, and security.
  
  
6sense is working to become the default Contextual Intelligence layer for B2B. Agents and MCP are how that context reaches customers, partners, and their AI tools. You'll partner closely with the team building contextual intelligence, write production Python daily, own multi-month projects, support the teams and customers who depend on these systems, and keep the platform current as the agent tooling landscape evolves.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Agents and Orchestration
  
  

* Extend LangGraph orchestrators with typed state, conditional routing, subgraphs, checkpointing, durable execution, and human-in-the-loop steps.
* Choose among routing, orchestrator-worker, plan-and-execute, reflection, and multi-agent handoff patterns based on the problem.
* Run agents headless—API- and MCP-first—across in-app, chat, workflow, and partner surfaces from one shared core.
* Maintain reusable components for state, memory, tool-calling, and agent-to-agent delegation with scoped permissions.

APIs, Tools, and MCP
  
  

* Evolve the APIs and tools agents use to read 6sense data and take action, for both human and LLM callers.
* Tune tool design for agent success, including names, descriptions, schemas, response shapes, error messages, and token-efficient outputs.
* Redesign and scale the MCP layer for production workloads, including concurrency, per-tenant quotas, latency budgets, caching, and graceful degradation, while maintaining backward compatibility and adopting new specification capabilities as they mature.
* Onboard external MCP clients, AI assistants, agent platforms, and partners. Write integration guides and reference clients, and define how 6sense consumes third-party MCP servers, including trust boundaries.
* Harden execution with idempotency, retries, rate limits, permissions, and spend controls. Maintain standards for tool contracts, versioning, and discovery.

Context and Evaluation
  
  

* Partner with the Contextual Intelligence team to expose context to agents through MCP, APIs, and tools, ensuring one context layer serves every surface. Establish contracts defining what each call returns, how fresh the information is, where it comes from, and how it is scoped to the tenant and user.
* Improve permission-aware retrieval and grounding through chunking, hybrid search, reranking, and citations. Optimize context assembly and memory within token and latency limits.
* Extend evaluation using golden datasets, tool-selection and tool-call accuracy, end-to-end task success, regression suites, and release gates, including context-quality measures.
* Expand tracing and usage analytics, and report on task success rate, tool-call precision, groundedness, latency, and cost per successful outcome.

Security, Privacy, and Trust
  
  

* Make security a first consideration in every tool, API, agent, and MCP change, and review your own and teammates' work for vulnerabilities.
* Enforce tenant isolation and user-level authorization on every call so agents never access data beyond the caller's permissions. Maintain short-lived, scoped credentials.
* Defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agency, and data leakage through tool outputs, traces, and logs. Set runtime limits on steps, tokens, time, and cost.

Customers and Engineering Craft
  
  

* Triage and debug customer-reported issues across agents, tools, models, and downstream systems, identify root causes, and deliver fixes.
* Participate in customer and partner technical calls, and support enablement teams with guidance, demos, and documentation.
* Write design documents that clearly explain assumptions and trade-offs, review code and designs, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and participate in on-call rotations and incident response.
* Track developments in MCP, agent frameworks, and model capabilities. Prototype promising technologies and provide short, evidence-backed recommendations.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 5+ years of experience building and running production software, with strong distributed-systems fundamentals, including idempotency, fault tolerance, backpressure, and failure recovery.
* 2+ years of experience building production LLM-based systems, including agents used by real customers.
* Strong Python skills and production experience with LangGraph or an equivalent orchestration framework.
* Experience designing APIs and tool interfaces for LLM callers, including schemas, descriptions, error handling, and tool-selection behavior. Direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience scaling an API or platform used by external customers or partners, including authentication, rate limiting, versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Production experience with retrieval and grounding, as well as writing and running LLM evaluations.
* Experience with multi-tenant, security-sensitive cloud systems, preferably AWS, including authorization boundaries and data-leakage prevention.
* Experience debugging production issues across services and supporting customers directly or through support and solutions teams.
* A track record of owning multi-month, cross-team projects independently and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience building or operating MCP servers in production, or contributing to MCP open-source projects.
* Experience serving context to agents from signals, entity data, knowledge graphs, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience integrating with external agent platforms or AI assistants as a partner, or working with agent interoperability protocols.
* Experience with B2B go-to-market, RevTech, CRM, or intent-data platforms.
* Experience with model routing, caching, and cost/latency optimization.
* Experience with Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or Spark.

What This Role Is Not
  
  

* Not an architect role: You'll set direction through working code and design documents.
* Not MCP-only: MCP sits alongside APIs, tools, and orchestration.
* Not a greenfield build: These systems are live, with real customers depending on them.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

title: Sr AI Agent Engineer
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building 
****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. Our work spans alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data. We build AI systems intended for real-world deployment, where transparency, auditability, and robustness are first-class constraints.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

****The Role****

We are building a 
****high-autonomy AI Engineering Agent****

 that can execute end-to-end AI engineering workflows on top of the Lexsi backend. The system is designed to reason over complex objectives, plan multi-step actions, interact with tools and data systems, evaluate outcomes, and iterate over long horizons while remaining interpretable and aligned.

As a 
****Sr AI Agent Engineer****

, you will be responsible for defining and building the core agent architecture. You will make foundational decisions about how the agent reasons, plans and executes actions, maintains memory and state, and has its decisions inspected and explained. This role requires deep hands-on engineering and the ability to operate in ambiguous environments with ownership from day one.

****What You’ll Build****

* ****End-to-end AI Engineering Agents****

   that can autonomously perform tasks such as experiment design, evaluation, analysis, and reporting, rather than merely assisting a human in these workflows.
* ****Harness Engineering:****

   Able to design and maintain complex harness components that support agents' scale exponentially for complex tasks.
* ****Agent architectures that combine reasoning, planning, tool orchestration, and memory****

  , with explicit handling of long-horizon execution, partial failures, and self-correction.
* ****Deep integrations with the Lexsi backend****

  , including internal evaluation systems, data pipelines, and alignment tooling, as well as enterprise APIs and proprietary data sources.
* ****Agents designed for enterprise and regulated environments****

  , where every action, decision, and output must be inspectable, explainable, and defensible.

****Responsibilities****

* ****Own the architecture and implementation of the AI Engineering Agent****

  , making early design decisions around planners, reasoning loops, memory models, and execution control that will shape the system long-term.
* ****Build robust tool orchestration and execution layers****

  , ensuring the agent can interact reliably with internal services, external APIs, and data systems, and recover gracefully from failures.
* ****Design and implement memory and state management****

  , enabling agents to operate across long-running tasks, retain relevant context, and reason over past actions and outcomes.
* ****Embed alignment, safety, and interpretability into the system design****

  , working closely with research teams to ensure that agent behavior is auditable and controllable by construction.
* ****Stress-test agent behavior in real-world conditions****

  , identifying edge cases, failure modes, and distribution shifts, and iterating on the system to improve reliability and correctness.
* ****Set a high engineering bar****

  , contributing to design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision-making with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

****Requirements****

* ****Significant experience building and shipping complex AI or ML-heavy systems****

  , where you have owned architecture and seen systems evolve in production, not just prototypes.
* ****Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and frameworks****

  , such as ReAct-style agents, AutoGPT-like systems, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or similar, with a clear understanding of their limitations and failure modes.
* ****Strong backend engineering fundamentals****

  , including advanced Python proficiency, experience building APIs and services, and familiarity with databases, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
* ****A systems-thinking mindset****

  , with the ability to reason about performance, reliability, cost, safety, and interpretability as interconnected design constraints.
* ****Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments****

  , where problems are loosely specified and ownership is expected rather than assigned.

****Strong Bonus Signals****

* Experience building 
  ****long-horizon or stateful agent systems****

   that must reason over time rather than single-turn interactions.
* Prior exposure to 
  ****AI alignment, interpretability, or safety tooling****

  , especially in production or enterprise settings.
* Experience working in 
  ****regulated or high-stakes domains****

  , where system behavior must be explained and audited after deployment.
* A track record of debugging and improving systems that behaved unpredictably in the real world.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

title: Applied AI ML Senior Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Join a world-class data science team at JPMorgan Chase and help shape the future of our Chief Administrative Office.
  
  
As a Data Scientist Senior Associate in the Chief Data & Analytics Office, you will lead the development and deployment of innovative AI and machine learning solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to address complex business challenges, drive adoption of modern ML practices, and ensure responsible AI governance. You will have the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art technologies and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the hands-on design, development, and deployment of advanced AI, GenAI, and large language model solutions.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on a wide range of machine learning techniques and optimizations.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, production-ready AI systems.
* Conduct experiments using the latest ML technologies, analyze results, and tune models for optimal performance.
* Own end-to-end code development in Python for both proof-of-concept and production-ready solutions.
* Integrate generative AI within the ML platform using state-of-the-art techniques.
* Drive adoption of modern ML infrastructure, tools, and best practices.
* Optimize system accuracy and performance by identifying and resolving inefficiencies.
* Communicate technical concepts and results to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ensure responsible AI practices, model governance, and compliance with regulatory standards.
* Mentor and guide other AI engineers and scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning, including generative AI, large language models, or foundation models.
* Experience programming in Python; experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Proven experience designing, training, and deploying large-scale ML/AI models in production environments.
* Deep understanding of prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and distributed systems (Kubernetes, Ray, Slurm).
* Solid grasp of MLOps tools and practices (MLflow, model monitoring, CI/CD for ML).
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Demonstrated leadership in working effectively with engineers, product managers, and other ML practitioners.
* Experience applying data science and ML techniques to solve business problems and passion for detail, follow-through, and technical excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Experience with high-performance computing and GPU infrastructure (e.g., NVIDIA DCGM, Triton Inference).
* Familiarity with big data processing tools and cloud data services.
* Advanced knowledge in reinforcement learning, meta learning, or related advanced ML areas.
* Experience with search/ranking, recommender systems, or graph techniques.
* Background in financial services or regulated industries.
* Experience with building and deploying ML models on cloud platforms such as AWS Sagemaker, EKS, etc.
* Published research or contributions to open-source GenAI/LLM projects.

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

About Us

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance.

The company continues to earn recognition from leading industry analysts and was recently named a Leader in AIM’s 2026 Generative AI and Data Engineering PeMa Quadrants. Backed by EQT a purpose-driven global investment organization which was ranked among the world’s leading private equity firms by PEI in 2025 Straive is positioned as a high-value alternative to traditional IT services providers, combining domain-led intelligence with AI execution at scale.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly technical, hands-on Sr. Gen AI Engineer / Lead Gen AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and deployment of production-grade Generative AI applications. In this dual-impact role, you will act as a primary individual contributor architecting core AI engines while simultaneously leading engineers through task allocation, code reviews, and technical mentorship. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between state-of-the-art AI research (LLMs, Agentic frameworks, Advanced RAG, OCR) and production-grade full-stack engineering (Python, FastAPI, React).

Key Responsibilities

* **Generative AI & Agentic Systems:**
  Architect, build, and optimize LLM-powered applications, multi-agent workflows (e.g., CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph), and autonomous AI agents.
* **RAG & Document Intelligence:**
  Design and deploy advanced RAG architectures and document processing pipelines utilizing OCR techniques (e.g., LayoutLM, PaddleOCR, Tesseract, Azure Document Intelligence) and Vision LLMs to extract structured data.
* **Backend Microservices:**
  Build robust, asynchronous, high-throughput microservices and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
* **Frontend Integration:**
  Collaborate on or build modern web interfaces using React (e.g., Control Towers, operations dashboards, interactive chat interfaces).
* **MLOps & Infrastructure:**
  Oversee model deployment, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, vector database integration (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, PGVector), and cloud infrastructure setup (Azure/AWS).
* **Technical Oversight:**
  Lead a team of AI, backend, and full-stack engineers; allocate tasks, establish sprint priorities, and ensure timely delivery.
* **Conduct rigorous code reviews:**
  To maintain high engineering standards, security, performance, and scalability across AI and full-stack codebases.

Required Experience and Qualifications

* **Overall Experience:**
  6 to 9 years of professional software engineering experience.
* **AI/ML Domain Experience:**
  3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML, OCR, and Generative AI solutions in production.
* **Core Technical Stack:**
* **Generative AI & LLMs:**
  Extensive experience with commercial and open-source LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama), Agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI), and LLM evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, TruLens, RAGAS).
* **RAG & Unstructured Data:**
  Strong knowledge of hybrid search, re-ranking, chunking strategies, vector databases, and document intelligence workflows.
* **OCR & Vision Techniques:**
  Hands-on experience with OCR engines (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, Azure Document Intelligence) and Multi-Modal/Vision LLMs.
* **Backend:**
  Deep expertise in Python and asynchronous frameworks (FastAPI, AsyncIO).
* **Frontend:**
  Working proficiency in React (TypeScript/JavaScript) for building interactive web UI components.
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure / AWS), Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.

Recognition & Achievements

* We have been recognized as a Star Performer in Data & AI Services Specialists - Everest’s North America PEAK Matrix 2025, and as a Leader in AIM’s Pema Quadrant of Agentic AI Service Providers - 2025.
* In Nov 2023, Straive acquired Gramener, an award-winning, design-led data science company, enhancing our data, analytics, and AI capabilities. In June 2025, we acquired SG Analytics, a leading provider of AI-powered insights and contextual analytics services.

For more information, please visit our Website
https://www.straive.com/

Join Us Today

**Ready to make an impact? Join Straive and redefine the future of business and technology, where you can thrive and lead.**

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status."*

title: Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical)
description:
**About Teleradiology Solutions / Daignostix**

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS), founded in 2002 by two Yale-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, provides 24x7 diagnostic radiology reporting to over 150 hospitals across 21 countries, through a network of radiologists (US, Indian certified) and technology-driven workflows.

Daignostix, the AI arm of TRS based in Whitefield, Bengaluru, builds clinical AI for medical imaging and healthcare workflows. TRS also maintains an active academic and research focus, including AI in radiology (www.radguru.net).

**Role Summary**

Daignostix builds the AI behind TRS's 24x7 teleradiology operations and the products used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams. Beyond clinical imaging models, this includes algorithms that route and prioritise cases, predict TAT and forecast volumes and radiologist coverage, along with mobile applications that put these capabilities in users' hands.

As a Junior AI Engineer – Applied AI (Non-Clinical), you will build and ship operational ML algorithms and AI-enabled mobile features end to end under the guidance of senior engineers, using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to move quickly without compromising quality. This role does not work on clinical diagnostic models.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

●      
**Operational algorithms.**
Build, train and evaluate models for case routing and worklist prioritisation, TAT prediction, radiologist scheduling and RVU/volume forecasting, and anomaly detection on operational data.

●      
**Mobile AI features.**
Build AI-enabled features in mobile apps (React Native, Flutter or native iOS/Android) and integrate them with backend model services.

●      
**On-device inference.**
Convert, optimize, and deploy machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models for production use, balancing accuracy, inference latency, memory usage, and model size.

●      
**Data and evaluation.**
Build data pipelines from operational systems, define success metrics with operations stakeholders, and measure model impact against baselines in production.

●      
**AI-assisted development.**
Use Claude Code and similar agentic coding tools in day-to-day development, while owning the review, testing and correctness of everything you ship.

●      
**Production engineering.**
Package models as tested services (Python, Docker, FastAPI) with unit and regression tests, logging and monitoring. Senior engineers lead architecture and deployment.

●      
**Stakeholder collaboration.**
Work with operations, product and engineering teams to turn workflow problems into measurable AI solutions.

**Requirements**

**Must-have:**

●      
**Education.**
B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MS/M.Sc. from an IIT, IISc, IIIT, BITS Pilani or a comparably selective institution, in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic record.

●      
**Experience.**
2-4 years of hands-on software and ML engineering, including mobile applications and ML models that reached real users.

●      
**Proof of building.**
At least one mobile app or ML system that you personally built and shipped to real users, and can defend in technical depth.

●      
**Programming.**
Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in machine learning frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM, along with proficiency in building and deploying production-grade ML solutions.

●      
**AI-assisted development.**
Regular use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools on real projects, with sound judgement in reviewing and testing AI-generated code.

●      
**ML fundamentals.**
Tabular, time-series and optimisation problems: feature engineering, gradient-boosted models, forecasting, classification metrics and experimental design.

●      
**Engineering basics.**
Linux, Git, Docker, REST APIs, pytest and basic CI/CD.

**Good-to-have:**

●      
**On-device ML.**
Experience deploying and optimizing machine learning models such as LightGBM, XGBoost, and scikit-learn models, including model compression, inference optimization, and efficient production deployment.

●      
**Operations research.**
Scheduling, queueing or routing optimisation (e.g., OR-Tools).

●      
**LLMs and cloud.**
LLM APIs, RAG or agent workflows, and one of AWS, Azure or GCP.

●      
**Shipping experience.**
App store releases, mobile analytics and exposure to healthcare workflows.

**Key Skills**

Python | scikit-learn | XGBoost / LightGBM | Time-Series Forecasting | Optimisation / OR-Tools | React Native / Flutter | Swift / Kotlin | PyTorch | Core ML / TensorFlow Lite / ExecuTorch | Claude Code / AI-Assisted Development | FastAPI / REST APIs | Docker | Git | pytest | CI/CD | MLflow / Weights & Biases

**Why Join Daignostix**

**﻿**

●      
**AI that runs the operation.**
Your algorithms directly shape how cases flow across a 24x7 global teleradiology service.

●      
**Ship to real users.**
Build mobile and backend features used by radiologists, hospital partners and internal teams.

●      
**Modern tooling with mentorship.**
Work with Claude Code and current AI tooling, with senior technical review and visibility from build to production.

The GCC will support Officeworks’ purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence.

**The role:**

**Title:**
AI Engineer

**Function:**
Technology

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Why this role exists:**

The AI Engineer orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design mock-ups within a pod delivery model. The role translates product specifications into functional instructions for AI agents, running multiple agent workstreams in parallel across standard-complexity work while holding the pre-production commit gate for routine changes.

The role evolves how engineering is executed. AI agents carry a significant share of test generation, documentation and code execution, while the AI Engineer remains fully accountable for system design judgement, code review, quality and all commitments to production. The role relies on AI-driven test coverage, agent-supported execution and human-in-the-loop validation to maintain high release standards.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Agent Orchestration and Delivery:**

* Translate product specifications from the Product Orchestrator into functional specifications and instructions that AI agents can execute, clarifying intent where requirements are ambiguous.
* Run multiple technical agents in parallel across standard-complexity work (coding, test case generation, documentation and visual design mock-ups) sequencing outputs so one stream is usable by the next.
* Apply base context, security policies, architecture patterns and coding standards established by the platform team to every agent run.
* Improve agent workflows continuously, sharing prompt techniques, context improvements and automation patterns across pods.

**Review, Quality Engineering, and Commit Gate:**

* Hold the pre-production commit gate on routine changes, ensuring no code reaches production without thorough review.
* Perform fast and accurate reviews of generated code, tests and specifications, identifying subtle errors, logical defects or plausible but incorrect outputs.
* Confirm that instructions given to technical agents have been executed to the expected standard before committing code.
* Design and execute test strategy for assigned workstreams, including functional integration and regression testing, building on AI-generated test coverage and agent-supported execution.
* Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, communicating severity and coordinating fixes with technical and functional stakeholders.
* Own non-functional outcomes for assigned workstreams, including performance, resilience, accessibility and security, and confirm architectural fit before commit.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or major architectural changes to the Senior AI Engineer or Principal AI Engineer for higher-level review.

**Context, Documentation and Knowledge Management:**

* Verify that technical documentation exists and is accurate, maintaining documentation as an active input to subsequent agent runs rather than an after-the-fact record.
* Maintain knowledge artefacts for workstreams so future code and agent outputs draw on detailed, reusable domain context over time.
* Contribute domain knowledge back to shared context repositories in line with central standards managed by Context Engineers.
* Maintain clear system provenance to distinguish agent-generated components from human-authored code.

**Production Support and Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve reported defects and incidents promptly across the platform domains the pod touches, including participation in on-call rotations.
* Support and maintain existing platforms, integrations and legacy services alongside agent-based delivery flows during technical transition periods.
* Execute production verification testing during post-deployment and hypercare periods, confirming release quality before handover to steady-state support.
* Report observed drift, hallucinations or specification failures in agent tooling to Agent Integrity Engineers.

**Who you will be working with:**

**In this role, you will:**

* Product Orchestration: Clarify specification intent and raise technical feasibility or workstream sequencing considerations with Product Orchestrators.
* Engineering Leadership: Seek higher-level review for complex or high-risk changes from Senior AI Engineers, Principal Domain Engineers, and Associate Engineering Managers.
* Architecture and Context Teams: Apply platform context libraries and feed domain knowledge back to Context Engineers, Solution Architects and Domain Architects.
* Platform and Integrity Specialists: Report agent drift or hallucination to Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and collaborate with Platform Engineers on workflows and permissions.

**What success looks like:**

* Workstream Throughput: High throughput of reviewed and committed work delivered through parallel multi-agent workstreams.
* Commit Gate Quality: High review quality with minimal defects escaping to production, backed by rigorous verification.
* Context Artefact Accuracy: High standard of accurate, reusable documentation and context artefacts that continuously improve subsequent agent runs.
* Platform Stability: High stability, supportability, and swift issue resolution across owned platform domains and legacy components.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How will you lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. We begin with customer, We do the right thing, We execute with accountability and We lead with ambition

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 6-8 years of software engineering experience, combining full-stack development with hands-on software quality assurance and testing across manual and automated methodologies.
* System Design Judgement: Demonstrated system design judgement to assess whether AI-generated code and technical output are fit for purpose, performant, and secure.
* Agent Orchestration: Practical experience or strong capability in orchestrating AI agents and developer tooling across parallel workstreams.
* Specification Literacy: Proven ability to write clear, precise functional specifications and prompts that produce accurate agent output.
* Quality Engineering: Demonstrated experience designing and executing test strategy (test planning, functional, integration and regression testing, test automation and defect management) across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Code Review Discipline: Experience conducting fast, accurate code reviews and managing pre-production commit gates, with an ability to identify plausible but incorrect logic.
* Operational Resilience: Experience supporting services in production, including incident handling and participating in on-call rotations across complex cloud architectures

**Preferred:**

* Retail Commerce Architecture: Experience working with modern headless retail platforms and commerce developer tooling.
* Observability Tooling: Familiarity with modern log management and observability tooling such as Sumo Logic or Datadog.
* Cloud and CI/CD Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS), Docker containerization, Git workflows, and modern CI/CD pipelines

title: Lead AI Engineer – RAG, GenAI & Vector Search
description:
Job Title: Lead AI Engineer – RAG, GenAI & Vector Search

Experience: 6+ years

Rel Exp: 3+ years

Location: Bangalore

Shift time: 11 to 8 am

Role Overview

AI Engineer with deep, hands-on expertise in building production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications. The ideal candidate has strong experience designing end-to-end RAG pipelines, from multi-format document ingestion and parsing, to retriever design, vector indexing at scale, and rigorous evaluation. You will work closely with data engineers, ML engineers, and product teams to deliver enterprise-grade AI systems that are accurate, scalable, and efficient.

Required Skills & Tech Stack

\*RAG (Expertise)

\*Document Processing

\*Retrieval Frameworks: LangChain; LlamaIndex

\*Vector Stores

\*Evaluation

\*Data Engineering

\*Programming: Python (expert level)

\*API Integration

\*Supporting Tools

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end RAG applications, from data ingestion to retrieval and generation.

• Build robust document processing pipelines to parse and extract content from diverse formats – PDF, Word, PPT, images, charts, and tables – using various Python frameworks and OCR/parsing libraries.

• Design and implement chunking strategies tailored to different document types and use cases to optimize retrieval quality.

• Build and fine-tune retrievers using frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, including hybrid search, re-ranking, and multi-stage retrieval approaches.

• Create, optimize, and manage vector indexes using vector databases (e.g., Milvus, or similar) for scalability, low-latency search, and enterprise-level efficiency.

• Develop and maintain evaluation pipelines for RAG systems using frameworks like RAGAS, tracking metrics such as faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision/recall, and groundedness.

• Integrate RAG pipelines with internal/external APIs and downstream applications.

• Collaborate with data engineering teams to build scalable data pipelines feeding the RAG ecosystem.

• Optimize system performance across the pipeline, including ingestion, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, and generation latency.

• Conduct experiments and benchmarking to continuously improve retrieval accuracy and response quality.

• Document architecture, pipelines, and best practices; collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and engineering teams.

• Stay current with advances in LLMs, RAG architectures, vector search, and evaluation methodologies.

hiring@khey-digit.com

title: R Systems - Lead Engineer - LLM/RAG
description:
