title: AI Enablement/Orchestration Engineer - Senior Associate
description:
Job Description: AI Enablement/Orchestration Engineer
  
  
****Role Summary & Role Description****
Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
  
  
We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.
  
  
Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic AI Enablement Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and integration of cutting-edge AI solutions into our business processes. This is a highly technical and hands-on role where you will work closely with senior team members to build AI systems leveraging technologies such as Generative AI (Gen AI), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks. You will collaborate closely with software engineers and investment servicing business teams to solve complex business challenges in the payments domain.
  
  
This role requires strong capabilities in both AI Engineering and Data Engineering. You will design data products, orchestrate multi-agent workflows, develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, integrate enterprise knowledge sources, and establish the governance and observability capabilities required to operate AI safely within a highly regulated financial services environment.
  
  
State Street is accelerating the adoption of AI-enabled capabilities to improve operational efficiency, enhance cybersecurity resilience, strengthen risk management, and deliver intelligent experiences across the enterprise.
  
  
As an AI Orchestration Engineer, you will help establish the AI execution layer that enables secure collaboration between enterprise data platforms, large language models, internal knowledge repositories, agentic workflows, governance controls, and human decision makers.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For****

* Design, build, and operationalize AI/ML solutions to detect anomalies, exceptions, fraud indicators, operational risk signals, and process deviations across high-volume payment flows.
* Develop anomaly detection models using supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, time-series, graph-based, statistical, and hybrid machine learning approaches.
* Engineer features from payment transactions, exception events, operational logs, historical patterns, and reference data to identify unusual value, volume, velocity, counterparty, timing, currency, geography, and repair/reject behaviors.
* Build scalable batch, streaming, and near-real-time data pipelines to support payment monitoring, detection, scoring, alert generation, and downstream investigation workflows.
* Tune detection thresholds, scoring logic, and model sensitivity to balance early detection, precision, recall, false positive reduction, and operational usability.
* Develop explainability capabilities, reason codes, model diagnostics, and investigation summaries to help payment operations, risk, and technology teams understand why anomalies are flagged.
* Integrate anomaly detection services with payment applications, case management tools, workflow platforms, APIs, data stores, and human-in-the-loop review processes.
* Use GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI capabilities selectively to support alert summarization, root-cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, operational playbooks, and assisted triage.
* Implement MLOps practices for experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, reproducibility, monitoring, rollback, and production support.
* Monitor model performance, alert quality, drift, data quality, investigation outcomes, SLA adherence, and production reliability across anomaly detection use cases.
* Partner with payments operations, product, risk, compliance, architecture, cybersecurity, and engineering teams to translate business scenarios into detection patterns and AI-enabled controls.
* Apply Responsible AI, model risk management, auditability, data governance, security, and regulatory control requirements for AI solutions in a financial services environment.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into agent-based solutions.

****Education & Qualifications****
**Skills Required**

* Hands-on experience building anomaly detection, fraud detection, transaction monitoring, risk scoring, or payment intelligence models using supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and hybrid approaches.
* Strong understanding of anomaly detection techniques such as clustering, isolation forests, one-class SVM, autoencoders, gradient boosting, time-series anomaly detection, graph-based detection, and statistical outlier methods.
* Ability to engineer features from high-volume payment data, including amount, currency, value date, settlement date, counterparty, account, geography, payment type, frequency, velocity, historical behavior, exception codes, and repair/reject patterns.
* Experience tuning detection thresholds and model sensitivity to optimize precision, recall, F1 score, alert quality, false positive reduction, and operational triage effectiveness.
* Knowledge of payment flows, payment exceptions, duplicate payments, unusual value or volume patterns, payment repairs, rejects, sanctions referrals, cut-off breaches, and operational risk indicators.
* Experience deploying batch, streaming, or near-real-time inference pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, cloud data platforms, APIs, and MLOps tooling.
* Ability to implement explainability and investigation support using SHAP, LIME, reason codes, model diagnostics, rule-model hybrids, and GenAI-assisted alert summarization.
* Experience monitoring model drift, data quality, alert trends, investigation outcomes, SLA performance, and production reliability for anomaly detection systems.

****Minimum Qualifications****

* 6+ years of professional experience; Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience developing large-scale data pipelines and distributed data-processing solutions.
* Proficiency in Python with solid software engineering fundamentals
* Experience with SQL, APIs, workflow automation, and cloud-native architectures.
* Solid understanding of RAG, experience with OpenAI Service and prompt engineering techniques. Knowledge of vector databases.
* Experience integrating LLMs with external databases, APIs and storage systems
* Experience in CI/CD-based projects. Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for deploying AI services
* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Experience using Jira as an agile management tool.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience in Payments domain. Familiarity with payment standards and rails such as SWIFT, ISO 20022, wires, ACH, SEPA, real-time payments, and cross-border payment processing is preferred.
* Experience in IBM MQ, Kafka, MFT.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI, data governance, and model risk management.

**Work Schedule**
Hybrid
  
  
**Keywords (If any)**
**Why this role is important to us**
Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
  
  
We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end-to-end, next-generation financial services company.
  
  
Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.
  
  
****About State Street****
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.
  
  
State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.
  
  
Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers
  
  
****About State Street****
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: AI Tooling Engineer - Remote
description:
**About Us**
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 225 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.
  
  
For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
  
  
This role sits in Zyte's Tooling team, working side by side with our Principal Engineer in Tooling on an internal agentic platform: one place that brings together what the company knows, today spread across many systems, so that people and their AI agents get that context in one place, each seeing only what they are allowed to see.
  
  
We are looking for a builder: someone who has built AI agents and shipped them to real users, and who likes owning a product end to end, from talking with the people who use it to the code, the deployment and the numbers that say whether it works. The first version is already in use inside the company and grows every week.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Build the platform with the Principal Engineer in Tooling: new capabilities every week, from design to production
* Connect new internal systems and SaaS tools to the platform: their APIs and data, how they fit a shared model, and who may see what
* Build agents and the tools they use, including MCP servers that agents across the company can call, and the context they need to answer well
* Own quality: evaluation sets and benchmarks, tracing, cost per answer, and fixing what users run into
* Turn proofs of concept into internal tools that run in production in the cloud, with security and access done properly
* Build with AI coding agents as the main way of working, with the specs, tests and reviews that keep the code sound
* Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives: evaluating and standardising internal AI tools, cost and usage tracking, and agreed standards for AI-built internal apps; help other teams build on the platform
* Talk with the people who use the platform, across the company, to learn what to build next, and explain what was built to technical and non-technical audiences

**Requirements**

* 3+ years building and shipping production software, mostly in Python, with relational databases
* Has built and shipped with LangGraph at least one agent that real people use: tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt and context design
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from the main providers, cost and token optimisation
* Hands-on with MCP or similar tool protocols, as a server and as a client
* Evaluates AI systems properly: test sets, LLM-as-judge, regressions when a prompt or a model changes; tracing and observability with Langfuse or similar
* Integrates APIs and data: SaaS APIs, SQL, data warehouses
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or AWS): containers, managed databases, identity and access, CI/CD
* Uses AI coding agents every day and knows how to keep their output in check
* A sense for security and permissions: identity, least privilege, people see only what they are allowed to see
* Comfortable with version control (GitHub/Bitbucket)
* Excellent written and spoken English, technical and non-technical

**Desired Skills:**

* Familiarity with web data or web scraping
* Django and Postgres, including vector search with pgvector
* Enough frontend to build and change a chat interface (React, Next.js)
* Has built internal tools that colleagues adopted
* Semantic layers or knowledge graphs
* Memory for agents, multi-agent setups
* Previous remote/distributed team experience

**Benefits**
By joining the Zyte team, you will:
  
  

* Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
* Freedom and flexibility to work remotely
* Work with cutting-edge, open-source technologies and tools — and shape the AI tooling the rest of the company relies on

title: Technical Expert - Agentic Systems
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore.
  
  
**Function:**
Software Engineering
  
  
**Reports to:**
Manager, Esko AI
  
  
**About The Role**
The Esko AI team is a group of specialists focused on leveraging AI to solve valuable and often challenging customer problems that have historically resisted automation via purely rule-based approaches. To succeed in the complex domain of packaging graphics, AI agents must operate reliably according to regulatory requirements, technical specifications, brand guidelines, customer-specific conventions - and invoke expert human judgement when required. This is a complex engineering problem that goes beyond the boundaries of standard agentic scenarios.
  
  
We're looking for a Technical Expert to take technical ownership of core agentic capabilities within Esko’s AI Platform, from experimentation and design through production implementation.be a senior authority and author on agentic AI across Esko's AI Platform. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management one: you'll set direction and raise the bar through writing code, leading experiments, writing documentation, and mentorship of team members for a platform that spans multiple agentic capabilities (knowledge & reasoning, tool use and orchestration, evaluation, and safety/guardrails) and which is used by many product teams across the business.
  
  
You should bring experience from multiple agentic AI projects with a similar order of complexity in terms of the technical challenges you have successfully tackled, together with a ‘sixth sense’ for agentic AI operation to predict the approaches which are likely yield successful results as the platform grows into new domains.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Go deep on the hardest technical problems inside the agentic AI platform - the ones where progress depends on specialist expertise, not just engineering effort: data discovery & consolidation, agent planning and tool-use, retrieval and grounding, validation-before-action, conflict/ambiguity handling, and similar hard sub-problems.
* Personally design, build, and harden the platform's most technically demanding components - the pieces where correctness, edge cases, and failure modes are subtle enough to need deep, hands-on ownership rather than delegation.
* Act as the team's go-to technical expert on agentic AI and LLM systems: the person others bring their hardest "how do we actually make this work" problems to, providing depth on specific technical questions rather than setting overall team direction.
* Diagnose and resolve the platform's toughest technical issues - performance, reliability, correctness, and edge-case failures - where specialist knowledge is the difference between a real fix and a workaround.
* Contribute into architecture discussions, stress-testing designs against hard technical realities (scaling limits, failure modes, subtle correctness issues) that come from real specialist experience.
* Evaluate emerging techniques, frameworks, and tools in agentic AI and LLM tooling, and give the team pragmatic, evidence-based recommendations on what's worth adopting.
* Write technical deep-dives and documentation that make complex mechanisms legible to the rest of the team, so your expertise compounds rather than staying tacit.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language.
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial time as a senior/staff/principal-level individual contributor architecting and operating production agentic AI systems involving multi-step reasoning, tool use, planning, or orchestration, where alignment and dependability of the agent’s output is a key success factor.
* Experience across multiple distinct agentic AI projects, able to draw on that breadth to guide technical decisions in unfamiliar contexts.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in: LLM agent frameworks and orchestration, tool-calling and validation-before-action patterns, RAG and retrieval architecture, evaluation and observability for AI systems.
* A track record of setting technical direction and shaping outcomes across teams without formal management authority.
* Sound engineering judgement on production concerns at platform scale: reliability, security, multi-tenancy, performance, and observability for services consumed by many internal teams.
* Excellent technical communication - able to write RFCs and architectural documents that align diverse stakeholders, and to move fluently between deeply technical and business audiences.
* Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and autonomy, including defining the right problem as much as solving it.
* Undergraduate, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Preferred Experience**

* Public technical-leadership signals: conference talks, published papers or blog posts, significant open-source contributions, or patents in AI/agentic systems.
* Semantic and symbolic tooling (RDF/OWL, SHACL, Datalog, DMN, production rule engines, policy-as-code) as one of several tools in a broader agentic toolkit.
* Experience in high-accountability, regulated domains (pharmaceutical or food labelling, legal technology, financial services) or the packaging/graphic arts industry.
* Experience scaling an AI or data platform from a handful of internal consumers to many, including the governance and support model that requires.

**What Success Looks Like**

* The platform's hardest technical problems get solved correctly and durably.
* The team turns to you as the deep technical authority on agentic AI and LLM systems - for the "how" and "why it breaks,".
* The components you build are robust, well-tested, and well-documented, with edge cases and failure modes properly accounted for rather than discovered in production.
* Your specialist expertise ends up embedded in the platform itself - in code, designs, and documentation - not just in advice given in meetings, and also reflected in growing knowledge and capabilities of more junior team members.
* Emerging techniques and tools get properly evaluated on their technical merits, so adoption decisions are grounded in real hands-on assessment rather than hype.
* Agents built on components you own reliably apply the correct context, explain their reasoning, justify / evidence actions, and escalate rather than guess when evidence is ambiguous or absent.

Esko is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment
*where purpose meets possibility*
: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.
  
  
At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
  
  
**Unsolicited Assistance**
We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: Principal Engineer - AI
description:
**Let’s be unstoppable together!**
Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.
  
  
At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Circana is building an agentic ecosystem on the industry's richest view of consumer behavior: intelligent systems that reason, plan, and act across the data the world's largest brands and retailers run on. **Description**
RBS (Retail Business Services) Tech team works towards enhancing the customer experience (CX) and their trust in product data by providing technologies to find and fix Amazon CX defects at scale. title: Lead Engineer - AI Infrastructure [T500-28890]
description:
**About Suffolk:**

Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment (Suffolk Technologies). By integrating data, artificial intelligence, and advanced technology through our Seamless Platform, we connect design, construction, and operations to deliver smarter, more predictable results and redefine how America builds.

Suffolk – America’s Contractor – is a national company with more than $10 billion in annual revenue, 3,000 employees, and 17 offices, including Boston (headquarters), New York City, Miami, West Palm Beach, Tampa, Estero, Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Las Vegas, Herndon, U.S. Virgin Islands, and other key markets. Suffolk manages some of the most complex and transformative projects in the country, serving clients across healthcare, life sciences, education, gaming, aviation, transportation, government, mission critical, and commercial sectors. Suffolk is privately held and is led by founder, chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked #8 on ENR’s list of “Top CM-at-Risk Contractors.”

**About Suffolk Global:**

Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.

As a critical part of Suffolk’s long-term growth strategy, Suffolk Global enables greater speed, scalability, and technical rigor across the business. At the intersection of process standardization, AI-enabled innovation, and global talent, Suffolk Global is redefining how work is executed , embedding consistent workflows, leveraging technology to drive efficiency, and building high-performing teams aligned to Suffolk’s evolving needs.

By embedding deeply with U.S.-based teams, the platform supports high-impact work across design, digital delivery, and corporate functions. Powered by India’s exceptional talent pool, Suffolk Global is building a next-generation capability that combines deep technical expertise with a relentless focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous innovation, helping redefine what’s possible in the built environment.

**About Artificial Intelligence (AI):**

Suffolk’s AI team is at the forefront of redefining how AI transforms the built environment. Operating as a core part of Suffolk’s global innovation ecosystem, the team works at the intersection of construction, technology, and advanced analytics to design and deploy AI-driven solutions that address real-world challenges across jobsites and enterprise functions.

The work spans a broad range of IT capabilities, including enterprise applications, end-user support, systems integration, and platform delivery. The team helps ensure seamless connectivity across systems, reliable day-to-day operations, and a strong foundation for continued digital growth across the business.

This is an opportunity to build and scale cutting-edge AI capabilities in a highly applied environment, while helping shape Suffolk’s vision for the ‘Construction Site of the Future’ and redefining what’s possible in the built environment.

**Overview:**

Build and operate reusable AI infrastructure services that enable teams to develop, deploy, and scale Agentic AI and Generative AI applications securely and reliably.

This role focuses on building foundational AI platform capabilities including LLMOps, observability, governance, guardrails, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and runtime infrastructure for autonomous AI agents.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build AI Infrastructure to support a team of Agentic and GenAI app developers. This including building systems for Guardrails, Observability, Governance, LLMOps, agent to agent orchestration, Traceability and other such infra elements that are unique to AI systems. This includes the following…
* Build and maintain the foundational infrastructure for agentic AI systems — including orchestration layers, tool registries, and execution environments that support multi-step, autonomous agent workflows
* Design reliable and observable agent runtimes — implement tracing, logging, and replay tooling across long-running agent sessions, with support for interrupt/resume, sandboxing, and failure recovery (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, custom OpenTelemetry pipelines)
* Own memory and context infrastructure — architect short- and long-term memory stores, manage context window strategies, and build retrieval systems that give agents reliable, low-latency access to the right information at the right time
* Develop and operate tool/API integration layers — build secure, rate-limit-aware, and schema-validated connectors that agents use to interact with external systems, ensuring safe and auditable tool execution
* Define guardrails and safety infrastructure for autonomous agents\*— implement policy enforcement, output validation, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and permission scoping to ensure agents operate within defined boundaries in production

**Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* 10 -15 years software engineering
* 8-10 developing ML/AI systems

**What “Good” Looks Like;**

**Can independently build:**

* A retrieval pipeline
* A simple eval framework
* A production-ready API

**Competencies:**

* Engineering fundamentals
* Learning agility
* System reliability mindset

* Design and validate analytical models using diverse tools.

This role is an 80% IC role in doing hands-on engineering and developing POCs to support a resilient, scalable, performance optimized, secure multi-cloud data platform, and 20% of the capacity is responsible for managing and mentoring the employees, based out of Bangalore, responsible for the production maintenance & support of the legacy data platform. We partner with many of the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. **Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, with 15+ years of technology experience, preferably in financial services.

* Deep hands-on expertise with Apache Spark for batch and streaming workloads, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and cost optimization.

* Extensive experience productionizing data capabilities through DevOps and CI/CD, automated testing, observability, data quality, incident management, and operational support for mission-critical platforms.

* Experience with both structured and unstructured data management tools and associated patterns
* Familiarity with modern governance frameworks (Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation).

title: Lead Research Engineer - LLM Optimization & Agentic Systems
description:
**Company:**
CraftifAI

**Work arrangement:**
Full-time, work from office

**Role focus:**
70% hands-on research and engineering; 30% technical leadership and ownership

**Preferred joining timeline:**
Candidates who can join in fewer than 45 days are preferred.

About CraftifAI

CraftifAI is building
**Orbit**
, a platform that automates engineering workflows across embedded software, Edge AI, and FPGA development. Our work connects requirements, domain knowledge, code generation, testing, validation, and deployment to help engineering teams build working products.

We are looking for a research-driven engineer who can strengthen the LLMs and agentic systems behind these workflows, with a particular focus on efficient on-premises deployment and reliable code generation.

About the Role

You will lead the research and implementation of domain-specific LLM solutions and agentic systems for engineering applications. This includes fine-tuning models, reducing their deployment footprint while preserving measured task quality, designing knowledge architectures, building agent harnesses, and establishing rigorous product benchmarks.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
. Approximately 70% of your time will involve coding, experiments, model optimization, evaluation, and product integration. The remaining 30% will involve architecture decisions, research direction, mentoring, and ownership of technical outcomes.

You should be comfortable moving from a research hypothesis to an implementation, measuring its impact, understanding its failures, and improving it until it works reliably within the product.

What You Will Own

1. LLM Fine-Tuning and Efficient On-Premises Deployment

* Adapt LLMs for engineering tasks, including code generation, tool use, debugging, and reasoning over domain-specific information.
* Build data preparation and fine-tuning workflows using suitable approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference optimization.
* Apply and evaluate compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to reduce model size and memory requirements.
* Measure trade-offs between task quality, model footprint, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost on target deployment hardware.

2. Agentic Systems for Code Generation

* Design and implement agent harnesses for task planning, repository exploration, context management, code generation, tool execution, debugging, and iterative correction.
* Build reliable execution flows with clear state management, failure recovery, stopping conditions, and observable results.
* Improve the ability of agents to complete engineering tasks across multiple files, dependencies, tools, and execution environments.
* Own the integration of these capabilities into CraftifAI’s product workflows.

3. Domain Knowledge and Context Architecture

* Design knowledge systems that connect source code, requirements, architecture documents, hardware documentation, SDKs, APIs, and previous engineering outcomes.
* Develop effective retrieval and context construction using approaches such as hybrid search, reranking, structured knowledge, and repository-aware retrieval.
* Decide when information belongs in model training, retrieval, structured tools, or persistent agent memory.
* Keep retrieved information traceable to its source, version, and applicable hardware or software configuration.

4. Code Quality and Automated Verification

* Build and integrate static analysis tools, compiler diagnostics, linters, code structure checks, and security checks into agent workflows.
* Combine these checks with automated builds, unit tests, and controlled execution to evaluate generated code.
* Convert tool findings into actionable feedback that agents can use to diagnose and correct their outputs.
* Establish quality gates and regression checks that provide objective evidence of improvement.

5. Low-Latency System Design

* Profile and optimize the complete workflow, including retrieval, context preparation, model inference, tool calls, and correction cycles.
* Improve serving, caching, batching, context efficiency, and execution routing where they produce measurable benefits.
* Design for practical on-premises constraints, including available compute, GPU memory, concurrency, and restricted external connectivity.
* Optimize time to a verified result alongside model response time.

6. Reasoning and Learning from Field Use

* Improve agent planning, tool selection, debugging, and recovery through systematic failure analysis and controlled experiments.
* Turn field failures and user feedback into curated datasets, evaluation cases, improved knowledge, and better agent behavior.
* Evaluate suitable methods for improving reasoning and tool use, including fine-tuning, preference learning, and reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Validate improvements against regression benchmarks before release, within customer data and deployment constraints.

7. Product Benchmarking and Technical Leadership

* Own reproducible benchmarks at both model and complete product workflow levels.
* Measure task completion, functional correctness, static analysis findings, test results, human intervention, latency, memory use, and compute cost.
* Use held-out tasks, baseline comparisons, ablation studies, and error analysis to explain which changes improve the product and why.
* Define research priorities, lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and take ownership from experimentation through product integration.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* **Minimum qualification: MS by Research from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad**
  , in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field.
  **A PhD is preferred.**
* Strong practical experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them on private or on-premises infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience reducing model size or inference memory requirements, supported by measured quality and performance results.
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic systems for code generation, including tool integration, execution feedback, and iterative repair.
* Strong understanding of domain knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, context management, and their interaction with model behavior.
* Strong Python and software engineering skills, with practical experience using frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, PEFT, or equivalent tools.
* Experience integrating static analysis, build systems, automated testing, or other programmatic checks into code-generation workflows.
* Strong research discipline: clear hypotheses, controlled experiments, reproducible results, and careful interpretation of failures.
* Ability to make architecture decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and personally implement critical parts of the solution.

Additional Experience We Value

* Research publications or open-source contributions in efficient LLMs, code models, reasoning, agentic systems, or program analysis.
* Experience with C/C++, embedded software, compilers, firmware, or hardware-aware code generation.
* Experience with model serving, inference profiling, distributed training, or resource-constrained deployments.
* Experience turning research prototypes into maintained production capabilities.

What to Include in Your Application

Please share your CV and relevant publications, repositories, or project examples. Where possible, include:

* An LLM fine-tuning or compression project with measured quality, memory, and latency results.
* An agentic code-generation system you personally built, including its tool integrations and evaluation approach.
* A brief explanation of your individual contribution and the most significant technical problem you solved.
* Your current notice period and availability to work from the office.

title: Founder's Office (Engineering)
description:
**OnArrival | Bengaluru | Full-time | Work directly with the CTO & Co-founder**

**About OnArrival**

At OnArrival, we’re building the technology infrastructure that powers the next generation of travel experiences.

Our platform enables fintechs, banks, consumer brands, and digital businesses to seamlessly embed travel into their products through APIs, SDKs, and intelligent infrastructure.

We’re building towards a future where travel is embedded everywhere, increasingly autonomous, and powered by AI.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an exceptionally resourceful, technically strong, and hands-on individual to join our Founder’s Office – Engineering.

Think of this role as being the CTO’s technical right hand.

You’ll work closely with the CTO across engineering initiatives, new product ideas, architecture, AI experimentation, internal tooling, and strategic technical projects.

You’ll also act as a trusted liaison between the CTO and engineering teams, product stakeholders, technology partners, and external collaborators.

But here’s the important part: This is a hands-on engineering role, not a project management or coordination role.

We want someone who can write code, build prototypes, investigate problems, understand complex systems, challenge technical decisions, and independently take projects from an idea to a working solution.

One day you could be building an AI agent. The next, exploring a new backend architecture, debugging an integration, or representing the CTO in a technical discussion.

You’ll be involved in both the thinking and the doing.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Build, Code & Experiment**

\* Write production-quality code and build working prototypes.

\* Personally own and deliver engineering projects from concept to deployment.

\* Build internal tools, developer utilities, automations, and AI-powered workflows.

\* Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, and emerging technologies.

\* Work across APIs, backend systems, integrations, SDKs, and occasionally frontend applications.

\* Debug complex technical problems, investigate issues, and propose practical solutions.

\* Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and experimentation.

**2. Work Directly with the CTO**

\* Be deeply involved in the CTO’s ongoing technical initiatives and special projects.

\* Translate early-stage ideas and loosely defined problems into working solutions.

\* Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making.

\* Research new tools, frameworks, and technologies, and make informed recommendations.

\* Understand the broader engineering vision and help translate it into tangible outcomes.

\* Take ownership of initiatives without requiring constant direction or follow-ups.

**3. Act as a Technical Liaison**

\* Represent the CTO in selected engineering discussions, technical reviews, and partner conversations.

\* Work closely with engineering leads, product teams, and external stakeholders.

\* Bridge communication between the CTO and various engineering initiatives.

\* Understand technical blockers, dependencies, and implementation challenges.

\* Ensure important technical decisions translate into actual engineering progress.

\* Coordinate execution when needed, while remaining actively involved in the technical work.

**4. Drive Special Engineering Projects**

\* Take on experimental or high-impact initiatives that don’t naturally belong to an existing engineering team.

\* Build proof-of-concepts to validate new product ideas and technical approaches.

\* Explore platform improvements, architectural changes, performance optimization, and developer productivity.

\* Collaborate with different engineering pods to move initiatives forward.

\* Help evaluate build-versus-buy decisions and third-party technologies.

\* Take promising prototypes through technical validation and handover or production deployment.

**5. Explore What’s Next**

\* Stay ahead of developments in AI engineering, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, and software architecture.

\* Experiment with emerging technologies before they become mainstream.

\* Identify opportunities to simplify systems, automate work, and improve engineering velocity.

\* Bring fresh ideas to the CTO, backed by actual experimentation rather than presentations alone.

\* Help shape how OnArrival uses AI internally and builds AI-native travel experiences.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Technical Skills**

\* 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience.

\* Strong programming ability in at least one modern backend or full-stack language, such as Kotlin, Java, TypeScript, Python, or Go.

\* Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, databases, and modern backend architectures.

\* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

\* Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, debugging, deployment, and engineering workflows.

\* Familiarity with LLMs, AI development tools, and modern AI-assisted software engineering.

\* Ability to independently build, test, deploy, and demonstrate working solutions.

\* Broad technical curiosity and the ability to learn unfamiliar stacks quickly.

**Beyond Engineering**

\* Exceptional ownership: You don’t wait to be told every step. You figure things out and get them done.

\* Strong communication: You can explain complex technical ideas clearly to engineers, business stakeholders, and external partners.

\* High agency: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and making progress independently.

\* Structured thinking: You can break complex, loosely defined problems into manageable solutions.

\* Confidence: You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking difficult questions, and engaging with senior technical stakeholders.

\* Resourcefulness: You know when to build, when to automate, when to use AI, and when an existing tool is sufficient.

\* Discretion and reliability: You can be trusted with sensitive technical discussions, strategic initiatives, and responsibilities.

**Bonus Points If You**

\* Have worked in an early-stage or rapidly scaling technology startup.

\* Have been a founding engineer or independently built and launched products.

\* Have experience with AI agents, MCP, developer tooling, or LLM-powered applications.

\* Understand travel technology, fintech, APIs, or embedded platforms.

\* Have worked closely with founders, CTOs, or senior engineering leaders.

\* Enjoy hackathons, side projects, open-source contributions, and experimentation.

\* Are comfortable interacting with partners, vendors, and developer communities.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Within your first 3–6 months, we expect you to:**

\* Independently ship meaningful engineering projects and working prototypes.

\* Develop a strong understanding of OnArrival’s technology stack and engineering priorities.

\* Become a trusted technical extension of the CTO.

\* Take ownership of special projects with minimal supervision.

\* Build strong working relationships with engineering leads and product teams.

\* Help accelerate technical decisions, experimentation, and execution.

\* Free up the CTO’s bandwidth without introducing unnecessary coordination overhead.

**What This Role Is Not**

\* Not an executive assistant.

\* Not a traditional project manager or scrum master.

\* Not a role focused primarily on tracking tasks, preparing reports, or scheduling meetings.

\* Not a strategy-only position where engineering is delegated to other teams.

\* Not a role where you’ll spend all your time in meetings.

You’ll be expected to write code, solve technical problems, and ship actual software.

**Why Join?**

\* Direct founder exposure: Work alongside the CTO on some of the company’s most important technology initiatives.

\* Real engineering ownership: Build, experiment, architect, and ship without unnecessary layers.

\* Technical breadth: Work across AI, APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer platforms.

\* Freedom to experiment: Explore new technologies and turn ideas into working products.

\* High-impact work: Your contributions can directly influence OnArrival’s architecture, engineering productivity, and future products.

\* Accelerated growth: Develop the technical, product, and leadership judgment required to become an exceptional engineering leader.

**The Kind of Person Who Will Thrive Here**

* You’re probably the person who builds things over the weekend because you’re curious.
* You enjoy coding, but you’re equally interested in understanding why something should be built.
* You can jump from a technical architecture discussion to writing an API, then explain the solution to a stakeholder without losing context.
* You don’t need perfectly written requirements to get started. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, and build something.
* You like being close to decisions, taking responsibility, and making things happen.

If you’re someone who loves engineering, enjoys working with founders, and wants to be involved in building what’s next, this role is for you.

**Join us in building the infrastructure for the future of travel.**

title: Product Engineer
description:
**Experience**
: 3.00 + years
  
  
**Salary**
: INR 4500000-6000000 / year (based on experience)
  
  
**Expected Notice Period**
: 15 Days
  
  
**Shift**
: (GMT+05:30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)
  
  
**Opportunity Type**
: Office ()
  
  
**Placement Type**
: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: Astra)
  
  
**(\*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - Astra)
  
  
**What do you need for this opportunity?
  
  
**Must have skills required:**
LLM, Typescript/React, Node Js, Node/react, Websockets, AI Agents, Tool calling
  
  
**Astra is Looking for:**
Supa Health is building the agentic operating system that makes this work disappear — an AI scribe, an AI receptionist, and an agentic back office that handles benefits verification, prior auth, intake, and claims. Every call its agents make, every denial they work, every payer quirk they encounter feeds back into a system that gets sharper the next time. We''re building software that compounds.
  
  
We''re not selling dashboards. We''re replacing the work itself.
  
  
Small team, $5M from Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India), shipping fast. Looking for our founding product engineer.
  
  
**What You''ll Work On**
The honest answer is: whatever moves the product furthest. We have surface area in every direction and we''d rather you pick the one that fits you than wedge you into a slot.
  
  
**That could mean:**
Operator-facing surfaces. Real-time, dense, information-rich SPAs where our back-office team works through hundreds of cases a day. The interaction model matters as much as the engineering — operators live in these tools eight hours a day, and small wins compound into hours saved. Modern React stack, TypeScript end-to-end, real-time over WebSockets.
  
  
The agent platform. The systems that let our agents do real work in the world — making calls, navigating systems built before APIs existed, parsing structured and unstructured payer responses, and writing back into our own state. Worklfows for orchestration, Postgres as the source of truth, LLMs invoked deliberately rather than reflexively.
  
  
The platform underneath both. Schema, services, auth, multi-tenancy, integrations, and the HIPAA-grade segregation that has to be right on day one. Postgres, Drizzle, Fastify, an Nx monorepo, WorkOS for auth.
  
  
The next product wedge. We have a roadmap. We also have customers asking for things that aren''t on it. Founding engineers at Supa Health get to argue for what we should build next, and then build it.
  
  
You''ll talk to operators. You''ll talk to clinic owners. You''ll watch someone do their job for two hours and then go automate the painful parts of it. You''ll ship something on Tuesday and see it running in production on Wednesday.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Craft. You''ve shipped real software to real users for years and it shows in how you think. You have opinions about schema design, about when to reach for a state machine, about what makes a UI feel fast. You can tell the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality, and you reach for the second one. Your code reviews make the people around you better — not because you''re harsh, but because you''re specific, and the team''s standards rise around you.
  
  
Judgment. Healthcare is full of edge cases that look like bugs and bugs that look like edge cases. The CTO can''t be in every decision and we don''t want to use process as a substitute for thinking. We want people who can reason through a tradeoff with incomplete information and make the call.
  
  
Ownership. You don''t wait for work to be handed to you. You see what''s broken, what''s slow, what''s missing — and you write the doc, file the issue, or open the PR. You take a problem from "I noticed this" to "it''s deployed and working," which means talking to the user, designing the solution, writing the code, watching it land, and going back to fix what you got wrong.
  
  
Direction. You work with users and teammates to figure out what to build and how to build it. You sit with operators, watch where they get stuck, and come back with a sharper definition of the problem than we started with. You''re a thought partner to the team — not someone waiting for a spec, and not someone going off to build in a vacuum.
  
  
Speed. Not crashed-out hustle-culture speed. The kind of speed that comes from deleting unnecessary work, making decisions quickly, and not being precious about being wrong.
  
  
Range. You don''t need to be a 10/10 at frontend, backend, infra, AI, and product. You do need to be willing to learn whichever of those the work demands this week.
  
  
**Must Have:**
3+ years building production software. We care less about the years and more about the slope — what you''ve shipped, what you learned the hard way, and what you''d do differently now. You''ve lived in TypeScript and Postgres long enough to have real opinions about both.
  
  
**Good to Have:**
Agentic AI / LLM systems. You''ve built something with agents, tools, evals, and the unglamorous plumbing around them. You know when an LLM is the right answer and when it''s a fancy way to make a slow, wrong API call.
  
  
Early-stage startup experience. You know what it feels like to have no design system, no playbook, no PM, and a customer call in 90 minutes.
  
  
Healthcare / RCM background. You know what a 271 is. You''ve fought with a clearinghouse. You have feelings about Availity. This is rare and we''d love to find it, but we''ll happily teach the right person.
  
  
**How We Hire**
We borrowed our process from Linear because we think they got it right.
  
  
Intro call with the CTO. ~30 minutes. We talk about you, the company, and whether the role fits. We''ll discuss comp on this call.
  
  
Technical conversation. ~60 minutes. We work through a real problem together. No leetcode.
  
  
Paid work trial. 2–5 days, paid at our standard daily rate. You work on something real. You meet the team. You leave with a much clearer picture of whether Supa Health is the right place for you, and we leave with a much clearer picture of whether you''re the right person for Supa Health.
  
  
Decision. Independent feedback from the trial team, then a debrief, then an offer (or honest feedback if not).
  
  
**Who This Isn''t For**
We''d rather be honest now than waste your time later.
  
  
If you need a roadmap handed to you, you''ll be uncomfortable here. The roadmap is a conversation, and you''re in it.
  
  
If you want a 9-to-5, that''s a legitimate and healthy choice, and it isn''t this job. We don''t expect crunch, but we expect founding-team intensity.
  
  
If you''d rather not talk to users. Operators and clinic owners are part of your job, not someone else''s.
  
  
**Interview Process:**
L1- Introduction with the CTO
  
  
L2- Technical Conversation
  
  
L3- Paid Work Trial
  
  
L4- Decision
  
  
**How to apply for this opportunity?**

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

**About Uplers:**
Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!****

Your work will directly influence how ads are discovered, matched, ranked, and generated, improving user experience, advertiser ROI, and the efficiency of the Microsoft Ads platform.
  
  
We are looking for a scientist who values both deep research and practical execution. You are excited by scientific exploration, but equally motivated by shipping solutions, measuring impact, and iterating based on real-world outcomes. title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - AI Technologist
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Creative Hybrid (Creative AI Technologist) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.
  
  
You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.
  
  
You operate as the studio’s R&D engine. You proactively explore, test, and master emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover to raise the bar for everyone around you. You have a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.
  
  
You also work directly with clients and BCG case teams. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You lead workshops, shape narratives, and help organizations understand not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.
  
  
**Day To Day, You Will**

* Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
* Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
* Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
* Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualization, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
* Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
* Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
* Build capability across the studio. You run workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field
* 4+ years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment
* Fluency in Python, JavaScript, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution
* Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, ComfyUI, or similar, applied in a creative context
* Experience building agentic systems and pipelines: prompt taxonomies, evaluation rubrics, multi-step workflows, API orchestration. You understand RAG, tool use, and context windows at a working level
* Experience with automation frameworks, systems integration, and the judgment to know when to build versus when to connect
* An understanding of how brands work and how digital moments can create something people remember
* Confidence presenting to and working with clients, and the ability to lead a session, shape a narrative, and guide a review

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most cutting-edge design solutions.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You're Good AT**

* Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
* Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
* Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
* Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
* Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call
* Moving between creative and technical contexts without losing the thread of either. You think like a maker in both rooms
* Explaining what is technically possible in a way that gets non-technical people genuinely interested, not just nodding along
* Balancing experimentation with delivery, knowing when to push and when to ship

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.
  
  
As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:

**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.

title: GTM Engineer

A core component of the role involves analyzing GTM and customer data, identifying trends, and creating actionable insights and visualizations that guide strategic decisions. In addition, the GTM Engineer enhances productivity by building AI agents, improving workflows, and integrating tools that build pipeline and streamline daily operations.

This position is hands-on and highly collaborative—ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems with data, improving processes with technology, and delivering insights that directly impact pipeline, win rate, retention, and team efficiency. This position is a builder and analyst who elevates the GTM engine through smart use of data, AI, and automation.

The GTM Engineer reports to
**Revenue Operations**
and partners closely with leaders across the GTM organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Enablement & Agent Development**

* Build AI agents and workflows to support various use cases such as RFP responses, training and new hire onboarding, large data analysis, customer/prospect research, and high volume outbound messaging.
* Configure and leverage platforms like ChatGPT to increase GTM productivity.
* Build lightweight API-based automations connecting AI systems with CRM, content libraries, and GTM tools.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through intelligent automation.

**Data Analysis, Insights & Visualization**

* Analyze GTM, customer, and product data to uncover trends, patterns, and performance drivers.
* Build dashboards and visualizations using Domo
* Provide predictive insights, statistical modeling, and forecasting support for Sales, Marketing, and CS.
* Turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that influence GTM strategy and execution.
* Support strategic and board-level data requests as needed.

**GTM Tooling & Workflow Optimization**

* Improve workflows and user experiences within Salesforce and other GTM systems (Gong, Gainsight, Staircase, Marketo).
* Enhance lead management, lifecycle transitions, onboarding workflows, and productivity tooling through configuration and automation.
* Use outputs from Gong and Gainsight to surface actionable insights, not managed within those tools.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and Revenue Operations leadership to translate business needs into effective data and AI-driven solutions.
* Advise GTM team members on how to adopt and effectively use AI and insights in their daily workflows.
* Collaborate with team members within and outside of the GTM organization to ensure accuracy and clarity across GTM reporting.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–7+ years in GTM engineering, Revenue Operations, Sales/Marketing Operations, data-focused GTM roles, or similar technical roles.
* Strong experience with data visualization tools such as Domo, Power BI, or Tableau.
* Experience with common GTM tooling, including Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, and Marketo.
* Ability to build/configure AI-driven workflows, agents, and productivity automations.
* Strong analytical and statistical modeling skills; experience with forecasting or predictive analytics preferred.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to support non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with APIs
* Experience with SQL or Python recommended, but not required

**Success Measures**

* Increased GTM productivity through AI-driven workflows and improved tooling.
* Clear, actionable insights that influence pipeline, win rate, retention, and team efficiency.
* High-quality data visualizations and reporting used across GTM leadership.
* Reduced operational friction and enhanced GTM execution.
* Strong adoption of AI solutions and measurable impact on GTM performance.
